jobs.title: Senior Project Manager
Senior Product Manager (EdTech & AI)
Endear - Product Manager
jobs.description:
Our Story

At Endear, we’re building the first modern CRM for retail teams, starting with the frontline.

Our software helps retail teams build stronger customer relationships through thoughtful, intuitive technology. From clienteling and customer capture to appointments and in-store experiences, Endear gives brands the tools they need to create more personal interactions and drive measurable growth.

We work with brands like Gorjana, Reformation, and Alo Yoga, and we’re continuing to evolve Endear into an increasingly AI-first product built around how modern retail teams actually work.

Position Overview

We're looking for a Product Manager to help shape and deliver the next generation of Endear's platform.

You'll take ownership of product decisions, priorities, and outcomes, working closely with Design, Engineering, and cross-functional stakeholders to turn customer needs and business opportunities into impactful product experiences.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role for someone who can operate autonomously, make thoughtful tradeoffs, and drive initiatives from discovery through launch and iteration. You'll have meaningful ownership over what gets built, why it matters, and how we measure success, while partnering with product leadership on broader vision and direction.

AI fluency is central to how we work. You'll use AI to accelerate discovery, bring ideas to life through prototyping, automate workflows, and help the team deliver value faster.

This role is well suited for someone who thrives in ambiguity, takes ownership of decisions, and knows how to connect great product experiences to meaningful business impact.

What You'll Accomplish

In your first 6 months, you'll…

  • Take ownership of product initiatives from discovery through launch, making decisions around scope, priorities, and tradeoffs.

  • Build a deep understanding of our customers, their workflows, and the business problems we're solving.

  • Partner closely with Sales, Customer Experience, and Marketing to gather insights, align priorities, and identify opportunities for product improvement.

  • Translate customer needs, business goals, and product data into clear priorities and actionable plans.

  • Work closely with Design and Engineering to evaluate solutions, make product decisions, and deliver high-quality experiences.

  • Define success metrics and take accountability for the customer and business outcomes of the features you ship.

  • Use AI to improve how product work gets done, including rapid prototyping, documentation, research synthesis, and workflow automation.

In your first year, you'll…

  • Independently own meaningful areas of the product roadmap, driving decisions and measurable outcomes within the broader product strategy.

  • Deliver product improvements that increase adoption, engagement, customer value, and business performance.

  • Establish strong feedback loops across customers, Sales, CX, Marketing, Design, and Engineering to inform ongoing product decisions.

  • Build repeatable, AI-powered workflows that help the product team operate more efficiently and ship faster.

  • Become a trusted cross-functional partner who brings clarity to complex problems and drives alignment around priorities and decisions.

  • Demonstrate clear business impact through the products you build and the improvements you deliver.

You'll Thrive in This Role If…

  • You love owning product decisions and are comfortable being accountable for outcomes, not just execution.

  • You're able to operate independently, navigate ambiguity, and make sound decisions without needing constant direction.

  • You think commercially and understand how product decisions connect to customer value, adoption, retention, and business growth.

  • You naturally bring together different perspectives from Sales, CX, Marketing, Design, and Engineering to make better product decisions.

  • You're comfortable challenging assumptions, prioritizing competing needs, and communicating tradeoffs clearly.

  • You're highly fluent in AI and actively look for opportunities to automate work, build prototypes, and improve how teams operate.

  • You move quickly, experiment often, and know when to gather more information versus when to make a decision.

  • You care deeply about understanding customers and solving the right problems.

You Have Experience With

  • Approximately 5+ years of product management experience, ideally building customer-facing software or B2B SaaS products.

  • Independently owning product initiatives, including discovery, prioritization, decision-making, execution, and measuring outcomes.

  • Making product decisions that balance customer needs, business goals, and technical constraints.

  • Demonstrating measurable business impact through products or features you've shipped.

  • Working cross-functionally with Sales, Customer Experience, Marketing, Design, and Engineering to align stakeholders and drive initiatives forward.

  • Conducting customer discovery, synthesizing feedback, and using qualitative and quantitative data to inform product decisions.

  • Defining success metrics, evaluating product performance, and using insights to guide prioritization and iteration.

  • Operating effectively in ambiguous, fast-moving environments where priorities evolve.

  • Demonstrating strong AI fluency through practical applications, such as:

    • Building functional prototypes with AI to communicate and validate product ideas.

    • Automating product documentation, requirements, and ongoing updates.

    • Creating AI-powered workflows or systems that streamline product copy, content edits, or repetitive processes.

    • Using AI to accelerate research synthesis, problem framing, and product decision-making.

  • Evaluating AI-generated output critically and understanding when human judgment and validation are needed.

Experience with retail technology, e-commerce, CRM, mobile-first products, or AI-powered experiences is a plus, but not required.

Align With What We Value

At Endear, we live by five core principles. Here's how they translate into what we're looking for in this role:

  • Customer First: You prioritize real customer problems, use research and data to guide decisions, and connect product improvements to meaningful customer and business outcomes.

  • Take Ownership: You take responsibility for product decisions and results, independently driving initiatives from identifying opportunities through delivery and iteration.

  • Enable Autonomy: You create clarity around priorities, decisions, and tradeoffs so cross-functional teams can move forward confidently and independently.

  • Under Promise, Over Deliver: You set realistic expectations, communicate openly with stakeholders, and consistently deliver measurable value.

  • Innovate & Deliver Value Quickly: You embrace AI, automation, and experimentation to improve how products are built, reduce unnecessary work, and deliver meaningful improvements faster.

About the Team

Endear's product organization works across three product areas: AI, IRL (in real life), and Core Flows.

You'll collaborate closely with Product, Design, and Engineering while working across the business to understand customer needs, identify opportunities, and drive product outcomes.

You'll partner most closely with:

  • Product Leadership: Align on broader product vision, strategic priorities, and business goals while independently owning decisions within your product initiatives.

  • Design Team: Collaborate on discovery, problem definition, prototyping, and delivering intuitive product experiences.

  • Engineering Team: Evaluate technical feasibility, navigate tradeoffs, and turn product decisions into shipped solutions.

  • Sales, Customer Experience & Marketing: Gather customer and market insights, align on product priorities, support launches, and identify opportunities to improve adoption and customer value.

We're a small team with big ambitions, collaborative, customer-obsessed, and deeply excited about the problems we're solving in retail.

Our Hiring Process

  1. Recruiter Screen

  2. Behavioral Interview with the Hiring Manager + Co-Founder

  3. Panel interview with key Product and Engineering team members

  4. Final conversation with Co-Founder + CTO

  5. Offer 🎉

Compensation & Benefits

  • Base Salary: $140,000-$170,000

  • Fully remote, US-based team

  • Comprehensive healthcare (medical, dental, vision)

  • Co-working or home office stipend

  • Flexible PTO and unlimited vacation

  • Opportunity to shape foundational product work in a transformative industry

Location: This role is remote and US-based. Our full team comes together for an all-team standup every Monday at 8:00 AM Pacific, so you'll need to be available at that time.

Apply Even If You Don't Check Every Box

If this role excites you but you're unsure if you meet every requirement, reach out anyway. No retail or e-commerce background is required. We care about your product thinking, skills, motivation, and how you approach problems more than we do about perfect resumes.

jobs.title: Associate Product Manager (f/m/d)
Treasury Project Manager - Short-Term Contract
jobs.description:
About Voodoo

Voodoo is a consumer tech company founded in Paris in 2013, with one mission: entertain the world. Today we are 1,000 people, generating $1b+ in annual revenue, profitably. Our games and apps have passed 7 billion downloads and reach 200 million+ active users every month, making Voodoo the #3 mobile publisher worldwide in downloads, after Google and Meta. We were backed by Goldman Sachs, Tencent and GBL along the way.

Team

Our Corporate teams support the company’s performance and growth whilst putting people at the core of everything they do. As a French tech leader and global successful company, our Corporate teams are constantly looking for ways to innovate and increase organization efficiency to keep Voodoo ahead of the market. Voodoo’s Corporate function is composed of three teams: HR, Legal and Finance, working together to drive Voodoo’s success.

Role

We're looking for a Treasury Project Manager to join our Corporate team on a 6-month fixed-term contract. In this role, you'll drive the transformation of our treasury operations by identifying inefficiencies, implementing automation, and strengthening financial controls across our global entities.

  • Support day-to-day treasury operations when needed, ensuring continuity across the team

  • Gain a deep understanding of daily cash management and liquidity monitoring across France and international affiliates using Kyriba TMS and electronic banking platforms

  • Design and implement automated workflows leveraging AI and Kyriba to reduce manual workload (automatic bank statement analysis, automated bank notifications, budget code entry, etc.)

  • Monitor and validate the effectiveness of newly implemented workflows, iterating as needed

  • Analyse the current cash forecasting process and identify areas for improvement

  • Propose and implement enhancements to the cash forecasting methodology, including the potential rollout of new Kyriba modules

  • Assess the existing workflow between purchase orders, invoices, and payments to identify fraud risk exposure

  • Design and implement controls and tracking mechanisms to mitigate fraud risk and ensure end-to-end traceability between POs and payments

Profile

  • Master's degree in Finance or Accounting (business school, engineering school, or university)

  • Minimum 4 years of experience in cash management, combined with a proven track record in project management

  • Hands-on experience with Kyriba TMS and electronic banking platforms

  • Proficiency in AI tools, including the ability to craft effective prompts with clear context, expected output formats, and examples - and to design appropriate safeguards (e.g. preventing cell overwrites, balance discrepancy checks, alert setup)

  • Strong analytical mindset with the ability to challenge existing processes and propose pragmatic improvements

  • Rigorous, proactive, and autonomous, with a strong sense of ownership

  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, international environment

  • Fluent in both French and English (spoken and written)

Benefits

  • Competitive salary based on experience

  • Swile Lunch voucher

  • Gymlib (100% covered by Voodoo)

  • Premium healthcare coverage with SideCare, 100% covered for you and your family

  • Wellness activities in our Paris office

  • Remote Fridays

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager D365 CRM
Product Owner Gemeentepas
jobs.description:
Wil jij maximale waarde creëren voor gemeenten, aanbieders en eindgebruikers met de Gemeentepas? Het kan als Product Owner. Je vormt de spil tussen business, technologie en operatie en is in staat om de strategische doelen van de organisiatie te vertalen naar tactische doelen en het opzetten van een duidelijke productvisie, roadmap en backlog.

Wat jij doet

Als Product Owner ontwikkel en onderhoud je een heldere productvisie en -strategie voor de stadspasoplossing, afgestemd op de behoeften van gemeenten en het portfolio van Centric. Je richt je op het bepalen van de productrichting, het vertalen van wensen en behoeften naar concrete verbeteringen en het onderhouden van sterke relaties met stakeholders.

In deze rol gaan we een maximaal beroep doen op je commerciële vaardigheden. De Gemeentepas is een nieuwe oplossing binnen ons portfolio. Dat betekent dat je veel contact met potentiële klanten zult hebben. Hun wensen weet te vertalen naar standaardoplossingen en daarvoor een marktconforme vergoeding weet te verantwoorden. Je zult actief in aanbesteding trajecten een inhoudelijk en commerciële rol gaan vervullen.

Je wordt daarin uiteraard ondersteund door onze product sales en productmanager. Wij denken dat dit een hele mooie kans is voor een zeer ondernemende product owner die in zichzelf en een nieuw product wil investeren.

Wat doe je nog meer?

  • Productstrategie en roadmap: Je stelt een roadmap op voor de doorontwikkeling van de Gemeentepas. Hierbij kijk je naar integraties met gemeentelijke systemen, waaronder Suites voor het Sociaal Domein, en onderzoek je nieuwe mogelijkheden, zoals koppelingen met Europese wallets.

  • Klant- en stakeholdermanagement: Je vertegenwoordigt de stem van de klant en zorgt ervoor dat wensen, behoeften en eisen van gemeenten, aanbieders en eindgebruikers worden vertaald naar concrete productverbeteringen.

  • Backlogbeheer en prioritering: Je beheert en prioriteert de productbacklog op basis van businesswaarde, wettelijke vereisten, strategische doelstellingen en gebruikersfeedback.

  • Samenwerking met het ontwikkelteam: Je werkt nauw samen met het scrumteam om epics en user stories op te stellen, te verfijnen en te valideren, zodat de ontwikkelwerkzaamheden aansluiten bij de productvisie.

  • Analyse en optimalisatie: Je identificeert hiaten in de functionaliteit door middel van fit-gapanalyses en initieert verbeteringen op het gebied van gebruikerservaring (UX), toegankelijkheid en systeemintegraties.

  • Markt- en trendontwikkeling: Je volgt marktontwikkelingen, relevante wet- en regelgeving en technologische innovaties en vertaalt deze naar nieuwe functionaliteiten en proposities.

  • Monitoring en waardecreatie: Je bewaakt de voortgang en de gerealiseerde waarde per sprint en release en stuurt waar nodig bij om de productdoelstellingen te behalen.

  • Rapportage en KPI’s: Je monitort en rapporteert over relevante KPI’s, zoals gebruikerstevredenheid en de adoptie van de stadspasoplossing door gemeenten en aanbieders

Dit krijg je

Bij Centric kun je als Product Owner/ Productmanager rekenen op:

  • Een brutosalaris van €4.500,- tot € 5.250,- per maand afhankelijk van kennis en ervaring

  • Mogelijkheid tot thuiswerken en een goede werk-privébalans doordat je de ruimte krijgt om te bepalen hoe jij jouw werkweek indeelt

  • Uitgebreide opleidings- en ontwikkelmogelijkheden

  • 26 vakantiedagen, 8% vakantietoeslag (uitbetaling in mei) en loyaliteitsdagen: hoe langer je in dienst bent, hoe meer vrije tijd

  • Een bijdrage aan je pensioen en korting op je collectieve zorgverzekering

  • Een laptop en telefoon van de zaak

  • Een thuiswerkplekvergoeding van € 15,- per maand plus € 2,45 netto per thuiswerkdag

  • Een mobiliteitsbudget omdat jij zelf wil bepalen hoe je van werk naar huis reist

  • Personeelsaanbiedingen bij toonaangevende merken

  • Een bonus tot € 1.500,- als jij een nieuwe collega aan ons voorstelt

  • Een personeelsvereniging die écht leuke dingen organiseert. Ga je mee naar Praag, de Efteling of skiën?

Dit breng je mee

Je hebt strategisch inzicht, bent besluitvaardig en beschikt over sterke analytische vaardigheden. Daarnaast herken je jezelf in het volgende profiel:

  • Je hebt hbo-werk- en denkniveau, bij voorkeur in de richting van IT, bedrijfskunde of een vergelijkbaar vakgebied.

  • Je hebt enkele jaren ervaring als Product Owner of Product Manager binnen softwareontwikkeling.

  • Je hebt ervaring binnen de publieke sector. Kennis van het Sociaal Domein is een sterke pré.

  • Je hebt kennis van systeemintegraties, security en privacy, waaronder de AVG en Secure Software Development.

Het maken van een assessment kan onderdeel uitmaken van deze sollicitatieprocedure.

Omring jezelf met mogelijkheden bij Centric


Hier starten jouw kansen  
Zonder dat je het misschien weet, ben je al eens met Centric in aanraking geweest. Als je betaalt in de winkel. Als je een glas kraanwater drinkt. Als je een paspoort aanvraagt. Duizenden organisaties en hun miljoenen klanten rekenen elke dag weer op onze 200+ technologische oplossingen, hoogwaardige IT-diensten en 3.700 gekwalificeerde professionals. Samen zorgen we dat belangrijke processen in onze samenleving altijd doordraaien. 

Zodra je Centric komt versterken, omring jij jezelf met mogelijkheden. Zo kun je jouw kennis vergroten door samen te werken met de ongeveer 500 collega’s van Digitale Overheid. Als partner van meer dan 300 gemeenten zorgen wij er dagelijks voor dat de dienstverlening van decentrale overheden aan inwoners en bedrijven niet komt stil te vallen. Want wist jij dat bijna alles wat inwoners van Nederland met de overheid regelen via onze oplossingen verloopt? Denk aan lokale belastingen en vergunningen, maar ook aanvraag van reisdocumenten en een uitkeringsaanvraag. Al die gegevens zorgen voor steeds meer inzicht en daarmee voor een nog betere dienstverlening richting inwoners.

We only have positions available for Dutch-speaking applicants residing in the Netherlands.

Wil jij bouwen aan het verschil? Solliciteer via onze website naar deze vacature Product Owner Gemeentepas. Voor meer informatie over de functie kun je contact opnemen met onze Recruiter, Danitsha Abdul via +31 6 10053663 of 

Centric aanvaardt geen ongevraagde hulp van intermediairs/uitzendbureaus of andere derden voor onze vacatures. Toegestuurde cv’s (in welke vorm dan ook) door genoemde partijen aan enige medewerkers van Centric zonder geldige schriftelijke zoekopdracht van onze HR Afdeling of Recruiters, worden beschouwd als publieke informatie. Er zal aan genoemde partijen geen vergoeding zijn verschuldigd in geval dat een kandidaat wordt aangenomen van wie ongevraagd het cv en/of andere gegevens zijn toegestuurd.

jobs.title: QA Tester
jobs.description:
About Us

We're hiring a QA Tester to help us ship reliable software, faster. You'll test new features and releases across our web and mobile products, find and document defects, and help build out our automated test coverage. The role is open to candidates from around 1 to 3 years' experience.

About the role and team

You'll sit within a cross-functional product squad alongside developers, a product managers and project managers, working in Agile sprints. Quality is a shared responsibility here: you'll be involved from refinement through to release, not just at the end.

Key responsibilities

  • Review user stories and acceptance criteria early, asking questions that surface gaps and edge cases before code is written

  • Write and maintain clear test cases, test plans and checklists for new features

  • Carry out manual functional, exploratory, regression and cross-browser/device testing

  • Log defects with clear reproduction steps, evidence and severity, and follow them through to resolution

  • Run regression and smoke tests ahead of releases and give a clear go/no-go view

  • Verify fixes and support release and post-release checks in production

  • Help improve QA processes, documentation and test data management

  • Share product knowledge with the wider team and support colleagues in Customer Success when issues are raised

Skills and experience

Essential

  • At least 1 year's hands-on experience testing web or mobile software in a commercial setting

  • Solid understanding of the software development lifecycle and testing fundamentals (test types, test design techniques, defect life cycle)

  • Experience writing test cases and raising well-documented bugs

  • Familiarity with an issue tracker and test management tools

  • A methodical, curious mindset and strong attention to detail

  • Clear written and verbal communication, including explaining technical issues to non-technical colleagues

  • Experience in leveraging AI to streamline and automate testing

Desirable

  • Some experience with test automation

  • Basic SQL for checking and preparing test data

  • Exposure to CI/CD pipelines (e.g. GitHub Actions) and version control with Git

  • Awareness of accessibility (WCAG), performance or security testing

  • Experience testing B2B SaaS or multi-tenant platforms

Benefits

 

As you can see, we are quickly progressing with our ambitious plans and are eager to grow our team of doers to achieve our vision of managing over 2 million properties through our platform across various countries. You can help us shape the future of property management across the globe. Here’s what we offer:

  • A competitive compensation package

  • 25 days annual holiday + 1 additional day for every year served up to 3 years.

  • Flexible working environment including the option to work abroad

  • Private health care for you and immediate family members with discounted gym membership, optical, dental and private GP

  • Enhanced parental leave

  • Life insurance (4x salary)

  • Employee assistance program

  • Company volunteering day and charity salary sacrifice scheme

  • Learning management system powered by Udemy

  • Referral bonus and charity donation if someone you introduce joins the company

  • Season ticket loan, Cycle to work, Electric vehicle and Techscheme programs

  • Pension scheme

  • Work abroad scheme

  • Company-sponsored lunches, dinners and social gatherings

jobs.title: Global Senior Program Manager
jobs.description:
Are you ready to lead complex engineering programs within the semiconductor industry? As Senior Program Manager, you drive multidisciplinary global projects from concept to delivery, working closely with leading customers, engineering teams and operations. 

 

You will be responsible for the full lifecycle of development programs, from the initial customer request and concept phase through industrialization and customer delivery. Working closely with engineering, operations, supply chain and our customers, you ensure technical ambitions are translated into successful business outcomes. 

 

Your main responsibilities are: 

  • Lead complex Design & Engineering programs from concept development through manufacturing ramp-up and customer delivery. 

  • Drive program execution across multidisciplinary teams of up to 50 engineers located across multiple global Benchmark sites. 

  • Take ownership of program scope, planning, budget, risks and key decision-making throughout the entire lifecycle. 

  • Align technical experts, project leaders and stakeholders around shared goals, priorities and deliverables. 

  • Work closely with operations, supply chain and external partners to ensure products are ready for successful industrialization and production. 

  • Act as the primary point of contact for customers, providing clear communication on progress, risks, decisions and their business impact. 

  • Create structure, alignment and momentum in technically complex environments where customer expectations, engineering challenges and business objectives come together. 

 

This role offers a unique opportunity to work at the forefront of semiconductor technology, leading strategic programs that have a direct impact on both our customers' success and Benchmark's future growth. 

 

Why do you want this position? 

Because few roles offer this combination of technical complexity, global collaboration and strategic impact. You will lead high-profile semiconductor programs, work directly with industry-leading customers, and drive the successful delivery of innovative products from concept through manufacturing, leaving a visible mark on both our organization and the future of semiconductor technology. 

 

What do we offer? 

At Benchmark, you work on products that truly matter. We are an organization where you are given freedom, where entrepreneurship is rewarded, and where you have the opportunity to turn your ideas into reality. We offer a dynamic environment with plenty of room to grow, take ownership, and advance your career. You will be part of a global company while still enjoying the down-to-earth culture that Twente is known for. 

At Benchmark, you will find challenging work, a high level of trust, and extensive opportunities for personal and professional development. You will work alongside pragmatic colleagues in an informal culture, supported by attractive employment conditions that enable long-term success. 

In addition, we offer: 

  • A competitive salary of up to €9,000 gross per month, based on full-time employment, depending on your experience, expertise, and background. 

  • revenue-based quarterly bonus scheme with a maximum payout of 5% of your quarterly salary.  

  • Enjoy 40 days of paid leave per year (27 vacation days plus 13 additional ADV days). 

  • Personal growth and development, with a tailored development path that aligns with your ambitions and the needs of the business. 

  • Flexibility in how you organize your workweek, enabling you to balance work and personal life in a way that works for you. 

  • A strong engineering-driven knowledge culture, where collaboration, knowledge sharing, and innovation are central. Through initiatives such as Lunch & Learn Sessions and Pitch Discovery Sessions, you will have ample opportunities to learn, inspire others, and develop new ideas. 

 

Who are you?

Whether you're already leading large-scale engineering programs or ready to take on a broader strategic role, you thrive in complex, technology-driven environments. You know how to align stakeholders, manage competing priorities, and guide multidisciplinary teams towards a common goal. With your leadership skills, business acumen and ability to bring structure to complexity, you successfully translate ambitious plans into tangible results.  

 

Furthermore, we are looking for: 

  • 7+ years of experience leading complex technical programs in a high-tech semiconductor environment, preferably within system development and with a background in mechatronics or mechanical engineering.  

  • Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to align multidisciplinary teams around common goals and priorities.  

  • Proven track record in delivering complex systems and development programs, from concept and design through industrialization and customer delivery.  

  • Strong technical affinity, capable of translating engineering challenges into clear plans, decisions and results.  

  • Excellent communication and problem-solving skills, combined with the flexibility to thrive in a fast-paced international environment and willingness to travel. 

 

If you're excited by the challenge of leading global semiconductor programs at the forefront of technology, we cannot wait to get in touch! 

 

Serious Tech 
At Benchmark, you work on products that make a real impact through innovation, whether by improving safety, enhancing healthcare, or making everyday life easier. From product design and engineering to volume production and, in some cases, direct delivery to end users, the entire process takes place at our Almelo facility, where you will work alongside approximately 650 colleagues. 

 

We develop and manufacture innovative solutions for industries including semiconductor, healthcare, aerospace, and industrial markets. From concept to production, the complete product lifecycle comes together under one roof. While the technical challenges are significant, our culture remains down-to-earth and approachable. You will work with people who take ownership, support one another, and continuously strive for improvement. 

 

Seriously you? 

We are looking for people who are energized by complex technology and are motivated by challenging work. People who take initiative, share ideas, and enjoy working together to make things better every day. If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you!

The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination.

n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.

Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:

  • Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders

  • Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects

  • Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation


That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register.

We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.

AI is now part of almost every workflow built on n8n. But before a new user can build their first AI automation, they often hit a wall: sign up with a model provider, create an API key, add billing, and paste credentials into n8n. Many people never get past that step.

The Relay team removes that wall. With Gateway credits, n8n Cloud users get leading AI models and services such as web search, scraping and document parsing built in, with no keys to manage. A new user can open a template or ask the AI assistant to build something, and it just works on day one.

Make day-one success the default

  • Own the Gateway credits experience end to end: from sign-up to first successful AI workflow or Agent, to ongoing usage.

  • Remove credential friction across the product. Work with the Growth, Agents and n8n Assistant teams so new users land on services that work out of the box.

  • Decide which models and services we offer, and how we price and package them for users..

Build and run provider partnerships

  • Own relationships with model and tool providers, from first conversation to signed deal.

  • Lead commercial negotiations, including volume commitments, pricing and terms.

  • Partner with Finance on commitment approvals and consumption forecasting.

  • Decide when to add, expand or drop a provider, based on user demand, quality and cost.

Shape the enterprise AI gateway

  • Lead discovery with enterprise customers and prospects: platform teams, IT and security leads, and AI owners.

  • Turn what you learn into a clear product strategy, and be honest about what to build, what to pause and what to stop.

  • Define the core capabilities: virtual keys, budgets and spend limits, model access policies, usage reporting and audit.

  • Consider how the gateway works for self-hosted and Cloud customers. Work closely with engineering and our Cloud team on deployment questions.

  • Help define how the enterprise gateway is packaged and sold, together with Sales, Finance and leadership.

Lead across teams

  • Work with a dedicated engineering team, and with design, as one product team.

  • Coordinate with teams that own nearby areas, such as identity and access management, governance, billing and the Cloud experience.

  • Keep leadership, Sales and Customer Success informed, and bring them clear recommendations.

REQUIREMENTS

Must-haves

  • Experience as a PM for AI infrastructure, developer platforms or LLM tooling (for example AI gateways, model APIs, or AI platform products), or for enterprise admin and governance products (for example access control, policy, spend management or audit).

  • Hands-on experience with partner or vendor deals: you have negotiated terms, not only managed relationships.

  • A strong grasp of usage-based pricing, unit costs and consumption forecasting.

  • Comfort talking with enterprise buyers: platform engineers, security teams and IT leaders.

  • Builder mindset: You’re entrepreneurial and hands-on, and you enjoy moving from an ambiguous problem to a prototype, shipped product, and iteration quickly.

  • Technical fluency: You’re comfortable reasoning about APIs, integrations, authentication, schemas, data flows, and system constraints and can partner deeply with engineers.

  • Data fluency: You can define meaningful success metrics, investigate product behaviour and funnels, and combine quantitative evidence with qualitative insight and product intuition

Nice-to-haves

  • You have built or run an LLM gateway or proxy, or worked closely with tools like LiteLLM, Portkey or similar.

  • You’ve built products for technical users and understand what great developer and builder experiences look like.

  • You’ve worked on products involving third-party APIs, authentication, developer platforms, or integration ecosystems.

  • You’ve built products alongside developer communities, contributors, or external ecosystems.

Why join us?

At n8n, you’ll work on the heart of the product experience - shaping how builders go from an idea to a workflow they trust in production. Your work will influence some of the most fundamental parts of n8n: how people build, connect services, access powerful capabilities, understand what’s happening in their workflows, and scale from simple automation to complex AI-powered systems.

You’ll join n8n at a stage where the product and company are scaling rapidly, but there is still enormous opportunity to define what a world-class automation building experience should feel like. You’ll have the autonomy to identify important problems, work deeply with users and technical teams, and turn ambitious ideas into product experiences people rely on every day.

Sound like a challenge you’re excited to take on?

CreatorIQ is the operating system for creator-led growth trusted by more than 1,300 global brands and agencies.

We’re on a mission to make businesses more human, and humans more impactful. We operate by our values — be intentional, pursue excellence every day, embrace the journey together, and be a good human — every day. CreatorIQ has earned the title of best companies to work for in multiple programs, including BuiltIn LA and NY. It’s been named a Fastest-Growing Company in North America on the Deloitte Technology Fast 500™ for four years, was named a leader in IDC MarketScape: Worldwide Influencer Marketing Platforms for Large Enterprises in 2025, was named a Leader by The Forrester New Wave™: Influencer Marketing Solutions, and has been consistently recognized by G2 as a Leader, and is rated 5 stars on Influencer MarketingHub. We operate in a flexible work model that combines both in-person and remote work to boost collaboration, enhance innovation, and adapt to individual work styles.

We're seeking passionate, innovative minds to join our journey. Be a part of our dynamic team and let's transform the industry together!

Product Manager, Messaging

We’re looking for a Product Manager who wants to own how brands actually talk to creators at scale. This role owns CreatorIQ’s messaging product: the unified inbox and composer that creator marketing teams live in every day, the sending infrastructure underneath it, and the automation and agentic layer we’re building on top. Messaging is where creator relationships are won or lost, and the opportunity is to let AI do the work a manager currently does one message at a time, on infrastructure that can actually carry it.

If you love turning a messy, high-volume communication problem into workflows that marketers trust — and you have the taste to tell when AI-drafted outreach genuinely sounds like the brand versus when it’s impressive-looking slop a creator will ignore — you’ll fit right in. We’re growing fast, building in an evolving AI and agentic landscape, and working with teams around the world who care about doing great work without the ego.

In this role, you'll get to:

  • Take real ownership of the creator messaging experience end to end — inbox, composer, threads, templates — iterating from messy problem to shipped feature. You’ll measure, learn, and do it again.

  • Own the agentic layer of messaging: outreach that drafts itself, sequences that adapt, and automations a marketer can trust to run without watching. You’ll decide what the agent does on its own, what it proposes, and where a human has to sign off.

  • Shape how brand voice and comms style become real product primitives, so automated messaging sounds like the customer instead of like a template — and have the backbone to cut scope when the output isn’t there yet.

  • Partner with engineering on the sending infrastructure all of this rests on: flexible mailbox connectivity (Gmail, Outlook, SMTP, IMAP/POP), isolated per-customer sending environments, dedicated domains and reputation, tracking, and volume throttling.

  • Make deliverability a product feature rather than a support ticket — authentication setup a non-technical user can actually complete, domain warm-up, bounce and unsubscribe handling, and clear in-product answers when a message doesn’t send.

  • Run discovery with real users — creator marketing managers, agency teams, program ops — and turn their workflows, volumes, and frustrations into clear requirements.

  • Look beyond the backlog. Spot opportunities across the messaging and marketing agent roadmap, challenge assumptions, and help shape where the product goes next — including channels past email, like SMS, WhatsApp, and platform DMs.

Who you are and what you'll need for this position:

  • You’ve spent 4+ years in product management (or equivalent technical product ownership) in B2B SaaS — titles matter less than the work.

  • You have a builder’s mindset. You prototype. You’d rather put a rough working thing in front of someone this week than write a document about it for three, and you use AI tools to build that thing yourself.

  • You have genuinely good product taste, specifically for AI output: you can look at generated copy, a prototype, or an agent’s behavior and tell whether it’s good, and you can articulate why.

  • You either understand email deliverability — SPF/DKIM/DMARC, domain and IP reputation, warm-up, bounce and complaint handling — or you’ll go deep on it fast.

  • You’re comfortable with how modern AI features work in practice: prompting, context, evaluation, confidence, human-in-the-loop review, and where an agent should and shouldn’t be allowed to act alone.

  • You’re technical enough to hold your own on infrastructure conversations — APIs, data models, queues, third-party integrations — and to recognize when a “small” request is actually touching something big.

  • You can map workflows fast, write clear requirements, and explain your thinking without needing a meeting to do it.

  • You’re curious, self-driven, low-ego, and allergic to “that’s not my job.”

  • Comfortable working with distributed teams. Most work is async and flexible, but occasionally we’ll ask for a later call.

Nice to have:

  • Experience shipping email or messaging software — marketing automation, sales engagement, CRM, or an ESP.

  • Familiarity with AWS SES or comparable sending infrastructure, and with mailbox integrations (Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, SMTP/IMAP).

  • Experience with responsive email HTML, template systems, or WYSIWYG editors.

  • Experience with SMS/MMS, WhatsApp Business, or social DM integrations, including the consent and compliance requirements that come with them.

  • Familiarity with customer-facing APIs, webhooks, or enterprise integrations.

  • Experience with influencer marketing, creator workflows, or martech.

Excited about this opportunity? Passionate about what we do at CreatorIQ? Please apply! CreatorIQ is a place where everyone can grow.

  • Comprehensive perks program providing stipends for cell phone and internet, home office setup, mental wellness, professional development and tuition reimbursement, plus occasional company-funded meal opportunities throughout the year.

Compensation, benefits, and beyond:

  • Ability to communicate complex ideas using a clear, user friendly format

  • A real ‘do-er’ and builder - someone who loves being hands-on and getting things done

  • Happy to travel to client site (City of London) as needed

Benefits

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
Hi, I'm Maria, Interim VP Product at FeedbackFruits. 👋

FeedbackFruits is moving from a founder-led company to a product-led one, which means Product is taking on a much bigger role in deciding what we build and why. Before stepping into this role I worked as a PM here myself, with the squads and within the details, so I know how much depends on the PMs who work with those squads every day. I'm building a team of PMs who care about the craft: who do the discovery before committing to a build, make clear calls about priorities, and follow their work through to how teachers end up using it.

I'm looking for a Product Manager to lead one of our squads and own how teachers go from setting up their first activity to making FeedbackFruits part of how they teach every week. That means helping instructors see which students are stuck while there's still time to step in, making grading faster and less painful, and making it easy for a great activity to travel from one teacher to the next across an institution. You'll decide what the squad works on and why, and you'll have the room to set that direction yourself.

The EdTech market is tough right now, so every product decision has to earn its place. I like working this way, because a PM with sharp judgment sees their impact fast. You’ll also help shape how product works here as we raise the bar together: how we find the right problems, make calls and bring people along, and what great looks like for the PMs who join after you.

What you'll do:

  • Own the product strategy and roadmap for your squad, and keep its work tied to what matters most to us right now: teachers getting value from FeedbackFruits early and coming back for more

  • Run discovery with teachers, institutions and partners, dig into the data, and frame each problem clearly before anyone starts designing a solution

  • Make the prioritisation calls, including the "not now"s, and explain them with enough context that people follow your reasoning even when they'd have chosen differently

  • Work side by side with engineers on technical approach and feasibility, and with designers on critiques and validating solutions with users

  • Write specs and acceptance criteria clear enough that the squad can move without waiting on you, then review what gets built and keep iterating

  • Define MVPs that get something useful into teachers' hands quickly, and after launch, look at the results and decide whether to scale it, rework it or retire it

  • Keep Sales, Partner Success and leadership aligned by documenting decisions, presenting strategy and progress, and keeping the roadmap visible

  • Help the squad see how its work lands with teachers and students, and make time to celebrate the wins

What you bring:

  • You spot opportunities before anyone asks for them, and you'd rather spend an extra day understanding a problem than a month building the wrong solution

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager | Integrations & AI Foundations (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
bunch is building the backbone of private markets. We are enabling next-gen fund operations with one integrated system that combines secure data infrastructure, AI-powered workflows and expert fund services. If you value ownership, growth through real responsibility, and working with a thoughtful, ambitious team, this role might be for you.

Your Role

As Senior Product Manager for Integrations & AI Foundations, you're the product owner for bunch's integration and AI platform. You have two kinds of customers: external developers and fund-manager teams connecting to bunch, and the internal product teams building on top of what this team provides.

Integrations & AI Foundations is a new platform squad. It owns the infrastructure that lets data move securely between bunch and other systems, and lets every other product team build AI capabilities — extraction, retrieval, agents and evaluations — without each one solving the same hard problems again.

The team covers five connected areas:

  • Integrations / API layer — API contracts, authentication, versioning and deprecation, rate limits, uptime and SLA, and a Developer Portal

  • MCP layer — agent-callable tools built as thin wrappers over the same API contracts, including a customer-facing MCP offering

  • Document Parsing — a reusable ingestion, decomposition and extraction pipeline, with human-in-the-loop review and accuracy monitoring

  • Retrieval / RAG — chunking, embedding, vector store and retrieval, with access control enforced on every query, offered as a callable service

  • AI Agentic Layer — the agent framework, memory, guardrails, evaluation harness, observability and agent registry other teams use to ship their own agents

Document extraction, agent workflows, evaluations and multi-provider model fallback under EU data residency are already in production.

Fund managers don't want to retype data that already lives in their own systems, and they want to pull their bunch data into their own tools and their own AI. Customers and prospects ask for APIs, CRM and accounting syncs, automated exports of capital accounts, and MCP access.

You'll turn those signals into a coherent platform: one that customers integrate with, and that our own product teams build on, instead of a string of one-off builds.

You will:

  • Set platform strategy and sequencing across the five areas: decide how to slice the work and what ships first

  • Run APIs as a product: contracts, versioning and deprecation policy, rate limits, SLAs, Developer Portal and documentation, and time-to-integrate as a measure you actively drive down

  • Define and launch the customer-facing MCP offering: which capabilities get exposed, tool descriptions that agents actually invoke correctly, and a security review gate for anything customers touch

  • Generalise document parsing: the first use case is already live; your goal will be to take it over and generalise it so more teams can reuse its logic

  • Shape retrieval and the agentic layer as services other teams consume, with access control, guardrails, evaluations and observability built in rather than bolted on

  • Draw and hold ownership lines with domain teams. When a request doesn't map to a named responsibility, run the scoping conversation rather than absorbing it

  • Own platform-wide policy with Engineering and Security: data classification and residency, LLM cost and rate governance, and an integration and extraction registry so nothing gets built twice

  • Work directly with customers — fund managers, CFOs and their technical teams — and with Customer Success to understand integration needs, then turn them into platform decisions

  • Define success through goals and key results and clear metrics per area: API uptime and SLA, time-to-integrate, MCP adoption, extraction accuracy, and reuse across teams.

What success looks like

In your first 90 days

  • Resolve and document the MCP audience, governance model, and hand-off point between platform and domain teams

  • Agree a plan and timeline for moving extraction from the existing team onto the shared pipeline

  • Define a sequenced first slice, with baseline metrics for each area

In your first year

  • A versioned public API and Developer Portal that customers integrate with

  • A customer-facing MCP offering live

  • Multiple domain teams extracting from their documents on the shared pipeline, shipping an agent on the agentic layer, without having to run a separate vector store or having to rebuild extraction from scratch

About you

  • 6+ years in product management, with at least 3 on platform, API or developer-facing products in B2B SaaS

  • You've shipped and run public APIs: REST or GraphQL, OAuth and other authentication patterns, versioning, deprecation, and docs developers actually like

  • Hands-on experience shipping LLM features to production, whether extraction, RAG or agents. You understand evaluations, confidence scoring, failure modes and human-in-the-loop review, and can hold your own with Applied AI engineers on chunking, embeddings and model fallback

  • Working knowledge of MCP or agent tool-use, and a clear view on what makes a tool safe and reliable for an agent to call

  • Strong instincts for security and compliance with regulated data: access control, GDPR and data residency

  • You lead through influence. You're comfortable with internal teams as customers and can say no, or not us, clearly and with reasons

  • You write clearly and document decisions so others can build on them

Nice to have

  • Fintech, fund administration or private markets experience: capital calls, capital accounts, subscription documents, LP and portfolio reporting

  • Experience in an EU-regulated environment

  • You've built a Developer Portal or a partner integrations programme from zero

  • You've moved a capability out of one team and into a shared platform without breaking either side

  • Experience in a company moving from ops-led to product-led

Workplace & Benefits

  • Customizable benefits package (wellbeing, sport, mobility, food, and more)

  • 28 days of vacation, plus 2 company days and local public holidays

  • Remote-flexible hybrid (3 days/week in office)

  • Up to 6 remote calendar weeks a year

  • A great tech and work setup

  • Work with a diverse team of 120+ bunchies from 40+ countries, with leaders who are best-in-class in their domains

Hiring process

  1. First interview with the People team (30 min) – Get acquainted with bunch and explore alignment

  2. Hiring Manager Interview with the VP of Product (60 min) – Discuss the role, your experience and your goals

  3. Case Interview with Product & Design (60 min) – Demonstrate how you think, work and communicate, based on a small case shared beforehand

  4. Final meetings with key stakeholders (3 x 30 min) – Learn more about the vision and discuss open questions

Curious to learn more?

Get a feel for who we are, how we work, and what we’re building:

  • About bunch – Our mission, product, and journey so far

  • Case Studies – About those who already build on bunch

  • Gathering insights – Our latest bunch of blog posts

  • Glossary – Explore commonly used private market terms


About bunch

bunch is building the operating infrastructure for the next generation of private markets. We combine AI-powered automation with deep regulatory expertise to replace fragmented spreadsheets and manual processes with one integrated platform across the fund lifecycle, purpose-built for private markets heading toward $32 trillion in Assets Under Management.

We've 4x our ARR in 2025, crossed 150 fund managers and 12,000 LPs on the platform, and just closed our $35M Series B in May 2026. We're looking for ambitious people who want real ownership of hard problems, and who care about building infrastructure that actually matters to the people using it.

jobs.title: Senior Product Designer
jobs.description:
Do you think in journeys, not just screens? Can you see where a learner gets stuck, where a buyer needs proof of value, and where an upgrade feels like a natural next step rather than a sales pitch? And do you want to be the person who sets the design direction for a whole product, not one corner of it?

AIHR is looking for a Senior Product Designer to be the sole designer on our product team. You'll shape our learning platform end to end: how HR professionals discover content and keep learning, how teams see the value of learning, and how our design system helps everyone build consistently and fast. You'll work across both product squads as a hands-on designer and the team’s go-to for design advice.

About AIHR

Founded in 2016 with the mission to future-proof HR, the Academy to Innovate HR (AIHR) has become the world’s market leader in online training for human resources (HR) professionals. We have a global customer base spread across 140+ countries, amongst which companies like Unilever, Reckitt, Goldman Sachs, Philips, Deloitte, Nike, Heineken, and UBS. It is our goal to continuously upskill and empower 1,000,000 HR Professionals.

We are an international team of 100+ people, driven by excellence, innovation, and a hunger to grow in everything we do. As such, we strive to provide the world’s best courses and excellent support to our customers while continuously optimizing every aspect of our work. With over 30 nationalities, our team is diverse, yet we all share a few traits: we're friendly, enthusiastic, and great team players.

Being a fast-growing company, working at AIHR means taking on a lot of responsibility and getting countless opportunities to develop yourself in new areas and potential to craft your own role.


Why a designer now

We built the AIHR Academy for individual HR professionals who choose to learn on their own. That focus got us here. Now we're at a pivotal point: we're taking the full learning experience, our internal expertise and our content into the B2B market.

That shift opens the platform to new personas with different needs. A learner whose employer provides their license comes in with different motivations than someone who paid for themselves. And a manager or buyer needs to see team progress, skill gaps and return on investment before they renew. Much of today's experience wasn't designed with them in mind.

Role and Responsibilities

As our Senior Product Designer, you own the user experience across the AIHR Academy, from how learners discover content to how buyers decide whether to renew. You represent the user in every product conversation and help the team make better decisions, faster.

You report to the Head of Product and work daily with our Learner Experience and Manager Experience Squads, their Product Managers, front-end engineers and our Learning Consultants. PMs already prototype with AI tools, and you’ll help them do that well within the guardrails you set.

Journeys and engagement

  • Map and design end-to-end journeys for each persona, from first visit to long-term learning habit.

  • Shape how learners discover content and keep coming back. You know which engagement mechanics, like progress, milestones and social learning, suit busy professionals and which feel gimmicky.

  • Propose ideas quickly, test them pragmatically and learn from the data.

Growth surfaces

  • Design the moments where members and B2B customers upgrade and renew, as part of the wider journey rather than as standalone funnels.

  • Tread the line between commercial goals and product quality. You know when an upgrade moment helps someone see more value and when it costs trust, and you bring a clear way of making that call that the team can learn from.

Craft and UI ownership

  • You don't stop at concepts. You turn decisions into clear, high-fidelity work in Figma, so engineers can build with confidence.

  • During implementation, you're the go-to partner for front-end engineers and co-own the UI with them. You bring the cases and the fidelity, they bring the constraints and the shipping, and you resolve gaps together until what's live matches the intent.

Design system and enablement

  • Own our design system. You keep it up to date, audit it regularly across the product and turn what you find into your own improvement ideas and a prioritized plan.

  • Set the bar and the guardrails that others build within. You raise the standard of the whole system, not just individual screens, and make it easy for others to prototype with.

How you work

jobs.title: Enterprise AI Product Owner
jobs.description:
About Legal 500

Legal 500 is a global legal market research, data and intelligence business. Our research helps corporate clients make informed decisions about legal representation and gives law firms insight into their market position, performance, and clients.

Beyond research, we’re building a growing data, benchmarking, market-intelligence and subscription service offering. We bring the legal market together through a global programme of events - awards ceremonies, conferences and roundtables that convene leading law firms, in-house teams and their advisers. And through Legal Business, our journalistic title, we deliver independent news, analysis and commentary on the business of law and the strategy, performance and leadership of the world’s leading law firms.

We are a growing, multi-site organisation, with colleagues working across research, data, technology, product, journalism, commercial and events in London, Leeds and Bristol.

About the Role

Our new Enterprise AI Product Owner will own the adoption and value of AI in how Legal 500 works. You'll use our enterprise AI tools, with Microsoft Copilot and the wider Microsoft 365 AI capability as the main platform. You'll recommend what should be built or adopted and why, put governance in place where none yet exists, and make sure people across the business use the tools well.

This is a business-facing product role that starts from how the business works, not a technical build role. Copilot is the primary tool of choice, but you'll also oversee the other AI tools the business adopts.

What you'll do

You'll sit centrally within our People & Business Operations function, reporting to the Director of People & Business Operations. Your remit covers the whole of Legal 500, not a single department. You'll:

  • Own the roadmap and prioritised backlog for our enterprise AI opportunities, recommending what to build or adopt, what not to, and why. You'll write clear user stories and acceptance criteria and hold a consistent line with senior stakeholders when demand exceeds capacity.

  • Start every opportunity from the end-to-end business process. You'll walk business owners through how work gets done today, often where no SOPs exist, map the pain points, coach them through mapping a future-state process, and find where Copilot, other AI tools or workflow changes will make a measurable difference.

  • Personally configure, test and refine Copilot skills, agents and team workflows. You'll take ideas through proof of concept and pilot, then hand ownership of the output to the business owner.

  • Design, implement and enforce AI governance from the ground up. This includes owning the intake and review process for new use cases, agents and workflows, working alongside our Data Protection Officer, Information Security and IT Operations

  • Own our enterprise AI libraries: the register of approved tools and the libraries of approved agents, prompts, templates and shared workflows. You'll keep them curated, current and compliant, and avoid duplication between tools.

  • Design and deliver upskilling yourself, including training sessions, guides, clinics and self-serve resources. You'll also lead AI working groups and champion networks.

  • Spot common patterns across teams and bring them together on shared processes and solutions, so the same problem isn't solved many times.

  • Define and track adoption and value, such as usage, time saved, quality and user confidence. You'll maintain an AI benefits register, report progress to senior stakeholders and feed role impact into workforce planning.

What we're looking for

Essential

  • A process-led consulting approach, with a structured way of walking business owners through end-to-end processes, including where no SOPs existed

  • Proven experience of setting up AI governance from scratch and enforcing it. This includes owning an intake and review process and working with specialists such as a Data Protection Officer and IT Operations

  • Hands-on Microsoft Copilot experience: you've personally configured Copilot skills, agents or team workflows. Using Copilot, or overseeing someone else configuring it, isn't enough

  • Strong product management skills: setting priorities, writing user stories, running a backlog and managing senior stakeholders well

  • Experience of owning enterprise libraries or other centralised controls

  • Experience of running enablement yourself: you've designed and delivered upskilling personally, without relying on an L&D team, and you're comfortable leading working groups

Desirable

  • A genuine interest in enterprise efficiency and how people actually work, with a track record of bringing teams together on shared ways of working

  • A background in internal transformation, process improvement or Microsoft 365/Copilot SME roles, ideally including evaluating, onboarding or governing other enterprise AI tools

  • An understanding of professional services, publishing, legal markets or other knowledge-intensive environments

What this role isn't

  • It isn't about owning AI models in production, and working with development teams isn't the main job. There will be occasional technical work, but if you're mainly motivated by software delivery, this probably isn't the role for you

  • It isn't about running governance within someone else's framework, or handing enablement off to an L&D team. We need someone who has set these up and delivered them personally

Role information:

  • Hybrid workplace - 3 days a week in office, 2 days remote

  • This role can be based in either London or Leeds

  • Occasional travel to the other offices may be required (Bristol, London and Leeds)

What you bring

Nice to have

jobs.title: Electrical Engineer II
jobs.description:
Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

Please submit your application in English

🐙 Kraken Generation Flex

The energy industry is undergoing the largest transformation since industrialisation, at an unprecedented rate of change and we are positioning ourselves at the heart of it. In Germany, home to the largest electricity market in Europe and a roadmap toward Net Zero by 2045, we are scaling rapidly to integrate Distributed Energy Resources (DERs) into the grid.

Kraken is recognised as a thought leader and innovator. We are building a SaaS business that digitally connects hundreds of thousands of DERs with energy markets. As we expand our footprint in Germany and the wider European market, we are looking for an Electrical Engineer to help turn customer sites into market-connected, controllable assets.

🏠 Where you’ll fit in and role summary

As we enter a stage of rapid commercialisation and customer growth in Germany, we are looking for an Electrical Engineer to support the delivery of our site integrations and grow into owning them, learning the full lifecycle from the early information stage through design, deployment and testing.

You’ll work closely with our engineering team based in Manchester as we look to expand our engineering and operations in Germany and across Europe. Together, the team takes an integration project from the very early information stage, designs how it will be integrated into Kraken’s platform and then turns that design into a live, controllable, market-participating asset.

The Gateway (Kraken’s IoT Edge Hardware & Software) and other connectivity technologies with their protocol engineering are owned by our UK-based team, who will support you in becoming configuration literate. Over time you will carry out configuration, deployments and testing for sites yourself, and feed back what you learn about hardware, connectivity and grid operator requirements for European countries so the wider team can build on it.

Engineering delivery is an innovative and engineering-focused team with a culture that fosters collaboration and fresh thinking to create a new energy system. Alongside design, deployment and testing, they constantly look into ways to improve efficiency through tooling and the automation of repetitive tasks. They collaborate daily with delivery managers and customer success to onboard new sites as well as support the existing ones.

🚀 What you'll own

  • Integration design contribution: With guidance, analyse provided information and contribute to hardware and software integration approaches for German sites, mainly BESS (grid-scale and C&I) and RES (Wind and Solar). When necessary, exchange information with customer technical representatives in German and English through meetings and emails, and take part in design discussions with other team members.

  • Market access & prequalification support: Support the technical work needed for assets to enter ancillary-service markets (FCR, aFRR, mFRR) and to meet Redispatch 3.0 requirements. With guidance from senior engineers, help prepare the telemetry and control evidence for prequalification (Präqualifikation) with the relevant TSO. (Grid-code and plant-compliance obligations such as VDE-AR-N 4110/4120 remain with the plant/PPC; our focus is enabling market access, telemetry and dispatch.)

  • Technical judgement: Develop your technical judgement, making well-reasoned decisions and trade-offs with support from senior engineers, and contributing technical input to discussions within the team.

  • Developing domain knowledge: Build up your knowledge in one or more technical areas. This could include German grid connection rules and TSO-specific requirements, ancillary services, Redispatch 3.0, industrial communication protocols, industrial networking, internet of things, cyber security and so on.

  • Gateway application & configuration: Learn how the Gateway software (developed by an internal software team) works and how it is configured. Understand the requirements for an integration and judge if the Gateway software is able to support it or will need new development work. The team will help you get Gateway configuration literate and you will carry out deployments and changes independently over time.

  • Hardware and software deployments: Learn the process of our hardware and software deployments. Over time, take ownership of the configuration, deployment and testing of sites with guidance from the senior engineers.

  • Networking and cyber security: Contribute to hardware and network connectivity designs, keeping our own cyber security posture in mind as well as addressing the concerns from customers, with the support of the internal security team.

  • Hardware handling & dispatch: Berlin is planned as our stock base for our hardware going out to sites across Europe, so the role includes some hands-on work. This covers preparing units before they ship, such as flashing and configuring our industrial PCs and running pre-shipment tests, and helping to prepare and coordinate shipments.

  • Site testing & commissioning: Carry out site testing and commissioning, initially with the support of the team and building toward doing this independently as onboarding demand in Germany and other parts of Europe grows. Hardware is deployed remotely in most cases via O&Ms and third parties, but occasional hands-on support in Germany may be needed before or after a deployment.

  • Incidents & support: Help address engineering help requests from other teams and support incident response in the case of issues at existing sites.

🧠 What you'll bring to the party

  • Language: Native or professional fluency in German and English, needed for technical documentation and for working with customers, grid operators and our UK-based team.

  • Understanding of the German connection landscape: Working knowledge of the TSO/DSO hierarchy, the connection/integration process, and the technical connection rules (such as VDE-AR-N 4110/4120) a grid-connected asset must meet before it can participate in the energy markets.

  • Understanding of the German energy markets: Working understanding of the German ancillary services (FCR, aFRR, mFRR), what prequalification involves, and the Redispatch 3.0 framework.

  • Technical judgement: Sound technical judgement and a structured approach to problems, working with the team to agree and implement a solution.

  • Power plant systems: Ability to read and analyse single line diagrams for a given power plant to understand the site architecture for the points of metering and control instrumentation.

  • Asset integration: Exposure to, or a keen interest in, integrating BESS (grid-scale and/or C&I) and/or RES (Wind and Solar) for telemetry and control.

  • Integration design: Ability to contribute to clear integration designs and design documentation.

  • Hardware and networking: Familiarity with control systems deployments and their connectivity including the local networking and cyber security aspects, and an ability to help debug site connectivity and networking issues (including 4G routers and firewalls) with support.

  • Hands-on hardware preparation: Comfortable working at the bench with our panels and industrial PCs. This includes safely powering panels up and down using our test setup, flashing operating system images, and following a set procedure for pre-shipment checks. Full training is provided.

  • Industrial communication protocols: Practical experience or a good working knowledge of Modbus (TCP/RTU); awareness of one or more of IEC 60870-5-104, IEC 61400-25, OPC-UA or DNP3 is a plus.

  • CAD, diagrams and tools: Experience or familiarity with CAD tools such as AutoCAD or BricsCAD, Miro and Notion.

  • Communication: A clear communicator who documents their work (e.g. in design docs and Notion) and collaborates well with a team that is partly based in another country.

  • Commissioning landscape: Awareness of the other parties involved in site commissioning for power plants, their roles and responsibilities, and how we work with them.

  • Engineering background: Bachelor's in Electrical Engineering, Automation/Control, Software, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience in industrial/energy integration.

  • A proactive and collaborative mindset: You are eager to learn and grow, reliable and collaborative. You take initiative, communicate openly, raise risks early, and care about safe working. You welcome feedback, support your teammates, and steadily build toward taking on more independent ownership of integrations over time.

  • Location and travel: Ideally based close to Kraken’s Berlin office. Willingness to travel to customers and sites in Germany, and occasionally to our Manchester team, although travel is kept to a minimum. Awareness of site safety is required as we may work with site personnel even though we are remote.

⭐️ Bonus points

  • Wider knowledge of German grid compliance (VDE-AR-N 4110/4120, TSO-specific technical requirements) and where the Kraken system fits in.

  • Experience with AWS IoT Greengrass or similar edge-deployment architectures.

  • Familiarity with software/scripting and templating (e.g. Python, Rust, the Linux command line) and Git-based workflows.

  • Understanding of IT/OT security in the energy sector (NIS2, EnWG/KRITIS awareness; IEC 62443 a plus).

  • Exposure to the wider European balancing markets / ENTSO-E frameworks beyond Germany.
