jobs.title: Director Go-to-Market and Revenue Strategy
jobs.description:
Who We Are

You've ordered dinner through Just Eat Takeaway. You've bought and sold on OLX. You've paid with PayU. Chances are, you've already used a Prosus company today.

We are Prosus, a global technology company powering some of the world's leading lifestyle ecommerce businesses. Every day, billions of people across India, Latin America, Europe and beyond use our products and services to buy, sell, pay, connect and discover.

Our AI-driven ecosystem spans 100+ companies across ecommerce, food delivery, fintech and experiences, serving billions of consumers worldwide. AI powers how we operate and innovate, with more than 60,000 active AI agents helping our teams build, scale and move faster. Through our investment team, we also back the founders and technologies shaping the future: From robotics and autonomous systems to synthetic biology and frontier AI.

Guided by our five values Innovation, Results, People, Impact, and Entrepreneurship, culture is our competitive advantage. We thrive with experimentation; we build, we test, we learn, we iterate.

Join us in shaping the future of technology at global scale.

WHO YOU ARE

You are a commercial leader who has built the go-to-market of a platform from a blank page and knows what it takes to turn a product that people already use into a business that pays for itself. You have priced and packaged products for marketplaces, brands or merchants, and you have seen the difference between a model that looks good in a spreadsheet and one that a small business owner actually adopts.

You are comfortable in a B2B2C world: the customer is reached through someone else's channel, the data belongs to the ecosystem, and the money comes from several ends of a transaction at once. You influence without authority, because the teams that execute will rarely report to you. You are rigorous with numbers and plain with people, and you are at ease saying what the evidence shows even when the room expects something else.

You want to build something that reaches millions of small businesses, you are prepared to work for it.

THE OPPORTUNITY

Toqan for Partners is the AI assistant for the merchants across the companies of the Prosus ecosystem: restaurants, pharmacies, hotels, sellers, real estate agencies and car dealers, five million businesses in total. It launched to restaurants on iFood in Brazil in September 2026 and reached 65,000 restaurants in four weeks with no media spend.

The next twelve months decide how it will become a business: which applications partners pay for and at what price, how value is shared with everyone the partner transacts with, how the uplift is measured and published so the next company embeds, and how the product travels from iFood to the rest of the ecosystem and to India and Europe. You will lead that work, as the owner of the go-to-market and the revenue strategy of Toqan for Partners, alongside the product and technology leads who own what gets built.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Own the commercial model

Define pricing and packaging for the applications partners pay for, media management, supply, finance and operations, at a fraction of what they spend today and justified by the return they see. Design how Toqan takes part in the value it creates for the other end: take rate on agent-negotiated supply, credit origination, brand and industry media, and cross-sell of the ecosystem companies' own products. Set the rules that keep it honest, starting with the separation between paid placement and recommendation.

Drive the rollout across the ecosystem

With the Head of Operations, secure the commitment of each business in the ecosystem: sponsor, distribution, conditional yes and first market. Run the rollout inside each one, working through the teams that own the merchant relationship, and bring the product to its next verticals and markets.

Build the measurement

Own the scoreboard: active partners under a strict definition, uplift per business in retention and GMV, cost and value per active partner. Make the uplift the argument that brings the next company in and the evidence behind every pricing decision.

Structure the partnerships that carry the revenue

Lead the commercial agreements with distributors, industry, fintechs and the ecosystem companies' commercial platforms, from first conversation to signed terms, and the co-investment models that align their incentives with the partner's.

Build and lead the team

Hire and develop a small go-to-market and revenue team, growth on the merchant side, monetisation and analytics, and set its standard for rigour, ownership and candour.

WHAT YOU BRING

  • Ten or more years in go-to-market, revenue or commercial strategy, with at least one commercial function built from scratch and grown to scale.

  • Hands-on experience with pricing and packaging, ideally for marketplaces, retail media, payments or SaaS sold to small businesses.

  • Experience on more than one side of a marketplace: merchants or sellers, brands or suppliers, the platform itself.

  • A track record of adoption at scale with a long tail of small customers, not only of large enterprise deals.

  • Proven ability to move a result through teams that do not report to you, and to work inside another company's channel.

  • Fluency with data: you build the business case, run the analysis and read the uplift yourself, and use AI tooling as a normal part of how you work.

  • Candour, humility and patience: you say what the numbers say, you arrive to learn before you teach.

  • English required; Portuguese or Spanish strongly preferred.

WHAT WE OFFER

  • Global impact: a product that reaches five million small businesses across Latin America, Europe and India.

  • Ownership: the commercial model of a new business, with the numbers to be judged on and the autonomy to build it.

  • Growth: exposure to the leadership of the group and of its companies, and a clear path into operating roles in the ecosystem.

  • Competitive compensation and the Prosus benefits package for the location of the role.

Why Prosus?

At Prosus, your colleagues include 60,000 AI agents… and your job is to figure out what that actually means. We're one of the largest operators of agentic AI on the planet, inside a $100B+ portfolio across 100+ companies and two billion people. The humans here own what AI can't do alone: judgment, creativity, and the call on what gets built next.

Own the impact. Work the ecosystem. Earn your growth. Build with backing.

Curious about our perks and benefits? Take a look at this page.

Our Diversity & Inclusion Commitment

We respect the dignity and human rights of individuals and communities wherever we operate in the world. Building an inclusive workplace where everyone feels welcome and can thrive is critical for us. We provide access to education, which helps everyone understand the important role they play and the positive impact they can have.

Want to know more about life at Prosus? Explore our culture and values.

jobs.title: Data Center Warehouse Specialist
Full Stack Engineer
jobs.description:
We are a growing SaaS start-up with an international team, operating on the intersection between two of the world's most fascinating industries - global shipping and global travel.

Over 90% of global trade depends on ships, and the shipping industry depends on the 2 million seafarers who operate them. What most people don't know is there's a complex, mission-critical travel operation going on 24/7 to bring seafarers to the ships where they're needed, when they're needed. That's called crew logistics, and without it, global trade wouldn't function.

But it's an operation often built on manual processes and legacy systems, meaning high-stress for operators, an unreliable experience for seafarers, and poor outcomes for the industry. That is until Tilla enters the scene.

Backed by strong investor support, with more than 10,000 crew changes executed in the platform each year across over 600 vessels globally, our platform is a game changer in crew logistics, streamlining collaboration between operators and seafarers, making crew operations more humane, efficient, and cost-effective.

Join us on the next chapter of our growth journey and tackle this overlooked yet critical global challenge: every crew change, optimized and digital.

Your mission

Build and maintain the Travel services that get seafarers onto the right flights, shipping well-tested features across our TypeScript stack as part of the Travel team. You'll start by taking pressure off the team by solving bugs, serving customer requests and leading investigations, and progress into owning Travel services of your own.

✈️ Keeping travel operations dependable / by resolving bugs and customer requests quickly and properly

  • Investigating and fixing bugs across the Travel services, reproducing each scenario before changing any code

  • Handling day-to-day technical requests from customers and colleagues, and explaining what went wrong in plain terms

  • Adding logging and metrics to what you build, and following runbooks when alerts fire

🧭 Unlocking the product roadmap / by shipping well-defined features end to end

  • Building features across the frontend (React, Next.js) and backend (NestJS, GraphQL, Prisma) in Linear sprints

  • Breaking work into clear steps, surfacing assumptions early, getting feedback on technical decisions and keeping progress and blockers visible

  • Writing unit and integration tests, and acting on code review feedback

📈 Building depth in a sensitive domain / by growing into ownership of Travel services

  • Learning how flight bookings, fares and travel aggregation work, and how they connect to crew changes

  • Taking ownership of a Travel service module over time, including its uptime, bug rates and resolution times

  • Sharing what you learn through clear pull request descriptions and team documentation


You should have

  • Experience: early-career professional experience as a software engineer, building web applications across both frontend and backend.

  • Experience: working knowledge of TypeScript and React, and some exposure to Node.js backends. Familiarity with any of Next.js, NestJS, GraphQL, Prisma, Apollo Client, React Query, ShadCN, AWS (Lambda, SQS, RDS, ECS), Jest or Playwright is useful; we don't expect all of it.

  • Experience: exposure to GDS systems (like Amadeus) or travel aggregator platforms is a plus.

  • A high degree of ownership: you take a task from ticket to production and see it through.

  • Sound engineering fundamentals: readable code, sensible tests, and systematic debugging.

  • Technical depth and curiosity: you want to understand how the wider system works, not only the part in front of you.

  • A genuine interest in travel and flight booking, and a willingness to learn the industry in depth.

  • The ability to explain technical issues simply to customers and non-technical colleagues.

  • Clear, proactive communication about progress, risks and blockers.

  • A collaborative approach: you work well with other engineers, ask for help when it's the quicker route, and act on feedback.

  • Experience or interest in early-stage or growth-stage startups.

  • Fluency in English. Other languages are a plus.

  • Based in EMEA or LATAM, with good working-hours overlap with the rest of the Travel team.

Why Join Us?

  • Tackle a unique industry challenge with global impact

  • Be part of an international, mission-oriented, supportive and fun team

  • Do your best work, with leading-edge AI tools for all team members

  • Benefit from support and budget for your learning and development

We believe that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success at Tilla. We make hiring decisions based on your experience and skills. Therefore, we welcome applications from all members of society, regardless of age, gender, disability, sexual orientation, race, religion or belief.

Senior QA Engineer - POS Hardware (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
ABOUT US
 
Unzer is a leading European fintech company with a mission to simplify international payments for e-commerce and retail businesses. Our brand was formed from 13 companies that now contribute to building a unique product covering the entire payment flow.  
 
At Unzer, we are driven by the belief that customers should enjoy a seamless shopping experience, no matter where they choose to shop. We are a team of over 700 experts of 55 different nationalities, dedicated to creating a state-of-the-art unified commerce platform. Our goal is to enable businesses to delight their customers with a seamless payment experience.  
 
Whether you're a tech enthusiast, payment expert, or a dedicated support professional, we are looking for individuals who are passionate about making a difference.  
 
Our offices: We are based across Austria, Denmark, Germany and Luxembourg with a HQ in Berlin.
 
ABOUT THE TEAM
 
As a QA Engineer, you will play a key role in supporting the quality assurance of both hardware and software Point of Sales – POS products. You will work closely with multiple systems for merchant onboarding and management, test API integrations, and ensure the successful deployment of new features. You will collaborate with developers and various teams, provide documentation, user support, and training, and contribute to continuous improvement in product quality and team communication. At the same time, you will have the opportunity to work on exciting key account projects in order to integrate the best possible Unzer product solution.

What your work will look like:
  • Test and validate new payment terminal hardware and software releases.
  • Collaborate on systems used for merchant onboarding and master data management.
  • Test API integrations with Network Service Providers (NSPs), requiring familiarity with JSON.
  • Write clear documentation and user manuals for new features.
  • Use JIRA for issue tracking and basic project management tasks.
  • Use Confluence for knowledge sharing and documentation.
  • Employ tools like Opensearch, Postman, and basic SQL for testing and data review.
  • Leverage basic background in cash register systems for relevant QA tasks.
  • Communicate effectively with cross-functional and developer teams.
  • Support and resolve requests from other teams regarding features, products or systems.
  • Analyze special tasks and provide QA insights and recommendations.
  • Deliver presentations and training sessions about new features and product solutions to internal teams.
  • Work in both English and German (proficiency in both is preferred).

    • What you need to be successful in this role:
  • Experience or strong interest in QA/testing of software and hardware.
  • Basic understanding of programming concepts; experience with JSON is a plus.
  • Basic knowledge of Opensearch, Postman, and SQL.
  • Experience with JIRA and Confluence is an advantage.
  • Good written and verbal communication skills; ability to explain technical topics to non-technical audiences.
  • Strong documentation skills and attention to detail.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
  • Fluency in both English and German 
  • Team player with a proactive and analytical mindset.
  • Previous experience with payment terminals, APIs, or cash register systems is a plus.
    •  Please note that we will not sponsor your visa or relocation, and you must have a valid work permit to be eligible for this position. 

    What’s next?
  • Does it sound exciting? -  Apply with your CV in English. Please don’t shy away if you don’t meet all the requirements! We’re looking forward to meeting you.  
  • We will get back to you within 14 days of receiving your application.   
  • The interview process includes a 30-minute intro call with a TA Partner, a 60- minute call with the hiring manager, 60min skills assessment and a 30min final call. Please note the process might alter depending on our team’s availability. 

    • WHAT WE OFFER 

    More than a workplace. A place to grow. 🌍 

    At Unzer, colleagues from 50+ nationalities across four countries work together to create better outcomes for our merchants. We take ownership, move with pace and keep raising the bar—as one team. 

    We set high expectations and give you the flexibility, learning opportunities and practical support to do your best work, grow your impact, and build a sustainable career. 

    🏡 Flexibility that works 
    Combine focused time at home with connection and collaboration in the office. Our hybrid setup includes two office days per week. 

    🚲 Your commute, your choice 
    Choose the mobility benefit that works for you: bike leasing or a Deutschlandticket.  

    🏖️ Work from anywhere in the EU 
    Change your perspective and work from another EU country for up to 15 days per year. 

    📗 Keep raising the bar 
    Use an annual learning budget of €1,000 for courses, conferences, certifications and other development opportunities that help you grow and increase your impact.  

    🫴 Support when you need it 
    Access confidential counselling whenever you need support with personal or professional matters. 

    💰 Build your future 
    Look ahead with our company pension scheme and take care of your long-term financial wellbeing. 

     

    Benefits may vary by location and employment setup. Your recruiter will share the details relevant to your role. 

     
     
    *Unzer is an equal employment opportunities workplace, and we commit to hiring regardless of race, sex, gender identification, sexual orientation, national origin, native language, religion, age, disability, marital status, citizenship, genetic information, pregnancy, or any other characteristic protected by law. Please refrain from including your picture and age with the application.

jobs.title: Founding EMEA Account Executive - German-Speaking  (Switzerland)
Tech Lead (C# .NET - SaaS & Low-Code), €5.500 - €7.000 | Zoetermeer
jobs.description:
Ben jij een ervaren ontwikkelaar en leider die graag de technische richting bepaalt én zelf aan de knoppen zit? Als Tech Lead bouw jij samen met het team van ontwikkelaars aan schaalbare cloudoplossingen waarmee dagelijks honderden organisaties slimmer en efficiënter werken. Jij bent een technisch zwaargewicht die de kwaliteit, performance en toekomstbestendigheid van onze moderne SaaS-architectuur bewaakt. Je gaat over de technische beslissingen rondom ons eigen low-code platform en bent dé kartrekker van de groep. Jouw keuzes hebben directe impact op techniek, product én de toekomst van digitale documentverwerking.

Jij maakt het mogelijk

Onze groei vraagt om robuuste, veilige en altijd beschikbare services. Als Tech Lead merk je direct waar risico’s ontstaan: complexiteit loopt op, schaalbaarheid komt in gevaar en technische schuld vraagt om leiderschap. Jij stuurt bij vóórdat klanten het merken. Met moderne cloud-technologie, duurzame oplossingen en hoge codekwaliteit maak jij samen met het team het verschil, niet alleen vandaag, maar juist voor de toekomst.

Je kijkt verder vooruit dan de volgende release en je durft jezelf en het team uit te dagen. Daarnaast coach je de ontwikkelaars uit het team technisch en neem je initiatief om onze producten verder te brengen. Je bent de kartrekker van de groep, en schakelt laagdrempelig met onze product owners, engineering manager en andere development teams.

Concreet betekent dit dat jij:

+ Leiding neemt over het low-code platform ontwikkelteam;

+ Samen met dit team ontwikkelt aan ons low-code platform, op basis van wensen vanuit de operatie én technische eisen voor future-proofing;

+ Als senior de codekwaliteit verhoogt door coaching, code-reviews en kennisdeling;

+ Actief meebouwt aan architectuurkeuzes, coding standards en automatisering in uitrol;

+ Kwaliteit borgt via tests, monitoring en goede documentatie;

+ Continu zoekt naar verbeteringen m.b.t. schaalbaarheid, stabiliteit, performance, security;

+ Samen met collega’s zoals ontwikkelaars, product owners en engineering managers spart over oplossingsrichtingen;

+ Wanneer nodig onze collega’s van consultancy en support helpt om complexe problemen met ons low-code platform op te lossen;

+ Verantwoordelijkheid neemt voor een aantal bestaande maatwerkprojecten en indien nodig niet terugdeinst voor een nieuwe maatwerk opdracht.

Hoe jouw werkweek eruitziet

Op maandag spar je met de teamleden en zorg je ervoor dat iedereen weet waar ze aan moeten werken, en dat ze daar ook verder mee kunnen. Je pakt zelf een wijziging op die vraagt om een nieuwe schaalbare service en je denkt direct mee over architectuur en security-impact. Later in de week review je code van collega’s en help je een medior op weg met een complexe async-workflow. Je overlegt met onze product owners en engineering manager en zorgt ervoor dat het team op één lijn zitten en weten wat er speelt. Tussendoor onderzoek je nieuwe technische mogelijkheden en voer je verbeteringen door waarmee klanten nóg fijner met onze software kunnen werken. Je werkt hybride en vindt zo de ideale balans tussen focus en samenwerking.

"Bij Whitevision hebben we meer dan 20 jaar aan rijke software-ontwikkeling achter ons liggen. Wat begon als een flexibele oplossing, is uitgegroeid tot een essentieel platform met integraties in diverse ERP-systemen. Onze groei van de afgelopen jaren laat zich onder andere zien in de ontwikkeling van een moderne React-frontend en de start van migraties naar Azure Functions, die we verder willen doorontwikkelen. Daarnaast richten we ons op onderhoudbaarheid, internationalisering en integraties met nieuwe bedrijven zoals Inconto. Ons platform, gebouwd in C#.NET, wordt continu doorontwikkeld door een groeiend team. Als Tech Lead krijg je de kans om niet alleen het technische hart van ons product verder vorm te geven, maar ook strategisch mee te denken over de toekomst van ons platform en onze producten. Met jouw visie en leiderschap help je onze software klaar te maken voor de volgende 20 jaar." - Serge Settels (Lead Software Developer).



Jij hebt het

+ Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring als Back-end Developer, waarvan een deel in een Lead of minstens Senior rol;

+ Coaching-ervaring en de drive om technisch leiderschap te tonen;

+ Uitgebreide kennis van C#, .NET (Core), Databases en REST API’s;

+ Ervaring met complexe SaaS-architecturen;

+ Ervaring met MS SQL Databases, en performance tuning/troubleshooting op DB niveau;

+ Kennis van infrastructuur-principes en voldoende begrip van front-end aspecten om goed samen te werken en te beoordelen;

+ Ervaring met FluentMigrator, Aspose, en algemene testautomatisering is een pré;

+ Ervaring met low-code is een pré.

Ook breng je mee:

+ Analytisch vermogen: je doorgrondt complexe datastromen en neemt onderbouwde besluiten voor schaalbaarheid en security;

+ Communicatieve samenwerking: je zorgt voor een sterke verbinding binnen het multidisciplinaire team;

+ Eigenaarschap: je houdt overzicht, anticipeert op risico’s en neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor het eindresultaat;

+ Een proactieve houding: je neemt initiatief, en zorgt ervoor dat benodigde informatie actief opgehaald wordt zodat projecten vlot doorlopen.


Onze Whitevision manier van werken is met respect, daadkracht, betrokkenheid en ambitie.

Deze kernwaarden passen dan ook uitstekend bij jouw persoonlijkheid.



Dit verdien jij
+ Een salaris waar je blij van wordt, €5.500 - €7.000 o.b.v. 40 uur, 8% vakantiegeld, 25 vakantiedagen en de mogelijkheid om 5 extra dagen te kopen (o.b.v. 40 uur) en flexibele werktijden.

+ Een mooi kantoor in Zoetermeer. We bieden ook de mogelijkheid om ook twee dagen per week thuis te werken, maar veel van onze collega’s vinden het zo leuk om op kantoor te werken dat zij dit minimaal doen.

+ Wij investeren graag in de groei en ontwikkeling van onze collega’s door middel van training of opleiding.

+ Een gezellig team met kantoren in Zoetermeer, de Goorn, Rotterdam en Breda. We werken hard, maar lachen minstens zo veel met elkaar!

+ Onderdeel worden van een snelgroeiend SaaS-bedrijf in Breda met de missie om repeterend werk de wereld uit te helpen.

Solliciteer direct!

If you’ve already heard about us, you’re probably reading this because you’re tired of the typical, chaotic ways of doing things in construction. But in case you haven’t, we’re a high-end project management consultancy and tech developer with a focus on upgrading the way construction projects are delivered.
 
Improving construction strengthens the very foundation of human civilisation. (Check out our short film about it.)
We bring transparency and control to projects through a pragmatic mix of the latest tech, our own processes, and a big dose of common sense. We then take our deep understanding of these projects and we invest heavily into developing the digital solutions that anyone can use to deliver their projects better. (Check out Shape, our construction management tech, to see what we’re doing.)
 
The core of all this is our true secret sauce: our people. We only recruit the very best, both in capability and personality. We’re deeply focused on designing a new type of organisation that’s optimised for the flourishing of the people in the team first and foremost. People who join us develop fast as a whole person in ways they never imagined. (Read more about our vision and missions.)
 
This approach has allowed us to grow from just two people in 2017 to over 220 today. We have a stable, repeat client base across infrastructure and complex building projects in the UK and internationally, and we’re still growing fast. Joining us isn’t just some “job”. It’s a transformative educational experience. We challenge you to be your best self in all aspects of life. There are many diverse and interesting challenges available. It’s up to you to guide yourself into whichever areas you’re most interested – we’ll enable it. 
 
(Get to know us better by watching a few more of our videos.)
 
Core values for a good life
 
A life of human flourishing is all about meaningful relationships and challenging yourself to create a positive impact, so our values reflect the four levels of relationships that each of us has:
 
- Grow yourself – your relationship with yourself 
- Care about people – your relationship with others around you 
- Execute to greatness – your relationship with your team 
- Build civilisation – your relationship with humanity and the world 
 
We enshrined our values in our vision:
 
We exist so that everyone in our team can flourish in a high-impact community that:
 
- Connects us with meaningful relationships 
- Inspires us to develop ourselves to become better humans 
- Empowers us to pursue our own learning adventures 
 
By first doing this, we can achieve the highest levels of value for the world.
 
And enable the achievement of our vision through our two missions:
 
- To fully digitalise the construction of human civilisation 
- To create a new type of organisation that enables human flourishing while delivering a huge positive impact on society
_____________________________________________________________________ 
The Role 
 
Purpose of the role
 
You will be enhancing the delivery of the most complex and interesting projects in the world through the power of project controls. You will be a senior leader in our team pushing the discipline to new heights not only within Laminar but within the industry in general. 
 
Your team
 
This role is part of our Project Management Consultancy which focuses on: 
- Understanding what the real problems of projects are.  
- Implementing the best solutions to those problems.  
- Developing scalable best practices, tools and technology. 
 
More specifically you will be part of our Project Controls Discipline Team who are industry leaders in the planning and controls of complex construction projects. Your initial leader will be one of our project controls discipline directors. 
 
Your top three objectives:
 
1. To make construction projects deliver to near perfection 
2. To develop yourself and everyone around you 
3. To create scalable and repeatable solutions to common problems 
 
Your top five responsibilities:
 
1. Own the controls: Own the controls for cost, schedule, change and risk on one or more projects to enable accurate decisions for project teams 
2. Develop everyone: Maximise the development of your team personally and professionally and educate our clients to improve as well 
3. Make scalable solutions: Develop scalable and repeatable best practices and tools in collaboration with the team so that long-term impact is achieved 
4. Report and inform: Provide simple actionable reports to stakeholders at all levels that help them deliver their part of the project more efficiently and effectively 
5. Own the outcome: You may not be the project manager ultimately responsible for the results but you are sure as heck responsible for putting in your best effort to ensure the project’s understanding and focus on the plan no matter how stubborn they are! 
 
You must have:
 
- A construction engineering background: You have solid capability in the control of cost, schedule, and change, along with deep experience in developing project controls processes and reporting that align with strategic objectives and broader project context.
- Communication skills: You have the charisma, presence, and influence to engage construction teams, drive adoption of new approaches, and promote best practices across the board.
- Leadership capabilities: You’re a proven leader, coach, and developer of teams, capable of guiding others and building high-performing planning and controls functions.
- Impact: You have a strong track record of implementing scalable, repeatable solutions that created significant positive impact across complex projects.
 
Laminar isn’t the place for you if any of the following is true: 
 
- You want an easy, chilled-out role without much challenge 
- You like to be the smartest person in the room 
- You don’t like continuously receiving honest candid feedback 
- You prefer to do your own thing rather than work with a team 
_____________________________________________________________________ 
Frequently Asked Questions 
 
What kinds of projects would I be working on?
It’s common for people to be exposed to several projects in their first year with us. You’ll work on some of the most complex and interesting environments in the world. We’ve delivered over 100 data centres internationally, many of them fast-tracked and multi-package. Our teams have supported flagship infrastructure programmes like HS2 through integrated planning and digital delivery, contributed to over $30bn in power generation and transmission projects, and played a key role in the development of high-containment labs and R&D campuses for some of the world’s most advanced industrial and life sciences clients. You might find yourself working in sectors such as data centres, infrastructure (including defense, rail, and highways), high tech (such as advanced manufacturing, pharmaceuticals, and semiconductors), or complex building projects. These aren’t hands-off assignments. They’re dynamic, hands-on environments designed for people who want to be challenged. We bring back the lessons from every project to help our team grow and deliver the highest levels of value. (Check out our case stories.) 
 
Who are our clients?
Major owners/operators and main contractors with project values between £1m and £1bn+ globally. 
 
Where would I be working?
One week you might be working from home. The next, you might travel to the site to meet the construction teams and help organise them. Maybe you’ll pop into our London office for a workshop or a beer. Maybe you’ll fly out to exotic (and sometimes not!) locations in Europe or the Middle East to visit clients. It really depends on what you want to get involved in and what fits with your life. 
 
How does what I do connect with the long-term impact on the construction industry? 
You’re tasked with understanding and solving common problems. We don’t want to reinvent the wheel every time, so you’ll be responsible for documenting new solutions and evolving ones we’ve developed. This goes into our knowledge repository, which we’re going to open source to the industry. 
 
The knowledge you capture will be used by us to build new products. You’ll constantly test those products in the field, so we can rapidly iterate and improve them for anyone in the industry to use. 
____________________________________________________________
Benefits
 
The standard stuff: 
 
- Health Insurance Scheme. Comprehensive private health coverage – for you and your family. Because your well-being is our priority 
- Pension Scheme. A competitive plan to help you plan for the long term – plus salary sacrifice options available to maximise your savings 
- Bonus Scheme. As a permanent member of the team, you’ll share in our success. Our annual bonus is designed to reward both the now and the future – with a flexible mix of cash and high-growth equity that you choose. Bonuses are discretionary and based on performance 
- Professional body membership. One fee covered per year – so you can stay connected to your field and develop your craft 
- Cycle to Work Scheme. A tax-efficient way to get wheels – and do your bit for the environment 
 
The life-changing stuff:
 
- In-house coaching. Regular 1:1 coaching sessions, fully confidential, to help you navigate challenges, build self-awareness, and grow intentionally – professionally and as a human being
- Equity upside. As we grow, you grow. Our generous equity scheme is especially powerful for those who stay with us on our journey. You help us build the future – and own a piece of it
- Flexible working. Work where it makes sense – most of our team works from home, visiting sites or clients regularly. We care about outcomes, not clock-ins
- Relentless development. Our goal is for every year here to be worth five years of development anywhere else. You’ll get a coach, a mentor, honest feedback, and a culture that challenges you to keep levelling up
____________________________________________________________
Important! Applying properly
 
We get thousands of applications so please write us a letter as part of your application explaining:
 
- Why you want to join us 
- What you’ll bring to the team 
 
We aren't a giant, faceless corporation; we really care about the people who want to join our team, so your letter will be read carefully. After that, we’ll reach out to you to schedule a casual conversation to help you get to know us a bit better and tell us a bit about yourself. A couple of technical and personal assessments follow to understand your capability based on our own development matrix.  
 
This is to ensure that when you join, you’re starting at the right level of responsibility.

jobs.title: Senior LCA Engineer
jobs.description:
👷🏻‍♀️ What we do 👷🏻‍♀️

At Emidat, we are building the first climate-native product management system for building material manufacturers.

Emidat aims to decarbonise building materials, making up 11% of global GHG emissions. We collect data from physical production processes, generate a digital product passport with verified environmental data and make it usable along the value chain. In short: One solution to assess, design, buy, sell and manage products - with environmental impact at the core.

Embodied carbon is emitted on day zero and can never be reduced later, while global floor area is set to double by 2060. From January 2026, EU regulation (CPR) requires verified environmental data. 430,000 manufacturers will need it, and only about 2,500 have it today. That gap is our market.

Find out more about us, the team and our values here.

What you will work on

Your mission

Your core mission is to turn LCA methodology into software that works at scale. You own the full chain from methodological question to working software solution and take ownership of the team's most complex methodological and technical challenges. You make sure each new product category, market and verification takes less time and effort, working with high autonomy and high accountability.

As an early senior member of a fast-growing climate-tech company, your career trajectory is entirely in your hands. This role offers unparalleled visibility and growth. You can deepen your expertise as a technical expert in the team, or leverage your domain knowledge to pivot into high-impact roles across Customer Success, Sales, or Product. Exceptional early joiners are primed for future Team Lead and leadership positions.

In the first 6 months, you will

  • Lead strategic projects: Take full ownership of complex, ambiguous projects such as new markets, program operators or complex product categories. Define requirements, navigate trade-offs, delegate across the team and drive delivery.

  • Shape the product core: Work closely with our software engineers to translate environmental science and ISO/EN standards into clean, scalable software requirements, and propose complete implementation strategies for whole concepts, not individual features.

  • Scale our LCA work: Reduce the time and effort for recurring work such as tool verifications, new product category implementations and matching, through automation, reusable standards and better processes. Turn verifier feedback into requirements that solve the issue for good.

  • Scale tool verifications: Work with program operators and verifiers to establish processes that make tool verifications faster, more predictable and repeatable across markets and product categories.

  • Set the standard: Define what clear requirements and architecturally sound solutions look like, and take ownership of refining our methodologies for PCFs, LCAs and EPDs.

  • Improve how we work: Identify problems others don't see, turn them into actionable proposals, and solve recurring problems at the root instead of case by case.

  • Grow the team: Mentor junior colleagues and give them regular, actionable feedback.

  • Shape the industry: Help establish Emidat as a thought leader in LCA, e.g. by representing us in ECO Platform working groups and in the committees that author PCRs.

What you will bring to this role

Minimum requirements

  • Extensive LCA expertise: You bring deep expertise and experience conducting Life Cycle Assessments, LCA calculation methodology, PCRs and ecoinvent/matching logic. You showcase ownership of complex, ambiguous methodological or technical challenges.

  • Mastery of standards and regulation: You have comprehensive knowledge of the key LCA / EPD standards and program operator requirements (i.e ISO 14040/14044 and EN 15804+A2). You interpret these standards rigorously, and evaluate sources critically.

  • From methodology to software: You have experience working with automated software solutions for LCA/EPD generation, with proven ability to translate regulatory and methodological logic into technical requirements. You bring a product mindset: you prioritise, scope and communicate requirements clearly.

  • Verification and customer experience: You have created multiple EPDs that were successfully verified and published with a European program operator (e.g. EPD Global, EPD International, IBU). You have worked directly with customers, ideally in a consulting environment, and can represent methodological positions confidently towards customers and verifiers.

  • Leadership and project management: You have a track record of leading large projects end-to-end: scoping, planning, delegating, coaching others and keeping quality high. You manage several projects at the same time and coordinate multiple internal and external stakeholders.

  • Language: Business fluent in English (C1+).

Nice to have’s

  • Education: Bachelors, Masters Degree or PhD in a relevant subject, i.e Sustainable Energy Systems, Architecture, Urban Planning, Engineering (Environmental, Chemical, Mechanical, Electrical) etc.

  • Languages: Proficiency in German, or any other of the following European languages (French, Italian, Dutch, a Nordic language).

  • Verifier: Qualification as a verifier for EPDs acc. to EN 15804+A2

  • Engineering partnership: Experience completing partnering with software engineers to develop implementation strategies.

  • AI-enabled way of working: You are experienced in leveraging AI tools to accelerate your work, e.g. for research, requirements and documentation.

  • Tool Verifications: You have experience with EPD tool verifications.

  • Industry: Experience working on Construction products, or familiarity with the latest regulatory developments affecting the construction industry (e.g. EU Taxonomy, national and regional regulations) and can assess their impact on methodology and product.

How we support you

Your manager / team lead will be

  • Benedikt Team Lead, LCA and Product Manager

You will work closely with

  • Florian (CTO & Co-Founder)

  • Anna (LCA Expert)

  • Areeba (LCA Expert)

  • Elahe (LCA Expert)

  • Jonas (LCA Expert)

  • Marzooka (LCA Expert)

  • Tom (Tech Lead, Engineering)

  • Fabio (Software Engineer)

  • Kacper (Software Engineer)

  • Andrea (Software Engineer)

  • Timon (Customer Success)

Meet the rest of the team HERE.

See our full benefits HERE, including:

  • 💸 Attractive compensation package including VSOP (for FTEs)

  • 🏖️ 25 days of vacation days per year

  • 📚 €2,000 Learning Budget

Admin

  • Role type: Full-Time

  • Location: Munich, Germany.

  • Office: Office based.

  • Visa / Relocation: Preference will be given to candidates already based in Munich and that do not require a visa.

Compensation: €90K – €100K • €5K – €10K Equity • Equity over 4 years

jobs.title: RevOps with Salesforce experience - France (all genders)
jobs.description:
Chez Shiftmove, nous construisons la prochaine génération de produits de mobilité connectée qui permettent aux entreprises de prendre des décisions plus intelligentes et basées sur les données. Notre objectif est de rendre les opérations complexes intuitives et efficaces, en transformant les insights en actions à fort impact pour des milliers de clients B2B à travers l'Europe. Rejoignez notre équipe RevOps en pleine croissance !

Nous recherchons un Administrateur Salesforce expérimenté avec une solide expertise en CPQ pour soutenir et optimiser notre environnement Salesforce au sein d'une organisation SaaS en forte croissance. Ce poste se situe à l'intersection des Ventes, des Opérations de Revenus, de la Finance et du Succès Client, en veillant à ce que Salesforce soutienne la manière dont l'entreprise vend et gère réellement ses clients. Le candidat retenu sera opérationnel, proactif et à l'aise pour travailler avec les équipes GTM dans un environnement SaaS à abonnement. Vous devez comprendre le fonctionnement des Account Executives et des Account Managers, et être capable de traduire les processus commerciaux en configurations Salesforce évolutives. Une expérience dans le soutien aux migrations CRM, aux intégrations ou à la consolidation de systèmes lors d'acquisitions sera un atout majeur.

Veuillez noter que certains entretiens se dérouleront en anglais.

Tasks

  • Gouvernance du cycle de vie complet : Piloter l'optimisation de bout en bout de Salesforce CPQ, en traduisant des stratégies commerciales complexes en offres produits sophistiquées, en logiques de tarification et en workflows d'approbation automatisés.
  • Alignement Devis-Encaissement : Garantir que le moteur CPQ reflète fidèlement les structures tarifaires réelles et les processus contractuels, en fluidifiant le parcours du devis initial jusqu'aux données prêtes pour la finance.
  • Conception de systèmes évolutifs : Piloter l'évolution de nos structures de données fondamentales et des automatisations Flow, en veillant à ce que la plateforme soit conçue pour une performance à long terme plutôt que pour des correctifs à court terme.
  • Pilotage des migrations et des fusions-acquisitions : Assurer le rôle de référent technique pour les migrations CRM et les consolidations de systèmes, en maintenant un modèle de données unifié et robuste lors des expansions mondiales et des intégrations d'entités.
  • Conseiller stratégique GTM : Collaborer directement avec les directions Ventes, RevOps et Finance pour traduire les besoins métier de haut niveau en configurations techniques évolutives.
  • Synergie des opérations de revenus : Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes Data et RevOps pour assurer une cohérence optimale des systèmes, en mettant l'accent sur la visibilité du pipeline et sur des reportings fiables sur l'ensemble du cycle de vie client.
  • Intégrité et performance du système : Maintenir des standards élevés en matière de qualité des données et de santé du système, en faisant de la plateforme une « source de vérité » que les équipes GTM adoptent réellement et en laquelle elles ont confiance.
  • Résolution proactive des problèmes : Identifier et éliminer les points de friction au sein de l'écosystème Salesforce, en allant au-delà de la simple maintenance pour porter une démarche d'amélioration continue de la plateforme.

Requirements

  • Approfondie en administration Salesforce, avec un historique démontré dans la gestion d'organisations complexes.
  • Expérience démontrable avec Salesforce CPQ
  • Expérience au sein d'entreprises SaaS B2B ou à modèle d'abonnement
  • Solide compréhension des processus de vente, de la gestion du pipeline et du cycle de vie client
  • Une expérience dans le soutien aux migrations ou intégrations CRM est fortement appréciée
  • Capacité à travailler de manière transversale avec les équipes Ventes, RevOps, Finance et Succès Client
  • Gestion du changement : Expérience dans la conduite d'intégrations ou migrations CRM, idéalement dans un contexte de fusions-acquisitions ou de croissance rapide.
  • Maîtrise des langues : Français (C2), Anglais professionnel courant

Benefits

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

  • Construire des produits à impact réel : Nous résolvons des problèmes complexes du quotidien pour des milliers d'entreprises à travers l'Europe, en remplaçant des opérations de flotte manuelles et fragmentées par des solutions intelligentes et basées sur les données sur lesquelles les gens comptent vraiment.
  • Participer à une aventure porteuse de sens : Nous sommes une scale-up rentable, soutenue par des fonds de Private Equity, avec des fondamentaux solides et une ambition claire (1 million de véhicules d'ici 2027), offrant un mélange rare de stabilité, d'autonomie et de dynamisme.
  • Évoluer dans un environnement véritablement international et collaboratif : Avec plus de 40 nationalités, l'anglais comme langue de travail et des équipes à travers l'Europe, la collaboration et la responsabilité partagée font partie de notre quotidien.
  • Grandir avec autonomie et confiance : Nous investissons massivement dans le produit, la data et les personnes — en vous donnant l'espace pour prendre des responsabilités, contribuer vos idées, challenger les autres et donner le meilleur de vous-même tout en participant à façonner notre croissance.

jobs.description:
Work from anywhere, impact everywhere 

Diversity is at the heart of who we are at Xapo Bank.
We're a fully distributed team of over 160 Xapiens that work remotely from 50+ countries around the world.

Our beginning: A world that enjoys economic freedom and wealth protection,no matter where you live or who is running your country.
To achieve that, we search the world for the best people for the job.
We work hard, think globally, and inspire each other to learn and grow.
We are committed to changing the way things are done.

Although we are headquartered in Gibraltar, this is a full time, 100% remote position 
Work from anywhere!

Position overview

Xapo's product suite has grown from a Bitcoin vault into a full member proposition: BTC and USD accounts that pay interest, a global card with Bitcoin cashback, Bitcoin-backed loans, a growing suite of BTC wealth and credit products, and access to stocks, ETFs, and stablecoins, all inside one regulated relationship. 

Xapo is a bank, and a bank earns on the money its members choose to hold with it. Each of those products shipped well. What hasn't yet existed is a single owner of the economics of the customer relationship: one person accountable for winning the right members, growing what they hold with us, and keeping them, and for the balance-sheet products that make that possible.

The Chief Customer Officer is a new role at the top of the house, reporting to the CEO. You will run the stream that grows what members hold with Xapo, and you will own the Customer P&L, retail and institutional. It brings growth, client coverage, product management, and product design under one leader who is judged on customer contribution, the assets attracted and kept, and the members who stay. This is a customer-focused role in the most commercial sense: what a member earns from us, not the feature we shipped, is the centre of every decision.

The measure of success is a Customer P&L that grows on what members hold and keep: LTV:CAC improving, approved-to-paid rising, churn falling, and customer contribution the business can plan against.

This is a banking role, not a requirements-gathering role, a marketing role, or a role you can run from a dashboard. Products are priced on the balance sheet and judged on the money they attract and keep.

The mandate

  1. Own the Customer P&L, retail and institutional.
    You own customer contribution: customer gross profit from what members' balances earn, secured lending, Bitcoin yield, and conversion, stocks and ETFs, less the cost of winning and keeping members. We earn on what members hold, not on what they tap, send, or click, so you run on assets held and the margin they earn, not payment volume. Good looks like a Customer P&L the Exco and Board can plan against, where every line has a number you own and can explain, up or down.
  2. Grow what members hold with us, through earning products run like a banker would.
    You own the roadmap for the balance-sheet products: deposits and savings, lending and credit, and trading and structured. Each is led by a mission PM who is a banker, owning a product's contribution and its price on the balance sheet, not a backlog. Requirements go through the gate; the economics are the job. Every item is priced by Finance before it is built, on a shared risk appetite with Risk and Treasury. Good looks like products that scale assets held and member lifetime value at a risk profile the Board actually approved.
  3. Win the right members, efficiently.
    You own Growth: audience, lifecycle, and content, with one head accountable for the path from approval to paid. You own CAC and approved-to-paid, find the members who bring other members, and activate them in week one. Every incentive is priced before it runs. Good looks like net paid-member growth that improves every quarter, at a CAC that LTV comfortably justifies, because you diagnosed where the funnel leaks rather than spending more to fill it.
  4. Keep members, and deepen the relationship with the ones who hold balances.
    Retention is the most efficient growth we have. You own churn, and you own Client Coverage: relationship managers who sell the missions' products to the members who hold balances, and loop demand back into the roadmap. You are accountable for net new AUM flow, covered-book retention, and products per covered member, and for growth that is broad-based rather than concentrated in a few accounts. Good looks like falling churn and AUM growth from members who stay and expand rather than members re-acquired at cost.
  5. Make the value of Xapo visible, and the experience effortless.
    You own Product Design: one design system and one shell, so that members see the value of what they are earning clearly and early, and find every task simple. You design the proposition in the stream with Finance and partner with Operations, who run onboarding, KYC, support, cards, and payments, to remove friction at the points that affect members most. Good looks like members who understand their return, complete what they set out to do, and stay.
  6. Build one Customer organisation, not four.
    Growth, Client Coverage, Mission PMs, and Product Design come together under one operating model: one set of key results read weekly from one source, shared frameworks for discovery and prioritisation, and real career paths for the people in it. Engineering is pulled to a single ranked roadmap, and nobody in your line has engineers of their own. Good looks like fewer hand-offs per outcome and a number for every cell that its owner explains every week.
  7. Bring the regulated-bank and crypto-native lens to every customer call.
    You understand that a KYC onboarding decision and an AML monitoring decision carry different risk appetites, that a false positive at the gate is a paid-for member lost, and that a proposition built for a crypto-native power user can still fail a first-time bank customer. You can sit in the same room as a CRO, an MLRO, a CFO, and an engineering lead and make a customer case that survives all four conversations.

How you'll operate

This part matters as much as the mandate. The known failure mode for this role, in any company, is a CCO with a polished customer-insight deck and no ownership of the number. That is disqualifying here.

  • You lead from inside the work. You sit in on growth reviews, mission PM reviews, client meetings, and member calls, not just steering committees. PMs, designers, and relationship managers three levels down know your name because you've solved problems with them.
  • You move people with the business case, not the whip. When a priority needs to change, you diagnose the problem, build the case with data and the economics, and show teams why it matters, so they re-prioritise because they're convinced, not because they were told. Your authority comes from being right and being useful, not from your title.
  • You have extreme ownership. You own the Customer P&L and the member metrics beneath it, not the feature ship date. If a launch didn't move contribution, LTV:CAC, approved-to-paid, or churn, you don't report "the roadmap item shipped", you change the approach.
  • You have genuine gravitas. Senior, experienced leaders welcome your input because you've earned the standing to give it. You can challenge any executive's plan, including the CEO's, constructively, with evidence, and be thanked for it, because your challenge makes their work stronger.
  • You diagnose before you prescribe. You can walk into a leaking funnel, a churning segment, or a product that isn't earning and find the structural cause, then fix the economics, not just the symptom.

What you'll have done 

  • 10+ years in senior commercial or customer leadership (CCO, Chief Growth or Commercial Officer, MD or Head of Retail or Wealth, or equivalent) in digital banking, fintech, or payments, including meaningful time in a regulated environment (banking licence, e-money, or equivalent prudential/conduct regime).
  • Crypto-native credibility: hands-on experience building and growing customer propositions on or around digital assets, custody, on-chain flows, Bitcoin-backed lending, or similar. You don't need Bitcoin explained to you, and you don't need banking explained to you either.
  • Customer P&L ownership: you have owned a customer or product P&L judged on contribution, balances, and margin rather than transaction volume, and you are fluent in NIM, unit economics, customer contribution, and LTV:CAC.
  • Growth and lifecycle: a track record of acquiring, activating, and retaining members in a regulated, KYC-heavy environment, improving approved-to-paid and churn while holding CAC to a level that LTV justifies, not just growth-hacking a free consumer app.
  • Banking-grade product leadership: you have led product management for balance-sheet products such as savings, lending, or structured products, priced with Finance, with PMs who own a product's economics rather than a backlog. Experience with client coverage or relationship-managed models for high-balance and institutional clients is a strong advantage.
  • Commercial and risk fluency: you can build a customer business case that survives scrutiny from Finance, Risk, and Compliance in the same meeting, and you know the difference between growth that's sustainable and growth that's borrowed from tomorrow's risk appetite.
  • A track record of outcomes you can narrate: specific LTV:CAC, approved-to-paid, churn, AUM, or contribution numbers you owned, bets you killed when the data didn't support them, and outcomes you can prove.

 

The first 90 days

Day 30: The Customer P&L baseline is documented across retail and institutional: customer contribution, LTV:CAC, approved-to-paid, churn, net paid-member growth, and assets attracted and kept. You have formed your own independent view of where members are won, lost, and under-served, and shared it with the CEO and Board.
Day 60: The unified Customer operating model is live: one set of key results across Growth, Client Coverage, Mission PMs, and Product Design, read weekly from one source. Every mission PM owns a product's contribution and its price, and the roadmap is ranked on what it earns, built with Finance and the line leads.
Day 90: At least one measurable improvement in LTV:CAC, approved-to-paid, churn, or net new AUM flow is live and attributable to a change you made, not a feature ship, an outcome moved. Every cell in your line has defined key results and an owner who explains the number every week.

What this role is not

  • Not a requirements-gathering role. Mission PMs are bankers who own a product's contribution and price, not a backlog. You partner with Technology, Finance, and Operations on execution; you don't run those functions.
  • Not a volume role. If your primary output is card spend, transfer volume, or a shipped list rather than assets held and the margin they earn, we have both failed.
  • Not a reporting layer. If your primary output is a customer-insight deck or a roadmap deck, we have both failed.
  • Not a role that can be done from a distance. Remote-first means distributed, not detached.

Other requirements

  • A dedicated workspace.
  • A reliable internet connection with the fastest speed possible in your area.
  • Alignment with Our Values and the Xapo Values-Driven Leadership principles.

Why work for Xapo?

Impact Globally, Work Remotely.

  • Shape the Future
    Improve lives through cutting-edge technology, work 100% remotely from anywhere in the world.

  • Great work-life balance
    Build amazing things with a balance of autonomy and collaborative teamwork. Set your own work schedule and make use of a flexible PTO plan when you need to recharge. 

  • Expect Excellence
    Collaborate, learn, and grow with a high-performance team. Learn how you learn best - from books to conferences, you'll get a yearly budget for your individual learning and development goals.

At Xapo, we prioritize consumer protection and adhere to regulatory requirements by ensuring that all Xapiens are accountable for upholding principles of fair treatment, transparency, and ethical conduct in their interactions with customers and stakeholders.

jobs.title: Team Lead - Invoices
jobs.description:
Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous!

Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains.

Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times.

To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies.

BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America.

Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard.

About the role

Invoices is BLP's largest product. Every day, it decides whether a supplier invoice can be posted to the customer's ERP without a human touching it. The invoice team builds and runs that product.

This is a leadership job with three parts that are equally important:

  • Build the team. The team is growing fast and is distributed across Zurich and several European countries. You hire, onboard, and grow engineers, and you develop the subteam leads who will carry more of the line management as we scale.

  • Deliver for our biggest customers. Some of the largest enterprises in Europe are rolling out BLP right now. Their go-lives, automation rates, and escalations land on your desk, and you make sure the team delivers on what we promised.

  • Turn the team into an empowered product team. Today, a lot of work still arrives as requests through proxies. You lead the shift toward a team that owns its problem space, defines outcomes, measures them, and decides what to build.

As Engineering Team Lead for Invoices, you lead the team that owns BLP's invoice product: You own the team's roadmap, delivery, people, and hiring.

This job is for you if you want to lead a strong engineering team through its next phase of growth and own the result.

You report to the Director of Product Engineering and work closely with the other product team leads, product management, and the go-to-market organization (project managers, customer success, and sales). The team is organized in subteams, each with its own lead, and you are the person who keeps them aligned.

What you'll do

Lead and grow the team

  • Run regular 1:1s, ensure growth of the engineers in your team, review progress, and make promotion and ranking decisions together with engineering leadership.

  • Coach and develop subteam leads, and set up the subteam structure as the team grows.

  • Keep a distributed team connected and productive: clear working agreements, transparent planning, and a culture where people raise problems early.

Hire

  • Own hiring for the team end to end: define the profiles, screen candidates, run interviews, review coding challenges, and close offers together with Talent Acquisition.

  • Keep a high bar while hiring at pace (our current target is around two new engineers per month), and make sure every new joiner has an onboarding plan and a buddy.

Own the roadmap and priorities

  • Build the quarterly roadmap and run monthly planning with product owners and product management, prioritizing by customer impact, revenue, and strategic value.

  • Balance enterprise go-lives, automation improvements, platform migration, developer experience, operations, and new products, and say no when something does not move the product forward.

  • Escalate early and clearly when priorities conflict, and communicate decisions to the go-to-market organization.

Deliver for strategic enterprise customers

  • Take responsibility for the engineering side of large enterprise go-lives: requirements engineering, solution design, test and fix cycles, and go-live readiness.

  • Work directly with project managers and, where needed, with customer stakeholders and their IT teams, and give clear, regular engineering updates.

  • Close gaps in the product rather than per customer, so the next enterprise customer arrives on a platform that already handles their case.

What you'll bring

  • You have led an engineering team of 8+ people for at least two years, ideally in B2B SaaS, and you have grown a team through hiring rather than only inheriting one.

  • You have a strong backend engineering background and can still read, review, and discuss production code and system design with senior engineers.

  • You have hired many engineers yourself, you know what a high bar looks like, and you can run a structured interview process.

  • You have delivered complex software for enterprise customers, including demanding go-lives, and you are comfortable in a room with customer stakeholders.

  • You prioritize ruthlessly, communicate trade-offs clearly, and can hold a position with engineers, sales, and executives while keeping the relationship.

  • You develop people: you give direct feedback, set measurable goals, and help engineers grow into leads.

  • You take ownership, surface problems early, ask for help when you are stuck, and hold your team to the same standard.

  • You are fluent in English. German is a strong plus, since many of our customers and colleagues are in the DACH region.

What you'll get

  • A real mandate. You own the invoice team end to end: people, hiring, roadmap, and delivery.

  • Impact you can measure. Automation rates and go-lives on our largest accounts are directly visible to customers and to the business.

  • A strong team. Engineers from serious academic and industry backgrounds who care about doing the work well, with subteam leads already in place.

  • A smooth handover. The current team lead moves into a new role in engineering leadership and stays available to support your start.

  • Room to grow. As a fast-growing, global AI company, BLP keeps creating new leadership opportunities.

jobs.title: Infrastructure Program Manager
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

BY JOINING OUR TEAM YOU’LL GET TO

  • Build the machine that builds the machine. Join TechOps at the forefront of advanced manufacturing, we’re building the production system that will enable commercial fusion. The Production lines, tooling, and processes are being developed from the ground up; you'll create the ways of working, not inherit them.

  • Work at the frontier of manufacturing technology. Bring your creativity to evaluate, qualify, and deploy processes with no industry playbook, every component you build and every process you shape goes directly into the core of the stellarator magnet technology.

  • Do work that matters, and see it grow. The hardware you build is the product and your career grows with it, from prototyping and process development through quality and industrialization, alongside exceptional colleagues from around the world.

  • Make an impact you can point to. In a small, fast-moving team, your calls on equipment, quality, and process directly shape how a world-class deep-tech company produces superconducting magnets with results visible on the shop floor, not buried in a slidedeck.

YOUR IMPACT

You are the bridge between detailed infrastructure planning and the single integrated master schedule that governs Alpha's delivery. Without dedicated infrastructure schedule ownership, dependencies like infrastructure readiness for the magnet factory (drainage, cryo supply, extraction systems) quietly fall behind because nobody owns translating detailed site-level planning into the program-level view leadership actually uses to make decisions. You make sure that never happens by accident.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Own and actively manage all infrastructure and siting project schedules across Alpha and Stellaris - buildings, utilities, permitting milestones, and site readiness

  • Translate infrastructure -specific schedule detail into validated, structured inputs for the Master Scheduler's integrated master schedule, ensuring infrastructure milestones, dependencies, and readiness dates are correctly reflected

  • Identify infrastructure -specific critical path items and interdependencies - for example, infrastructure readiness depending on equipment or magnet-line arrival dates - and flag risks early

  • Partner closely with the Master Scheduler, Risk & Change Manager, and Individual Project Managers (Alpha Construction Project Manager, Site Development Program Manager's team) to keep infrastructure schedules and the integrated timeline in sync

  • Maintain infrastructure milestone governance discipline across all programs, ensuring consistent coding and leveling conventions

  • Support gate-readiness by preparing infrastructure-specific schedule status inputs ahead of release gate decisions

WHO YOU ARE

  • Experienced in managing infrastructure or site development schedules on complex capital programs, ideally spanning multiple sites or projects in parallel

  • Comfortable working with a federated schedule structure - translating detailed infrastructure planning into a broader integrated programme view

  • Strong cross-functional communicator, able to align site project managers and technical teams with the Master Scheduler's baseline

  • Fluent in English; German is a strong advantage given the permitting and contractor landscape]

  • Comfortable operating with high autonomy in a fast-scaling, still-being-built environment

INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Recruiter Interview (30-60 min)

  • Technical Screening (60 min)

  • Technical Panel (2x60 min)

At Proxima Fusion, our mission is bold: making limitless clean energy a reality. To get there, we need a high-performing, diverse team that brings different perspectives, challenges assumptions, and builds together with purpose. We know that diversity of thought and experience leads to better ideas, stronger execution, and a more resilient team. We don’t look at how you identify, what you look like, who you choose to worship or what ethnicity you are. We care about what you can bring to the table.

jobs.description:
As the GTM Engineer - Sales Operations CRM Management (m/w/d), you will own the systems that run sales and marketing across PERGOLUX's global operations, with HubSpot as the single source of truth, Aircall and WhatsApp as the conversation layer, and the integrations that connect them to Shopify, Klaviyo and our data warehouse. You turn business problems into working configuration, automation and integrations across 11+ markets, and you make sure what you build is documented, adopted and measured. Reporting to the Head of Sales Operations, you work daily with Sales Leads in each market, Sales Enablement, Data and Analytics, and the Marketing team.

PERGOLUX designs and sells premium, Scandinavian-inspired outdoor living products, from aluminium pergolas to garden furniture, direct to consumers. We are a company of around 300 people generating 9-figure revenue, operating across 8 markets and growing steadily across Europe and beyond.

What You'll Do

- Administer and evolve our multi-market HubSpot portal: objects, properties, pipelines, lifecycle stages, permissions and teams, plus workflows, lead routing, assignment rules and per-market task queues, while keeping data quality high through deduplication, property governance and regular audits.

- Own Aircall configuration (numbers, IVRs, routing, ring groups, overflow per market) and the Aircall–HubSpot integration, so every call, recording, outcome and AI summary lands on the right record, and support call pick-up SLAs and Conversation Intelligence for coaching and quality programmes.

- Configure and integrate WhatsApp and messaging platforms (Rasayel, Superchat) with HubSpot routing and reporting, and own the Shopify–HubSpot data flow for orders, payments and customers alongside integration partners.

- Connect HubSpot with Klaviyo, Zendesk, GA4 and our Snowflake/Looker warehouse, and build lightweight automations using REST APIs, webhooks, custom code actions and iPaaS tools (Make, Zapier, n8n), including scoping and implementing new GTM and AI tooling with a clear business case.

- Design the MQL to SQL handover with Marketing (lead scoring, routing, SLAs, attribution), map and document the end-to-end customer lifecycle, write clear SOPs, train Sales Leads, reps and outsourced partners, and manage change requests through a Jira backlog.

What You'll Bring

- 3–5+ years in RevOps, Sales Ops, Marketing Ops or GTM engineering, with hands-on HubSpot admin experience in a multi-team or multi-market portal, including deep knowledge of the data model, workflows, lead routing, custom objects, permissions and reporting.

- Practical experience configuring a cloud telephony tool (Aircall preferred) and its CRM integration, plus integration skills across REST APIs, webhooks, JSON and at least one iPaaS tool (Make, Zapier, n8n, Workato).

- Solid data skills: clean data modelling and confidence reconciling numbers across systems, with a track record of working with Marketing on lead management, scoring and attribution.

- The ability to translate messy business needs into simple, documented solutions, and to say no or "not yet" with a clear reason. Fluent English and comfort working with teams across Europe, the US and Australia.

- Nice to have: German, French or Italian; experience with Shopify or e-commerce order data in a CRM; scripting in JavaScript or Python; experience with Klaviyo, Zendesk, WhatsApp Business platforms, Snowflake/Looker, AI agents in a GTM context, or supporting outsourced sales teams. HubSpot certifications are a plus.

💼 Compensation — Competitive salary · Company pension plan · Capped overtime, fully paid

🚀 Growth and Career Development — You take real ownership from the start with direct impact on key business outcomes, and you can fast-track into senior roles as PERGOLUX scales and builds out its GTM systems across new markets.

⏰ Time Off and Flexibility — Up to 30 vacation days, starting at 27 · One week per year remote workation in EU/UK

🌟 Benefits and Lifestyle

- International, collaborative team, working with colleagues across Europe

- Regular team events, including summer party, Christmas party and after-work gatherings, plus retreats

- Modern setup and laptops (Apple or Windows)

- Employee discounts on PERGOLUX products

- Jobrad / Bike leasing program, promoting sustainable and healthy commuting

📍 Office Location – Schlesische Str. 27 C, Building C 6th floor, 10997 Berlin

How to Apply

Send your CV and a short note on a CRM or integration project you are proud of: what the problem was, what you built and what changed. Apply through our [Career Page](https://pergolux.careers/) or connect with us on [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/pergolux/posts/?feedView=all).

PERGOLUX is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, we think it's less about ticking every box and more about what you bring to the table!
