jobs.title: Senior Penetration Tester API, Web & Cloud – 6 Months Contract (all genders)
jobs.description:
Distribusion is the world’s leading ground transportation marketplace and gives travellers seamless access to ground transportation online, from search to ticket purchase. We have built a cutting-edge B2B technology platform that connects bus, rail and ferry operators in 70+ countries with the biggest online retailers including Google Maps and Booking.com.

We are shaping the future of travel and building the largest global network of transport providers and retailers. We are one of the fastest growing startups in travel, backed by leading venture capital investors including TQ Ventures, Lightrock, Creandum, and Northzone, and are headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Following our recent $80m Series C funding, we are ready to push beyond.

We are looking for an experienced Senior Penetration Tester to join us on a 6-month contract, and start as soon as possible. You will run hands-on, authenticated security testing across a real attack surface: public partner-facing booking APIs, payment flows, web and mobile apps used by millions of travellers, and the cloud infrastructure behind them. You’ll plan and run your own testing, work directly with our engineering squads to get findings fixed, and see your impact in production within weeks.

What you will do:

  • Test our partner-facing booking APIs against the OWASP API Security Top 10, with a focus on object- and function-level authorization, tenant isolation, mass assignment, data exposure and rate limiting.

  • Assess API authentication and integrity end to end, including OAuth 2.0/OIDC, API keys, JWTs, webhooks and request signing.

  • Hunt for business-logic abuse in booking, checkout, payment and refund flows, including race conditions and pricing manipulation.

  • Run authenticated tests of traveller-, partner- and operator-facing web and mobile apps following OWASP WSTG and ASVS, including how passenger personal data is stored, shown and exported.

  • Review cloud, Kubernetes and CI/CD configurations and secrets handling for attack paths that could be chained from an application bug.

  • Map and regularly test our internet-facing attack surface.

  • Red-team our AI features (assistants, agents, support bots) against the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications.

  • Write clear, reproducible, risk-rated findings with practical remediation guidance, walk engineers through fixes and verify them with retests.

Workplace:

We are a remote-first company with teams located around the Globe and a HQ in Berlin.



Who you are:

  • You bring 5+ years of hands-on penetration testing, mainly of web applications and APIs, and can point to recent engagements you’ve led end to end.

  • You have deep, practical knowledge of the OWASP API Security Top 10, WSTG and ASVS, including authentication/authorization models (OAuth2/OIDC, JWT), IDOR/BOLA, mass assignment, SSRF, injection and XSS.

  • You have found business-logic and race-condition vulnerabilities in transactional systems such as booking, e-commerce, payments or fintech.

  • You are fluent with Burp Suite Pro (or similar) and write your own scripts and tooling (Python, Go or similar).

  • You are comfortable assessing cloud and container environments (GCP preferred, Kubernetes) and CI/CD pipelines.

  • You work independently: you scope, prioritise, test and report with minimal guidance, and you explain complex risks plainly to engineers and leadership.

  • You are available to start at short notice.

  • Bonus Points: OSCP, OSWE, BSCP or similar certifications; experience red-teaming LLM applications or AI agents; testing in PCI-DSS environments.

What you can expect:

  • You will join a fast-paced travel tech company with a flat organizational structure.

  • You will have exciting opportunities, ownership, and responsibility and contribute directly to the success of the company.

  • You will join an international team of talented and driven people with a clear mission. Expect your colleagues to inspire, support and challenge you every day!

  • We have a flexible work policy with the option of working remotely and international opportunities arising as we continue to expand our global footprint – Our heart is in Berlin, but you’ll find us across the globe.

  • You will get a competitive salary.

Our hiring team for this role:
Your Talent Partner (TP) and point of contact is Lorena Rebenciuc, and the Hiring Manager (HM) is Ilya Isakov.

For any queries, contact your Talent Partner at

Do you want to work on a product that is used by millions of people daily with a high load, availability and scalability, and most advanced technology? Come join us!

jobs.title: Werkstudent Kommunikationsdesign (gn)
jobs.description:
Remmert entwickelt und baut automatisierte Lager- und Intralogistiksysteme für Langgüter, Blech und Werkstücke. Unsere Kunden sind Unternehmen aus der metallverarbeitenden Industrie in ganz Europa. Als familiengeführter Mittelständler mit internationalem Anspruch verbinden wir technische Präzision mit langfristigen Kundenbeziehungen.

Das Projekt:

Unsere Marke ist gewachsen, unsere Produkte und Zielgruppen auch. Jetzt wollen wir das Erscheinungsbild von Remmert gezielt weiterentwickeln. Es geht nicht um einen Neuanfang, sondern darum, das bestehende Corporate Design zu schärfen und zukunftsfähig zu machen. Als Werkstudent Kommunikationsdesign (gn) beschäftigst du dich an unserem Standort in Hüllhorst insbesondere mit diesen drei Ausprägungen:

  • Produkt-Branding: Erarbeitung klarer Gestaltungsregeln unserer Maschinen und Anlagen

  • Corporate Communication: die nach innen und außen gerichtete Unternehmenskommunikation in allen Facetten

  • Marktkommunikation: Weiterentwicklung und Streamlining visueller Kommunikationsmittel wie Anzeigen, Messen und Website

Deine Aufgaben

  • Analyse des bestehenden Markenauftritts über alle Kanäle und Medien hinweg

  • Mitwirkung an der Entwicklung und Umsetzung eines Gestaltungssystems mit gemeinsamem Markenkern und differenzierten Ebenen für Produkt, Unternehmen und Markt

  • Weiterentwicklung des Corporate Design Manuals, inklusive Anwendungsbeispielen und Vorlagen

  • Begleitung der Umsetzung, zum Beispiel bei Print- und Vertriebsunterlagen, Website, Social Media, Messeauftritten und Präsentationen

  • Aktive Mitarbeit an laufenden Marketingprojekten

  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Marketing, Vertrieb, Produktmanagement und Agenturen; Präsentation von Zwischenständen

Deine Qualifikation

  • Laufendes Studium im Bereich Kommunikationsdesign, Grafikdesign, Mediendesign oder vergleichbar, idealerweise im Master

  • Fundierte Kenntnisse in Typografie, Corporate Design und Markenentwicklung

  • Sicherer Umgang mit der Adobe Creative Cloud (InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop); Figma von Vorteil

  • Konzeptionelles Denken und die Fähigkeit, gestalterische Entscheidungen nachvollziehbar zu begründen

  • Interesse an Industrie und Technik: Du hast Lust, eine B2B-Marke im Maschinenbau zu gestalten

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse, gute Englischkenntnisse

  • Verfügbarkeit für mindestens 12 Monate, in der Vorlesungszeit bis zu 20 Stunden pro Woche

Option Masterarbeit

Das Projekt eignet sich als Grundlage für eine Masterarbeit, zum Beispiel zur Markenarchitektur oder zur Differenzierung von Markenebenen im B2B-Umfeld. Die Betreuung stimmen wir gemeinsam mit dir und deiner Hochschule ab.

Benefits

  • Ein echtes Gestaltungsprojekt mit Verantwortung und sichtbarem Ergebnis, das du von der Analyse bis zur Umsetzung begleitest

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten, abgestimmt auf dein Studium, und teilweise mobiles Arbeiten

  • Faire Vergütung

  • Einblicke in eine technisch anspruchsvolle, international tätige Industrie

  • Betriebliches Gesundheitsmanagement

  • Kaffee, Obst und Gemüse zum freien Verzehr

  • Sonderboni wie Mitarbeiter-werben-Mitarbeiter

  • Regelmäßige Mitarbeiterevents (Sommerausflug, Wandertage sowie Weihnachtsfeiern für alle Kollegen und deren Familien)

Du kannst dir vorstellen zum Team Remmert zu gehören?

Dann freue ich mich auf deine Bewerbung mit Portfolio (PDF oder Link). Wenn du die Stelle mit einer Masterarbeit verbinden möchtest, skizziere gerne kurz dein Themeninteresse.

Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
At Klue, We’re Building the Future of Competitive Intelligence

The Customer Success team is hiring 👋

You're the person who walks into an account and immediately sees what matters: the risk no one's named yet, the expansion hiding in plain sight, the champion waiting to be developed. You earn trust fast, ask the right questions, and turn a customer's goals into a plan that actually sticks.

If that sounds like you, keep reading. We'd love to meet you.

As a Customer Success Manager at Klue, you own the full customer relationship, from onboarding through renewal and expansion. You're the connective tissue: keeping every account team aligned, every customer growing, and every risk on the radar before it becomes a problem. Klue's product moves fast. New AI agents, integrations, and capabilities ship continuously. The CSMs who thrive here stay ahead of it, act on signals early, and show up as both a trusted advisor and a confident commercial partner.

Your Mission? To make sure every customer in your book gets real, measurable value from Klue, and grows because of it. You build the relationships, drive the adoption, and close the commercial outcomes. When your customers win, you win.

What's In It for You?

This role puts you at the center of how B2B companies use competitive intelligence to win deals, grow revenue, and own their markets. You'll work across industries and stakeholder levels, build deep customer intuition, and gain hard-won experience running complex change management inside leading organizations. In an AI-first company shipping continuously, your expertise compounds fast. No two years here look the same.

What You'll Do

  • Own Renewals and Expansions. Your book, your number. You forecast it, manage it, and hit it. That means spotting churn signals before anyone else names them, building the business case for expansion, and running cross-sell motions with Sales, including Klue's win-loss interview program. The commercial outcomes are yours.

  • Drive Adoption and Platform Completeness. Klue ships fast. Your job is to make sure every customer keeps up: AI agents running, integrations live, Curators and Consumers actually using the platform. You stay current on what's new and make it land, translating product velocity into conversations your customers care about.

  • Map Outcomes and Demonstrate ROI. You connect Klue to what your customers actually care about: win rate, rep confidence, PMM efficiency. You quantify it, document it, and make it impossible to argue with at renewal time. ROI isn't a slide you build at the end, it's a story you're telling all year.

  • Multi-Thread and Lead Change. Single-threaded accounts are at-risk accounts. You build across levels by default: economic buyers, Champions, Consumers, exec sponsors. You help customers navigate their own organizations and drive adoption through real friction, not around it.

  • Lead the Account Team. You own the account, which means owning the strategy and everyone working inside it. Win-Loss Researchers, PMAs, Sales, AI Solutions. You set the direction. They execute alongside you.

What Success Looks Like

We want you to love the role you're in and believe these are the things that matter most. You'll know you're nailing it when:

  • GRR and expansion targets are met or exceeded for your book every quarter.

  • All eligible customers have their AI agents running: right competitors tracked, right integrations live, platform usage above benchmarks.

  • Upsell and cross-sell opportunities are identified, qualified, and closed at or above target. Win-loss cross-sell pipeline exists and is actively moving for eligible accounts.

  • Every account has at least one documented ROI moment per quarter, tied to a specific Klue outcome.

  • Every account has at least two active contacts at different levels. No single-threaded accounts in your book.

  • Customers are activated on new product capabilities within one quarter of release.

  • Risk is flagged and acted on early, not discovered at renewal.

What You Bring

Must Haves:

  • The experience. track record in a CSM or commercial role with direct revenue accountability. You've owned renewals and expansion targets and hit them.

  • Ownership. ability to lead and coordinate a cross-functional account team without direct authority.

  • Customer facing. Proven success building trust and credibility across a customer organization, from day-to-day champions to executive buyers.

  • Commercial fluency. comfortable with upsell conversations, business-case development, and navigating contract dynamics with confidence.

  • Strong discovery skills. can diagnose a customer's business goals, connect them to Klue's platform outcomes, and make the link explicit and repeatable.

  • Change management instinct. knows how to build internal Champions, navigate complex stakeholder dynamics, and drive adoption against organizational friction.

  • Multi-threading instinct. you build relationships across levels by default, not as a recovery strategy.

  • Signal awareness and speed. proactively identifies risk and opportunity in customer behavior, usage data, and relationship health, and acts fast.

  • Technical curiosity. comfortable learning integrations and AI capabilities, and explaining them clearly to non-technical audiences.

  • AI-fluency. actively uses AI tools in day-to-day work and can model that behavior with customers.

Nice-to-Haves:

  • Experience in competitive intelligence, product marketing, sales enablement, or B2B SaaS.

  • Familiarity with technical integrations (MCP, CRM, Slack, or similar) and comfort guiding customers through deployment.

  • Knowledge of competitive enablement best practices and how revenue teams operationalize competitive programs.

  • Hands-on experience with AI tools beyond basic usage: prompt design, workflow automation, or AI-assisted customer work.

Benefits:

  • Competitive base compensation plus variable

  • Monthly Pension Contribution

  • Extended health & dental benefits that kick in within your first month in seat

  • Opportunity to participate in our Employee Stock Option Plan

  • Time off. Take what you need. We want the team to prioritize wellness and avoid burnout. Vacation usually falls into 3 categories: recharging, life-event, & keeping a work-life balance. Just ensure the required work gets done and clear it with your team in advance. You need to take at least 28 days off every year.

  • Direct access to our leadership team, including our CEO

  • Be part of a high performing team who know how to celebrate their success!

⬇️ ⬇️ ⬇️ ⬇️ ⬇️ ⬇️ ⬇️ ⬇️ ⬇️ ⬇️ ⬇️ ⬇️ ⬇️ ⬇️ ⬇️ ⬇️ ⬇️

Not ticking every box? That’s okay. We take potential into consideration. An equivalent combination of education and experience may be accepted in lieu of the specifics listed above. If you know you have what it takes, even if that’s different from what we’ve described, be sure to explain why in your application.

At Klue, we're committed to building a high-performing team where people feel a strong sense of belonging, can be their authentic selves, and are able to reach their full potential. If there’s anything we can do to make our hiring process more accessible or to better support you, please let us know, we’re happy to accommodate.

Why Klue Might Be the Perfect Fit For You

At Klue, you’ll push the boundaries of what’s possible. For yourself, your team, and our customers. The environment here feels more startup than corporate. You’ll roll up your sleeves, build, iterate, and level up. This is a place where your ideas matter, you can shape what comes next, and leave your mark.

If you’re looking to join a category-defining company… where you own big outcomes, influence real customers, and work with smart, gritty people… you’ll thrive here.

Unlock Your Potential. Take Risks. Take Action. Innovate

How We Work at Klue

We love the balance of connection and flexibility. We work Office-First, with a hybrid touch, and work together in our vibrant offices on Mondays, Wednesdays & Thursdays to collaborate, brainstorm, and build together.

Our main hiring hubs are in:

  • 🇨🇦 Vancouver (HQ)

  • 🇨🇦 Toronto

  • 🇬🇧 London

Our Commitment to You

  • High Performance Culture. We reward high performance and growth through career development, coaching, and annual performance reviews.

  • Comprehensive benefits: Extended health & dental coverage that starts on Day 1. Fun perks like discounts at Goodlife and Perkopolis are gravy.

  • Ownership: All full-time employees have the opportunity to participate in our Employee Stock Option Plan.

  • Our Vacation Policy is Take The Time You Need. We just ask that you give notice and don’t leave your team hanging.

  • Top-tier tools. All employees will receive a Mac (or PC, if that’s your jam) and access to A+ tooling.

  • AI First. All employees are encouraged to lean into AI to work smarter and faster. Built something cool lately? Show us at our Friday Show, Don’t Tell Meetings.

  • Growth / Leadership. Direct access to our leadership team, including our CEO, and opportunities to connect with incredible people across the company.

  • Social connection. There’s no shortage of ways to stay connected and have fun. We get together once a year in Vancouver for a company- wide kickoff. Throughout the year our Hubs hold regular social events.

  • Dog-friendly spaces. Bring your four-legged friend along in Vancouver or Toronto, as our offices are pup-approved.

About Klue

We’re on a mission to help organizations stop losing winnable deals. Klue’s AI agents generate market, competitor, and buyer insights in a unified platform. We ensure it’s trustworthy, automated, and activated across every department, so they have the answers they need to own their market.

✨ Here’s what makes us tick:

  • Klue is AI-first at its core. It’s wired deep into our internal processes and tooling, powering our small but mighty team. It drives Klue’s autonomous agents that handle the heavy lifting for customers: collecting intel, generating insights, and ensuring content is updated and available across departments. Our agents help them scale their impact, stay ahead of the market, and reclaim the time that used to be consumed by manual, repetitive busywork.

  • Competitor Insights. Klue helps revenue teams win more competitive deals by turning market, competitor, and buyer signals into insights teams can actually use. Our AI analyzes calls, CRM data, and real buyer feedback to give product marketers and sellers a clear picture of what’s happening in their market and why deals are won or lost. We’re a curious, collaborative team building a platform that helps companies compete with confidence, and we’re looking for people who want to do meaningful work alongside others who care about craft and impact.

  • A culture of curiosity, ownership and winning together. We’re a fast-growing, globally-distributed team based in Vancouver (with hubs like Toronto), scaling quicker than ever. We value people who own their domain, act boldly, stay curious and thrive in a collaborative, high-performance environment.

jobs.title: Talent Partner, GTM
jobs.description:
Talent Partner, GTM

Location: London, onsite 4 days a week.
Duration: 12-month fixed term contract

Retire The ERP.

Light exists to replace factory-era ERPs with software that feels alive. Our Smart Financial Platform gives modern, global companies superpowers: automated accounting, real-time reporting, and financial flows that move at the speed of the business.

We build with our customers, ship fast, and obsess over craft. In a short time, Light has gone from idea to the operating core for leading companies like Lovable, Legora, and Keyshot. People don’t just use Light, they enjoy it.

We’re an early team defining a new software category. Think engineers who love debits and credits, designers who care about reconciliation states, and operators who treat finance as a product. If you’re excited to modernise how the world runs money, one workflow at a time, you’re in the right place.

Backed by world-class investors and advised by industry titans, we’re building category-defining products with the freedom to ship ambitiously and own outcomes.

Come help us make Light the global default for next-gen finance.

The Role

We plan to double the team in 2027. Most companies that grow this fast dilute the talent density that made them good. We won’t.

You’ll hire across GTM: the teams that win our customers and tell the world about Light. One week that might be an enterprise account executive, the next a product marketer or a demand generation lead. You’ll lead Marketing hiring and work alongside our Sales Talent Partner on Sales. It will be fast and at times messy, and you’ll be the person who brings structure to it.

This isn’t a role for someone who wants to sit and screen all day. We want a guardian of the bar: someone who steps back, looks at the whole hiring problem and fixes what’s actually in the way. AI and good process handle the volume. You bring the judgement, and relationships with great people long before we need them.

What You’ll Do

  • Own Marketing hiring end to end, from individual contributors to leadership

  • Work on Sales searches alongside our Sales Talent Partner, including account executives, SDRs and partner sellers

  • Partner with Marketing and Sales leaders from the start: shape the role, challenge the brief, and build the scorecards and calibration that keep the bar high

  • Work out why a search is stalling, whether it’s the brief, comp, location, assessment or the market, and fix it. Sometimes the answer isn’t an external hire at all.

  • Map the markets for the GTM profiles we hire most often and build talent pools, so the pipeline exists before roles open

  • Hire internationally, with visa sponsorship and relocation support, as our GTM team expands into new markets

What Success Looks Like In Your First 6 Months

  • Marketing and Sales leaders bring you in early because you make their hiring decisions better

  • Hiring managers know what they’re getting and when, because you’ve told them, with data

  • We have mapped markets and warm talent pools for our most common Marketing and Sales profiles

  • Hires are closing at pace, and every one makes the team stronger

  • At least one AI workflow you’ve built is part of how the whole team works

How Our Talent Team Works

  • We protect talent density. Every hire should raise the average. We’d rather hold a role open a little longer than fill it with the wrong person.

  • We source proactively. Most of our best hires won’t apply, so we don’t wait for a role to open. We map the market, build relationships early and have a pipeline ready when the need arrives.

  • We use data. We know where candidates come from, where they drop out and what predicts a good hire. We use that to challenge hiring managers with evidence.

  • We build with AI. We don’t mean writing job ads with ChatGPT. We mean sourcing workflows, research agents and automations that change how much a recruiter can get done.

What You’ll Get From Us

Most Talent teams are bolting AI onto the way they’ve always worked. We’re building ours AI-first, from the ground up.

  • A team built AI-first. AI does the searching, research and admin, so you can spend your time on judgement, relationships and closing. You’ll help design how that works, rather than having it handed to you.

  • The tools and the time to build. You’ll have Claude, Codex, Lovable, Noon and Ashby from day one, plus a regular team build session to test new workflows. When something works, it becomes how the whole team operates.

  • A strategic role. You’ll help shape GTM hiring plans and market-entry decisions, bringing leadership evidence on where talent sits and what it costs.

  • Real ownership. Marketing hiring is yours to build from the ground up.

What You’ll Bring

  • 4+ years in Talent Acquisition, mostly in-house or in embedded or RPO-style roles, hiring GTM teams, including Marketing, in high-growth B2B SaaS or fintech

  • You switch gears fast. You can move from an enterprise sales search to a product marketing hire in the same afternoon, picking up the language, the market and what good looks like in each.

  • Deep knowledge of the London and European GTM talent market. Without opening LinkedIn, you could tell us which companies build the best Marketing and Sales teams, how they structure comp and OTE, and who’s likely to move.

  • You’re a guardian of the bar. You hold it under pressure, including telling a hiring manager “not this one” when the deadline is tight.

  • You step back before you dive in. When a search isn’t working, your first instinct is to work out why, before you screen more CVs.

  • You work at pace and bring structure to chaos. When priorities shift and reqs pile up, you set a clear plan and keep everyone moving.

  • A track record of proactive sourcing: hires you found and engaged before the role opened, rather than hires that applied

  • Hands-on experience building with AI to improve recruiting, with examples you can walk us through

Bonus Points

  • Hiring GTM teams for new markets

  • Building a Marketing team’s hiring from scratch

  • Experience with Claude, Codex, Lovable, Noon or similar tools

The Good Stuff

🏢 In-office culture, high talent density.
💸 Competitive salary.
🏝 25 days annual leave plus public holidays.
🚀 Shape how Light hires as we double the team.
🥳 Off-sites twice a year. The last 2 were in Tuscany & Provence!

Equal Opportunities

Light is an equal opportunities employer. If you need any adjustments during the hiring process, just let us know.

jobs.title: Senior Talent Partner, Customer Success & Technology
jobs.description:
Senior Talent Partner, Customer Success & Tech

Location: London, onsite 4 days a week.

Retire The ERP.

Light exists to replace factory-era ERPs with software that feels alive. Our Smart Financial Platform gives modern, global companies superpowers: automated accounting, real-time reporting, and financial flows that move at the speed of the business.

We build with our customers, ship fast, and obsess over craft. In a short time, Light has gone from idea to the operating core for leading companies like Lovable, Legora, and Keyshot. People don’t just use Light, they enjoy it.

We’re an early team defining a new software category. Think engineers who love debits and credits, designers who care about reconciliation states, and operators who treat finance as a product. If you’re excited to modernise how the world runs money, one workflow at a time, you’re in the right place.

Backed by world-class investors and advised by industry titans, we’re building category-defining products with the freedom to ship ambitiously and own outcomes.

Come help us make Light the global default for next-gen finance.

The Role

We plan to double the team in 2027. Most companies that grow this fast dilute the talent density that made them good. We won’t.

You’ll lead hiring for Customer Success and Tech: the people who build Light and the people who make it work for our customers. One week that might be a senior backend engineer, the next a technical customer engineer or a Head of Account Management. The two worlds overlap more than you’d think. Our best CS hires understand the product deeply, and our engineers build for customers they know.

This isn’t a role for someone who wants to sit and screen all day. We want a guardian of the bar: someone who steps back, looks at the whole hiring problem and fixes what’s actually in the way. AI and good process handle the volume. You bring the judgement, and relationships with great people long before we need them.

What You’ll Do

  • Own Customer Success hiring end to end, from account managers to technical customer engineers and partner enablement, up to leadership

  • Own Product, Engineering and Design searches, including senior and hard-to-fill technical roles

  • Partner with leaders from the start: shape the role, challenge the brief, and build the scorecards and calibration that keep the bar high

  • Work out why a search is stalling, whether it’s the brief, comp, location, assessment or the market, and fix it. Sometimes the answer isn’t an external hire at all.

  • Map the markets for our core CS and technical profiles and build talent pools, so the pipeline exists before roles open

  • Bring great people to London from across Europe and beyond, with visa sponsorship and relocation support

What Success Looks Like In Your First 6 Months

  • CS and Engineering leaders bring you in early because you make their hiring decisions better

  • Hiring managers know what they’re getting and when, because you’ve told them, with data

  • We have mapped markets and warm talent pools for our most common CS and engineering profiles

  • Senior and leadership hires are closing, and every one makes the team stronger

  • At least one AI workflow you’ve built is part of how the whole team works

How Our Talent Team Works

  • We protect talent density. Every hire should raise the average. We’d rather hold a role open a little longer than fill it with the wrong person.

  • We source proactively. Most of our best hires won’t apply, so we don’t wait for a role to open. We map the market, build relationships early and have a pipeline ready when the need arrives.

  • We use data. We know where candidates come from, where they drop out and what predicts a good hire. We use that to challenge hiring managers with evidence.

  • We build with AI. We don’t mean writing job ads with ChatGPT. We mean sourcing workflows, research agents and automations that change how much a recruiter can get done.

What You’ll Get From Us

Most Talent teams are bolting AI onto the way they’ve always worked. We’re building ours AI-first, from the ground up.

  • A team built AI-first. AI does the searching, research and admin, so you can spend your time on judgement, relationships and closing. You’ll help design how that works, rather than having it handed to you.

  • The tools and the time to build. You’ll have Claude, Codex, Lovable, Noon and Ashby from day one, plus a regular team build session to test new workflows. When something works, it becomes how the whole team operates.

  • A strategic role. You’ll help shape workforce plans and location decisions, bringing leadership evidence on where talent sits and what it costs.

  • Room to grow. As our People function scales, so does the scope of this role.

What You’ll Bring

  • 6+ years in Talent Acquisition, mostly in-house or in embedded or RPO-style roles, in high-growth B2B SaaS or fintech, including senior and leadership hires

  • You switch gears fast. You can move from a backend engineering search to a customer engineer hire in the same afternoon, picking up the language, the market and what good looks like in each.

  • Deep knowledge of the London and European markets for engineering and CS talent. Without opening LinkedIn, you could tell us which companies have the strongest teams, what they pay and who’s likely to move.

  • You’re a guardian of the bar. You hold it under pressure, including telling a hiring manager “not this one” when the deadline is tight.

  • You step back before you dive in. When a search isn’t working, your first instinct is to work out why, before you screen more CVs.

  • You work at pace and bring structure to chaos. When priorities shift and reqs pile up, you set a clear plan and keep everyone moving.

  • A track record of proactive sourcing: hires you found and engaged before the role opened, rather than hires that applied

Bonus Points

  • Hands-on experience building with AI to improve recruiting, with examples you can walk us through

  • Hiring solutions or customer engineers

  • Hiring people with finance or accounting backgrounds into customer-facing roles

  • Hiring across borders, including visa sponsorship and relocation

  • Experience with Claude, Codex, Lovable, Noon or similar tools

The Good Stuff

🏢 In-office culture, high talent density.
💸 Competitive salary.
🏝 25 days annual leave plus public holidays.
🚀 Shape how Light hires as we double the team.
🥳 Off-sites twice a year. The last 2 were in Tuscany & Provence!

Equal Opportunities

Light is an equal opportunities employer. If you need any adjustments during the hiring process, just let us know.

jobs.title: Marketing Manager (DACH)
jobs.description:
The finance function is broken.

Finance teams at fast-growing, multi-entity companies are outgrowing their single-entity ledgers and facing a familiar crossroads: bolt on more tools, or go full corporate ERP. Neither option is good. The Frankenstack breaks. The ERP weighs you down with implementation fees and consultants. There has to be a better, more AI native way.

There is. It's Light.

Light is building an AI-native financial platform for modern companies. Fast to implement, intuitive to use, and designed to get smarter over time. We call it organic software.

Companies like Legora, Lovable, and Fuse Energy already run on Light. Following our $30M Series A last year, we're building the team that will make Light the default finance platform for the next generation of businesses.

 
 

Why DACH, why now.

To win Europe, you have to win DACH. We know this. That's why we're making our first dedicated hire for the region and treating it as a must-win market. You won't be a satellite of a global team running templated playbooks. You'll be a builder. The person who decides what Light looks and feels like in Germany, Austria, and Switzerland.

 
 

What you'll be doing.

  • Building Light's presence in DACH from the ground up, shaping our GTM strategy, and becoming one of the defining faces of the region. If you'd rather set the direction than follow it, this is your gig.

  • Owning the full DACH events calendar. Finhack hackathons, third-party sponsorships, roundtables. From concept to follow-up, you run it.

  • Managing the regional budget, knowing where to spend and where to hold back.

  • Working with our brand team on everything from regional messaging and localisation to experiential campaigns that cut through in a market full of noise.

  • Bringing on-the-ground market data back to your VP Marketing and Growth Lead to sharpen paid activity, targeting, and messaging across the region.

  • Driving regional pipeline, working across events, campaigns, and community to build a consistent flow of qualified opportunities for the sales team.

  • Partnering with RevOps to keep pipeline clean, prospects moving, and nothing falling through the cracks between marketing and sales.

  • Enabling the sales team with the collateral, messaging, and market context they need to win in DACH.

  • Building community, not just pipeline. You'll build relationships with press, analysts, and partners, but the bigger goal is an ecosystem of likeminded changemakers around a product that's transforming the finance function.

 
 

What we think you'll need.*

  • Meaningful experience in field or regional marketing at a B2B SaaS company, ideally one that was building out international presence from a non-DACH HQ.

  • Native-level German fluency. You can write the copy, run the room, and build the relationships.

  • A real track record running field marketing and events from start to finish..

  • The ability to work across Sales, RevOps, and brand without losing momentum or creating friction. You know how to get things done in a cross-functional team.

  • Genuine enthusiasm for AI tooling, not just comfort with it. We're an AI-native company and use AI across everything we build and do. Just as Light helps finance teams do their best work, we expect our people to use AI to do theirs.

  • To be based in London, with frequent travel.

*But really, what do we know? If the crux of the role sounds right but you don't tick every box, reach out anyway and make your case.

 
 

The good stuff.

🏢 In-office culture, with a high talent-density team.
💸 Competitive salary.
🏝 25 days annual leave plus public holidays in your country of employment.
🚀 The chance to shape a category from the inside, not just market around it.
🌍 Regular travel to Copenhagen, London, New York, and wherever the action is.
🥳 Company off-sites twice a year. The last one was in Italy.

 
 

Light is an equal opportunity employer.

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Executive
jobs.description:
Validio is the agentic data management platform that automates data quality, lineage, and cataloging — so enterprises can finally trust the data behind their analytics, AI, and reporting. As an Enterprise Account Executive, you'll bring that promise to the enterprises that need it most, owning the full cycle from first outreach to closed deal.

You'll build and run your own pipeline across the enterprise segment, partner with Sales Engineering to prove value, and win over the data and business leaders who decide whether their organization can trust its data.

What you'll do

  • Own the full sales cycle — from prospecting and qualification to negotiation and close — across a defined enterprise territory

  • Build and manage your own pipeline, and develop account plans for the enterprises you target

  • Engage senior stakeholders, up to C-level (CDO, CIO), on the business impact of trusted data

  • Partner with Sales Engineering to run proof-of-value engagements and tailored demos

  • Navigate complex, multi-stakeholder buying processes with a value-based approach

  • Keep an accurate forecast and clean pipeline hygiene in the CRM

  • Represent Validio at industry events


What you'll bring

  • 5+ years closing complex B2B SaaS or data/AI deals, with a consistent record of exceeding quota

  • Experience owning full-cycle enterprise sales into large organizations

  • Command of value-based selling across multiple stakeholders and long cycles

  • A hunter's instinct for generating pipeline, paired with executive-level communication

  • Fluency with a structured sales methodology like MEDDPICC, and the discipline to qualify and forecast rigorously


Bonus points for

  • Background in data infrastructure, cloud, or data observability

  • Familiarity with the modern data stack (e.g. Snowflake, Databricks, AWS, GCP)

  • International or multilingual sales experience


Why Validio
Founded in Sweden in 2019, we're trusted by data-driven enterprises like Nordea, Canva, and Truecaller. Data quality is becoming the foundation everything else — analytics, AI, agents — is built on, and we're defining that category. You'll sell it as it's being created, with the room to shape how we win.

Come as you are. We hire for what you'll build with us, and we welcome applicants of every background.

jobs.title: Finanz- und Digitalisierungsberatung (w/m/d) - Accounting & Taxation
jobs.description:
Möchtest du das tägliche Leben von Millionen von Unternehmern in Deutschland (und bald in Europa) beeinflussen? Suchst du nach einem Arbeitsumfeld, das Vertrauen, Proaktivität und Autonomie schätzt? Stimmen unsere Company Values mit deiner Vision überein? Dann ist Pennylane der richtige Ort für dich!

 

Unsere Vision

Wir wollen das beliebteste finanzielle Betriebssystem für KMU (kleine und mittlere Unternehmen) und Steuerberatungsgesellschaften werden.

Wir helfen Unternehmern, sich von zeitraubenden Aufgaben rund um Buchhaltung und Finanzen zu befreien, während wir ihnen gleichzeitig Zugang zu wichtigen Finanzinformationen verschaffen, um die besten Entscheidungen für ihr Unternehmen zu treffen.

 

Über uns

Pennylane ist eines der am schnellsten wachsenden Fintechs in Frankreich (und jetzt auch in Deutschland!).

In 5 Jahren unseres Bestehens haben wir Folgendes erreicht:

💻 Wir haben uns als bahnbrechende Buchhaltungs- und Finanzsoftware für kleine Unternehmen und ihre Buchhalter bekannt gemacht.

💰 Wir haben insgesamt 225 Millionen Euro eingesammelt, unter anderem von Sequoia, dem berühmten Fonds aus dem Silicon Valley, der früh in Unternehmen wie Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal und viele mehr investiert hat...

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Wir sind von 7 Mitbegründern auf 900 zufriedene Pennylaner angewachsen: Wir gelten heute als einer der besten Arbeitsplätze in Frankreich (auch remote), mit einer Bewertung von 4,6/5 auf Glassdoor.

🌍 Wir haben ein internationales Umfeld mit mehr als 25 Nationalitäten aufgebaut, mit einer starken Remote-freundlichen Kultur, in der 30 % der Mitarbeiter bereits aus allen Teilen Europas arbeiten.

🤝 Wir haben das Vertrauen Tausender von Kunden und Wirtschaftsprüfungsgesellschaften gewonnen und hervorragende Bewertungen erhalten.

🚀 Bereits mehr als 900.000 KMU (kleine und mittlere Unternehmen) und über 5000 Wirtschaftsprüfungsgesellschaften nutzen Pennylane in Frankreich!

 

Deine Mission

Als Stimme unserer Kunden in Deutschland bist du verantwortlich für ihren Erfolg mit der Pennylane-Plattform.

Deine Kernaufgaben:

- Kunden-Onboarding: Du übernimmst die vollständige Einarbeitung (Onboarding) neuer Kunden – sowohl Unternehmen als auch Steuerberaterkanzleien – in die Pennylane-Plattform. Du stellst sicher, dass sie schnell den größtmöglichen Mehrwert aus unserer Lösung ziehen.

- Bestandskundenbetreuung: Du bist der primäre Ansprechpartner für unsere bestehenden Kunden. Du pflegst eine vertrauensvolle Beziehung, identifizierst Upsell-Potenziale und stellst sicher, dass die Kunden Pennylane optimal nutzen, um ihre Geschäftsziele zu erreichen.

- Proaktive Beratung: Du führst regelmäßige Health-Checks und Reviews durch, um die Kundenzufriedenheit und -bindung zu maximieren und Churn vorzubeugen.

- Interne Projektarbeit: Du arbeitest eng mit dem deutschen Sales-Team und dem Management zusammen, um Prozesse zu optimieren, Feedback zu Produktanforderungen zu liefern und zum strategischen Wachstum von Pennylane in Deutschland beizutragen.

- Expertentum: Du entwickelst dich zum Produktexperten für die Finanz- und Buchhaltungslandschaft in Deutschland und teilst dieses Wissen mit unseren Kunden.

 
 

Das bringst du mit

- Erfahrung: 2-5 Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Buchhaltung, Account Management oder einer ähnlichen kundenorientierten Rolle, idealerweise im Kanzlei-Umfeld oder alternativ im SaaS- oder Fintech-Bereich.

- Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Steuerfachangestellter, Steuerfachwirt oder Steuerberater oder Studium im Finance-Bereich

- Branchenwissen: Ein tiefes Verständnis für die Bedürfnisse von Unternehmen und/oder Steuerberatern in Bezug auf Finanzen, Rechnungsstellung und Buchhaltung ist notwendig.

- Soft Skills: Ausgeprägte Kommunikationsfähigkeit, Empathie und ein Talent dafür, komplexe Sachverhalte einfach zu erklären.

- Hands-on Mentalität: Als Teil eines Early-Stage-Teams in Deutschland bist du proaktiv, lösungsorientiert und bereit, Prozesse von Grund auf mitzugestalten.

- Reisebereitschaft: Für das Onboarding im Pariser HQ und für regelmäßige Besuche bei unseren Kunden innerhalb von Deutschland (ca. 1mal im Monat

- Sprachen: Verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse (C2-Niveau oder Muttersprache) und fließende Englischkenntnisse (für die Zusammenarbeit mit dem internationalen Team).

 
 

Was wir tun, um dein Arbeitsleben besser zu machen

🏢 Du kannst remote aus deinem Wohnsitz arbeiten, solange es in Deutschland liegt. Regelmäßige Arbeit aus dem europäischen Ausland ist möglich, wenn die Zeitverschiebung zur MEZ (Mitteleuropäische Zeit) maximal zwei Stunden beträgt.

🌴 Unabhängig davon, wo du ansässig bist, erhältst du 30 von Pennylane bezahlte Urlaubstage. 💵 Du erhältst ein wettbewerbsfähiges Vergütungspaket.

📈 Du erhältst Unternehmensanteile, um vom Erfolg mitzuprofitieren, den du gemeinsam mit uns aufbaust.

🏡 Du erhältst ein Budget, um dein Zuhause in einen komfortableren Arbeitsplatz zu verwandeln, sowie eine monatliche Pauschale, um in einem Coworking Space zu arbeiten, wann immer du möchtest. In Berlin haben wir ein Office, aus dem regelmäßig gearbeitet werden kann.

🇬🇧 Du erhältst Zugang zu Busuu, um dein Englisch oder Französisch zu perfektionieren.

💻 Du erhältst die neueste Apple-Ausrüstung.

🎉 Wir legen Wert auf regelmäßige gemeinsame Veranstaltungen wie unsere Tech Days (die Remote-Pennylaner alle 3 Monate zusammenbringen) oder unser jährliches Firmenseminar, um wichtige Momente des Zusammenhalts für alle zu schaffen.

 

Wen wir suchen

Um bei Pennylane erfolgreich zu sein, benötigst du:

- Englischkenntnisse (das Niveau wird je nach Abteilung, für die du dich bewirbst, bewertet und eingeschätzt).

- Begeisterung für ein sich ständig wandelndes Arbeitsumfeld.

- Hohe Kooperationsbereitschaft (innerhalb deines Teams oder mit anderen Stakeholdern).

- Ausreichend Erfahrung, um deine täglichen Aufgaben nach geschäftlichen Prioritäten auszurichten.

 

Wir wissen, dass einige Menschen eher zögern, sich zu bewerben, wenn sie das Gefühl haben, nicht die gesamte Liste der Kriterien zu erfüllen. Wenn du unsicher bist, ermutigen wir dich, dich trotzdem zu bewerben: Wer weiß, vielleicht ist es der Beginn einer sinnvollen und langfristigen Zusammenarbeit.

 

Wir möchten auch betonen, dass wir Vielfalt, Gleichheit und Inklusion voll und ganz befürworten und unser Bestes tun, um ein sicheres und integratives Umfeld zu schaffen. Wir verpflichten uns, gleiche Beschäftigungsmöglichkeiten unabhängig von Geschlecht, sexueller Orientierung, Herkunft, Behinderungen oder anderen Merkmalen, die dich ausmachen, zu gewährleisten. Im Gegenteil, Vielfalt macht uns zu einem noch besseren Arbeitsplatz.

 

🇫🇷 Données personnelles

Pennylane traite vos données pour gérer votre candidature et évaluer votre adéquation au poste. Si votre candidature n’aboutit pas, vos données peuvent être conservées 2 ans à compter de notre dernier échange ou de la clôture du recrutement afin de constituer & gérer un vivier de candidats. Vous pouvez vous opposer à tout moment et demander la suppression de vos données en écrivant à :
Notre data policy

🇬🇧 Personal Data

Pennylane processes your data to manage your application and assess your suitability for the position. If your application is unsuccessful, your data may be retained for 2 years from our last exchange or the closing of the recruitment process, in order to build and manage a candidate pool. You may object at any time and request the deletion of your data by writing to Learn more

🇩🇪 Personenbezogene Daten

Pennylane verarbeitet Ihre Daten, um Ihre Bewerbung zu bearbeiten und Ihre Eignung für die Stelle zu beurteilen. Sollte Ihre Bewerbung nicht erfolgreich sein, können Ihre Daten bis zu 2 Jahre ab unserem letzten Austausch oder dem Abschluss des Rekrutierungsverfahrens gespeichert werden, um einen Kandidatenpool aufzubauen und zu verwalten. Sie können jederzeit Widerspruch einlegen und die Löschung Ihrer Daten beantragen, indem Sie an Mehr erfahren

🇪🇸 Datos personales

Pennylane trata sus datos para gestionar su candidatura y evaluar su idoneidad para el puesto. En caso de que su candidatura no sea seleccionada, sus datos podrán conservarse hasta 2 años a partir de nuestro último contacto o de la finalización del proceso de selección, con el fin de constituir y gestionar una reserva de candidatos. Puede oponerse en cualquier momento y solicitar la eliminación de sus datos escribiendo a Más información

Über uns

💰 Wir haben insgesamt 225 Millionen Euro eingesammelt, unter anderem von Sequoia, dem berühmten Fonds aus dem Silicon Valley, der früh in Unternehmen wie Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal und viele mehr investiert hat...

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Wir sind von 7 Mitbegründern auf 900 zufriedene Pennylaner angewachsen: Wir gelten heute als einer der besten Arbeitsplätze in Frankreich (auch remote), mit einer Bewertung von 4,6/5 auf Glassdoor.

🌍 Wir haben ein internationales Umfeld mit mehr als 25 Nationalitäten aufgebaut, mit einer starken Remote-freundlichen Kultur, in der 30 % der Mitarbeiter bereits aus allen Teilen Europas arbeiten.

🤝 Wir haben das Vertrauen Tausender von Kunden und Wirtschaftsprüfungsgesellschaften gewonnen und hervorragende Bewertungen erhalten.

🚀 Bereits mehr als 900.000 KMU (kleine und mittlere Unternehmen) und über 5000 Wirtschaftsprüfungsgesellschaften nutzen Pennylane in Frankreich!

 

Deine Mission

- Bestandskundenbetreuung: Du bist der primäre Ansprechpartner für unsere bestehenden Kunden. Du pflegst eine vertrauensvolle Beziehung, identifizierst Upsell-Potenziale und stellst sicher, dass die Kunden Pennylane optimal nutzen, um ihre Geschäftsziele zu erreichen.

- Proaktive Beratung: Du führst regelmäßige Health-Checks und Reviews durch, um die Kundenzufriedenheit und -bindung zu maximieren und Churn vorzubeugen.

- Interne Projektarbeit: Du arbeitest eng mit dem deutschen Sales-Team und dem Management zusammen, um Prozesse zu optimieren, Feedback zu Produktanforderungen zu liefern und zum strategischen Wachstum von Pennylane in Deutschland beizutragen.

- Expertentum: Du entwickelst dich zum Produktexperten für die Finanz- und Buchhaltungslandschaft in Deutschland und teilst dieses Wissen mit unseren Kunden.

jobs.title: Major Account Executive
Staff Platform Engineer (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
Our goal is to have a solar system on every roof, a storage unit in every house, and an electric car in every garage. Enpal makes this possible with an integrated total solution for decentralized energy—from solar systems and battery storage to wall boxes, smart meters, and heat pumps. At the heart of it all is our AI-powered platform Enpal.One+, which intelligently connects thousands of systems and efficiently optimizes electricity procurement and feed-in on the energy market.

Are you ready for solutions that are more than just a promise and bring real quality of life to thousands of households every day? What you create at Enpal will deliver clean electricity tomorrow and bring about lasting change in how we use energy.

Job Description

As a Staff Platform Engineer, you will provide technical leadership for the internal platform that powers Enpal's applications and services. You will set technical direction, raise the bar on engineering standards, and drive cross-team initiatives that make our platform more reliable, secure, and scalable. You'll partner closely with engineering leadership, senior platform engineers, and development teams, acting as a force multiplier through mentorship, architectural guidance, and hands-on contribution to the platform's hardest problems.

 

This role is ideal for engineers who have deep, proven expertise in platform and cloud engineering and want to shape the technical strategy of a growing engineering organization, not just execute within it.

At Enpal, you would be:

  • Owning platform architecture. Define and evolve the architecture of our internal platform, making build-vs-buy and long-term design decisions that balance reliability, scalability, security, and cost.

  • Driving infrastructure automation at scale. Lead the design of automation and self-service tooling that removes manual toil across deployment, provisioning, and operations for the whole engineering org, not just your own team.

  • Setting technical standards. Establish best practices for Kubernetes operations, CI/CD pipelines, observability, and infrastructure as code, and ensure they are adopted consistently across teams.

  • Elevating the developer experience. Treat the platform as a product for internal teams: drive usability, reliability, and documentation improvements that let engineers ship faster and safer, and define the metrics that prove it.

  • Mentoring and growing engineers. Coach platform and junior engineers, review designs and code, and raise the overall technical level of the team through pairing, documentation, and feedback.

  • Leading complex, cross-team initiatives. Take ownership of high-impact projects that span multiple teams, from scoping and design through rollout, with minimal oversight.

  • Driving continuous improvement. Proactively identify risks, inefficiencies, and technical debt, and lead the changes that materially improve stability, performance, and automation.

  • Partnering across the organization. Work closely with developers, operations, security, and leadership to understand real needs and translate them into platform solutions and roadmap priorities.

Qualifications

We are looking for an experienced engineer with deep technical expertise, strong judgment, and a track record of leading platform initiatives.

  • 8+ years of experience in platform, cloud, DevOps, or software engineering roles, including significant time operating production systems at scale.

  • Proven, hands-on expertise with cloud environments and containerized applications (Azure, Kubernetes and more), including designing and operating production-grade clusters.

  • Deep experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform), CI/CD tooling, Helm and observability tooling, with the judgment to choose the right approach for a given problem.

  • A demonstrated track record of leading technical initiatives end to end, from design through rollout, across multiple teams.

  • Experience mentoring engineers and raising the technical bar of a team, including through code/design review and documentation.

  • Strong system design skills, with the ability to reason about trade-offs in reliability, scalability, security, and cost.

  • Clear communication skills in English, spoken and written, with the ability to influence stakeholders at multiple levels. Knowledge of German is a plus.

Nice to Have

  • Experience setting up or scaling platform teams in a fast-growing organization.

  • Deep understanding of monitoring, alerting, and incident response practices, including on-call ownership and postmortems.

  • Contributions to open-source platform or infrastructure tooling.

jobs.description:
About Strava

Strava is the app for active people. With over 200 million athletes in more than 185 countries, it’s more than tracking workouts—it’s where people make progress together, from new habits to new personal bests. No matter your sport or how you track it, Strava’s got you covered. Find your crew, crush your goals, and make every effort count. Start your journey with Strava today.

Our mission is simple: to motivate people to live their best active lives. We believe in the power of movement to connect and drive people forward.

About the Role

The Strava for Business team partners with the world's leading brands and agencies to inspire active communities and connect with athletes in meaningful ways. Our sponsorship solutions offer an innovative alternative to traditional advertising — rooted in motivation, community, and real-world impact.

We're growing fast and quote-to-cash rigor is the foundation of that growth. Today, the individual stages of our commercial process have clear owners across Sales, Creative Solutions, Partner Marketing Science, Legal, Product and Finance. The gap is in how those stages work together end to end.

This role sits within GTM Strategy & Operations, reporting into the Global Lead of the function.

This is a high-impact, high-autonomy role. You'll work at the intersection of all teams that are involved in our quote-to-cash process. This is a role for someone who excels in taking complex go-to-market problems, redesign the underlying process and drive change across teams, systems and ways of working.

We follow a flexible hybrid model that translates to more than half of your time on-site in our London, UK office — three days per week.

What You'll Do

• Own and improve quote-to-cash. Map the end-to-end commercial journey, identify bottlenecks and redesign processes so deals move cleanly from opportunity through delivery and revenue recognition.

• Lead cross-functional quote-to-cash transformation. Work across Sales, Partner Marketing Science, Creative solutions, Legal, Finance, IT and Product to solve problems that sit between functions and drive improvements through to completion.

• Integrate new products and capabilities. Make sure new propositions can be quoted, contracted, delivered, reported, invoiced and recognised cleanly before they scale.

• Improve business systems and handoffs. Design better workflows across the commercial stack, including HubSpot, Ironclad, delivery tooling, billing and revenue systems. Ensure data, ownership and approvals move cleanly between them.

• Build operational visibility. Establish the KPIs, reporting and escalation mechanisms needed to understand where the commercial engine is working - and where it is not.

• Own the transformation roadmap. Help make the operating model real by ensuring global design is informed by regional and XFN teams needs and can be deployed effectively.

What You’ll Bring to the Team

• Minimum 5+ years of relevant experience in quote-to-cash, revenue productivity, commercial learning, go-to-market enablement, strategy and operations, product operations, program management or a closely related field.

• Experience leading complex cross-functional programmes with multiple teams, systems and senior stakeholders.

• A proactive mindset with the ability to navigate ambiguity, drive and execute initiatives, and deliver results in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

• Comfort operating in a builder environment — you're not inheriting a playbook; you're helping create it. You thrive with autonomy, move quickly through ambiguity, and are energised by building from zero.

• Ability to map complex processes, identify root causes and design simpler, scalable operating models.

• Strong communication, stakeholder management, and storytelling skills, with comfort presenting recommendations and direction to stakeholders.

• Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects, prioritize effectively, and meet deadlines.

• A detail-oriented, methodical, and process-driven mentality that is focused on both accuracy and efficiency.

• Demonstrated ability to operate at the intersection of Sales, Product, Legal, Finance, and regional teams, with strong influence in a matrixed environment.

Ideally, You'll Also Bring

• Experience in adtech, media, advertising platforms or digital partnerships, with an understanding of the operational complexity behind deal delivery, measurement, creative operations, contracting and revenue recognition.

• Familiarity with CRM platforms (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot), Asana, Ironclad.

What Success Looks Like

• The end-to-end commercial process is documented and ownership is clear.

• The biggest quote-to-cash bottlenecks have been identified and materially removed.

• Critical handoffs between teams and systems are more reliable and measurable.

• New products can enter the commercial process without bespoke workarounds.

• Leadership has a clear view of operational health and where intervention is needed.

• GTM operations are built ahead of the business's growth rather than catching up with it.

Movement brings us together. At Strava, we’re building the world’s largest community of active people, helping them stay motivated and achieve their goals.

Our global team is passionate about making movement fun, meaningful, and accessible to everyone. Whether you’re shaping the technology, growing our community, or driving innovation, your work at Strava makes an impact.

When you join Strava, you’re not just joining a company—you’re joining a movement. If you’re ready to bring your energy, ideas, and drive, let’s build something incredible together.

Strava builds software that makes the best part of our athletes’ days even better. About Pleo

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

About the role

We're looking for a commercially-minded Account Manager to join our Mid-Market Account Management Team at Pleo. In this role, you'll help grow and expand our existing customer base and be part of the Customer Growth & Expansion team as we scale. If you're excited about strategic account management, obsessed with customer outcomes, know how to unlock expansion across complex organisation, you love nurturing relationships, identifying growth levers, proving ROI, and are passionate about spend management, then this is the opportunity for you!

Who you’ll be working with and reporting to

You’ll report to our Senior Sales Manager, Account Management and work closely with teams in Customer Success, Deal Desk, Pricing and Enablement. Our team of 16 is highly collaborative and dedicated to delivering value and growing our existing customer base. You’ll also have the chance to partner with teams across Sales, Support, Product and Marketing to ensure success.

What you’ll be doing

As an Account Manager, you will:

  • Own a dedicated book of business from a purely commercial perspective, focusing heavily on a land-and-expand revenue model through cross-selling, upselling, and driving overall account growth

  • Identify and close expansion opportunities within your book of business, securing new entities, teams, and product capabilities aligned with evolving customer needs.

  • Work hand-in-hand with Customer Success teams, who focus on customer adoption and retention, allowing you to stay fully focused on driving revenue and commercial outcomes.

  • Build deep relationships with key decision-makers (senior finance, procurement, and operations stakeholders) to understand their strategic initiatives and uncover whitespace opportunities.

  • Use MEDDICC (or similar framework) to rigorously qualify upsell and cross-sell opportunities, ensuring forecast accuracy and high deal velocity.

  • Showcase new product features, integrations, and advanced workflows. Leverage customer success stories, usage data, and ROI metrics to proactively pitch new functionality and quantify value.

  • Create custom proposals and business cases aligned with commercial goals and customer budgeting cycles, leading commercial conversations to ensure terms reflect the value Pleo delivers.

What you bring

You’ll thrive in this role if you have:

  • A solid understanding of value-based selling and consultative approach

  • Skilled in contract negotiations and building business cases linking features to value

  • Strong understanding of qualification methodologies (e.g., MEDDICC)

  • A passion for solving problems with a solution-oriented approach

  • Data-driven, goal-oriented, and accurate forecasting ability

  • Strong commercial acumen and ability to navigate senior stakeholders

  • A background in SaaS Account Management or Customer Growth with a proven track record of expansion revenue and high net revenue retention

  • Complete fluency in English

Why is this role a good fit for you

This role is a good fit for you if:

  • You are naturally curious and driven to map out complex organisations, identifying white space where Pleo can solve a genuine business need.

  • You get a rush from closing upsells by proving ROI and prefer driving proactive growth over simply waiting for a renewal.

  • You use frameworks like MEDDICC to keep deals on track and can easily show a CFO how tech features translate into financial value.

This role is not a good fit for you if:

  • You view Account Management solely as responding to support tickets or handling administrative renewals rather than proactively hunting for expansion opportunities and driving revenue.

  • You require a rigid, unchanging playbook to succeed. We are scaling fast, which means processes evolve and you’ll need to be comfortable building the plane while flying it.

  • You prefer simple, single-point-of-contact relationships. This role requires multi-threading across Finance, IT, and Procurement in mid-market organizations.

How you’ll develop in this role

In your first 6 to 12 months at Pleo, you’ll:

  • Lead targeted account whitespace analysis to drive impact in your assigned market segment.

The location


Please note: We can hire on a hybrid or in-person set-up in any of the locations listed on the advert but you will need to be physically based in the country of your choice with a valid right to work. We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role in any of the listed locations.

Show me the benefits!

  • Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)

The interview process

We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows:

  1. Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Acquisition Partner to discuss the role and your background.

  2. Hiring Manager Interview: A 45 minute chat to deep dive into your experience

  3. Challenge & Team Interview: We will send you a take home test and invite you to present during a 60 minute team interview. This is an opportunity to show us how you would handle the day to day of the role

  4. Final Interview: A final interview with a senior leader

Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success!

Last time we hired for this role, we received a vast number of applications but only a few were selected for an intro call. Some of the key reasons why previous candidates didn’t make it past the application screening stage include:

We love seeing people leverage AI—it’s a big focus for us internally too—but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light. What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit: Laszlo Bock, ~2014) to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on.   • Application care: every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care.   • A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails.

  • Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us.

  • Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email ----- We’ll design a process that works for you.

  • Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here.

  • Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role.

  • Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit.

jobs.title: Head of E-commerce
jobs.description:
On réinvente l'imperméable. Pour de vrai.

On crée des imperméables colorés, modulables et fabriqués à partir de tissus recyclés. Pas pour faire comme tout le monde, mais pour donner enfin envie de porter un imperméable.

Aujourd'hui, nous sommes une vingtaine, avec un modèle multicanal : un réseau retail en plein développement, un e-commerce qui fonctionne bien et un B2B qui accélère.

Et surtout, on a encore beaucoup de choses à construire et de barrières à faire tomber.

C'est là que tu entres en action.

Le poste

On cherche quelqu'un qui a déjà scalé un e-commerce dans la mode — et qui a envie de recommencer avec une marque qui a quelque chose à dire.

Pas un manager qui supervise. Pas un consultant qui conseille. Un(e) Head of E-commerce qui exécute, qui teste, qui itère, et qui vient chercher le résultat lui-même. Tu travailles en direct avec le fondateur, sans couche intermédiaire, sans réunion de validation à n'en plus finir.

Tu prends le lead sur l'e-commerce de A à Z — et le site, c'est ton produit. Pas un outil qu'on subit, pas un chantier qu'on repousse : quelque chose qu'on améliore en continu, avec méthode, avec des données, et avec l'obsession que chaque visiteur devienne client.

Tu comprends que dans la mode, performance et image de marque ne s'opposent pas — ils se construisent ensemble, sur le long terme. Tu sais qu'une bonne décision d'acquisition peut abîmer une marque, et qu'une marque forte réduit le coût d'acquisition. C'est exactement ce qu'on veut construire chez Flotte.

Si tu cherches un poste où on te demande de « définir uniquement la vision », ce n'est pas ce poste. Si tu cherches un endroit où tu construis quelque chose qui compte, avec quelqu'un prêt à aller vite et à prendre des risques calculés — bienvenue.

Vos missions

Tes responsabilités concrètes

Le site, c'est ton produit

  • Tu « owns » le site de A à Z — pas juste sa performance marketing, mais son expérience, son évolution, sa roadmap
  • Tu priorises les développements avec notre prestataire tech : ce qui sort, dans quel ordre, pourquoi
  • Tu A/B testes en continu — pas une fois par trimestre, mais comme réflexe de travail
  • Tu détectes les points de friction avant que les clients se plaignent
  • Chaque page, chaque étape du tunnel a une raison d'être et un indicateur qui le prouve

Performance & acquisition

  • Piloter et optimiser les campagnes Meta / Google / TikTok (et challenge l'agence qui s'en charge)
  • Construire une stratégie d'acquisition rentable, cohérente avec l'image de marque — pas juste du volume à tout prix
  • Gérer la saisonnalité mode : anticiper les pics, optimiser les périodes creuses, ne jamais sacrifier l'image pour remplir un objectif court terme
  • Déployer un vrai tracking et ne plus naviguer à vue

CRM & retention

  • Structurer la base client, segmenter, personnaliser
  • Email, SMS, automation — construire des flows qui transforment les acheteurs en fans
  • LTV : la faire grimper

Vision 360 & cohérence omnicanale

  • Assurer la cohérence de l'expérience digitale sur tous les canaux : e-commerce, retail, B2B
  • Apporter un regard digital sur la stratégie B2B portée par l'équipe dédiée — sans empiéter sur leur terrain
  • Garantir que le site et les outils digitaux servent l'ensemble des canaux, pas seulement le DTC
  • Être le garant d'une image de marque cohérente quel que soit le point de contact

Développement international

  • Identifier et prioriser les marchés européens à fort potentiel pour Flotte (UK, Benelux, DACH, Nordics...)
  • Définir la stratégie de pénétration marché par marché : positionnement, canaux, pricing, timing
  • Travailler en binôme avec le pôle marketing & communication pour adapter l'image de marque aux marchés cibles sans en diluer l'ADN
  • Tester, mesurer, ajuster — pas de grand plan sur 3 ans, mais une approche structurée et itérative
  • Piloter les partenariats locaux (distributeurs, revendeurs, marketplaces) quand c'est le bon levier

Pilotage

  • Définir les bons KPIs, les suivre, les challenger
  • Être force de proposition sur le budget, les outils, la stack tech
  • Recruter et structurer une petite équipe quand on est prêts

Vos compétences

Le profil qu'on cherche vraiment

Tu as déjà fait le chemin dans la mode — et tu as envie de recommencer avec une marque qui a quelque chose à prouver.

Tu connais les contraintes du prêt-à-porter : les collections qui se succèdent, les stocks à piloter, la saisonnalité qui dicte le calendrier marketing, et la pression permanente de défendre une image de marque tout en délivrant de la performance. Tu sais qu'on ne construit pas une marque mode comme on scale un pure player généraliste. Et tu crois qu'on peut faire les deux.

  • 5 ansd'expérience en e-commerce, obligatoirement dans la mode ou le prêt-à-porter, avec au moins une expérience de scale probante — et des chiffres à l'appui
  • Tu ne sacrifies pas l'image de marque sur l'autel du ROAS — tu sais que la désirabilité d'une marque mode se construit sur le long terme et se détruit très vite
  • Une vision long terme : construire une marque qui dure, pas juste optimiser une saison
  • Un profil entrepreneur dans l'âme : tu penses business autant que tu penses acquisition, tu n'attends pas qu'on te dise quoi faire
  • Tu maîtrises Shopify, Meta Ads, Google Ads, un outil CRM (Klaviyo ou équivalent)
  • Tu exécutes — la stratégie c'est bien, mais sans exécution ça ne vaut rien
  • Tu es à l'aise pour travailler en direct avec un fondateur exigeant, sans filtre, avec franchise et sans ego
  • Anglais courant obligatoire.

Avantages

Ce qu'on t'offre

Une marque à construire, pas à gérer.

Chez Flotte, tu n'arrives pas dans une structure figée avec des process à respecter. Tu arrives dans une équipe qui construit encore — et qui cherche quelqu'un pour accélérer. Tu as un accès direct au fondateur, une vraie autonomie, et un impact qui se mesure.

On est convaincus qu'on peut devenir la référence de l'imperméable en France, puis en Europe. Ce poste, c'est le poste de quelqu'un qui veut être là quand ça arrive — pas juste le regarder de loin.

  • Rôle de direction dans une PME en croissance avec une vraie ambition de scale
  • Package attractif selon profil + variable sur objectifs
  • Une culture friendly, colorée, qui ne se prend pas au sérieux — mais qui prend ses résultats très au sérieux

Envoie-nous un message court avec ce que tu ferais en priorité si tu arrivais chez Flotte demain matin, et ce que tu as déjà construit dans la mode.

Les CVs de 3 pages sans contexte : non merci.
