jobs.title: Shift Supervisor | DSL-01
jobs.description:
Shift Supervisor | DSL-01

Voor DSL-01 in Delfzijl zoeken wij een ervaren Shift Supervisor die vanaf de voorbereidingsfase meebouwt aan de operatie. Iemand die meedenkt over procedures, voorbereiding van de commissioning en startup en helpt om operators klaar te stomen voor het moment waarop de installatie daadwerkelijk gaat draaien. DSL-01 wordt een grootschalige productiefaciliteit voor Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF) en bijproducten.

 

Over de functie

Als Shift Supervisor speel je een sleutelrol in de veilige, stabiele en efficiënte operatie van DSL-01. In deze functie krijg je een unieke combinatie van projectwerk en operationele verantwoordelijkheid. Tijdens de huidige projectfase draag je in dagdienst actief bij aan de voorbereiding van de fabrieksoperatie, commissioning en startup. Zodra DSL-01 operationeel is, gepland vanaf voorjaar 2028, geef je (in ploegendienst) leiding aan een ploeg operators en ben je verantwoordelijk voor de dagelijkse aansturing van een complexe chemische productie-installatie.

Je zorgt ervoor dat productie-, kwaliteits-, veiligheids- en milieudoelstellingen worden behaald en neemt de leiding wanneer zich afwijkingen, storingen of noodsituaties voordoen. Daarbij werk je nauw samen met collega's van Maintenance, Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain en HSES.

Wat deze rol bijzonder maakt, is dat je niet instapt in een bestaande organisatie, maar vanaf het begin meebouwt aan de operatie, productie en manier van werken.

Jouw verantwoordelijkheden

Tijdens de project- en opstartfase (~1,5 jaar):

  • Werk je in dagdienst

  • Draag je bij aan de commissioning en inbedrijfstelling van DSL-01

  • Ontwikkel je procedures en werkinstructies

  • Speel je een belangrijke rol in het uitvoeren van trainingsprogramma's en het trainen van operators

  • Ondersteun je bij de opbouw van de operationele organisatie

  • Zorg je voor een succesvolle voorbereiding op de start van de fabriek.

In de operationele fase (vanaf medio 2028):

  • Geef je leiding aan een team van ongeveer 8 operators in een 5-ploegendienst binnen een volcontinu productieproces.

  • Bewaak je de veilige en efficiënte productie van SAF, propaan, butaan en nafta.

  • Monitor je procesprestaties via DCS- en MES-systemen, stuur je bij waar nodig en zorg je ervoor dat productie-, kwaliteits- en rendementsdoelstellingen worden gerealiseerd.

Daarnaast ben je verantwoordelijk voor het naleven van veiligheids-, milieu- en kwaliteitsstandaarden, neem je de leiding bij incidenten en calamiteiten en coördineer je werkzaamheden tussen Operations, Maintenance en andere betrokken disciplines. Ook speel je een actieve rol in het continu verbeteren van processen en het verder versterken van de veiligheidscultuur binnen de fabriek.

Een belangrijk onderdeel van je rol is het ontwikkelen van het operationele team. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de groei van operators, zowel op technisch vlak als in competenties zoals samenwerking, eigenaarschap en veiligheidsbewustzijn. Door coaching, begeleiding en duidelijke verwachtingen zorg je voor een sterk team dat veilig, effectief en met vertrouwen kan opereren.

 

Jouw profiel

SkyNRG is een groeiende organisatie in een snel ontwikkelende markt. Daarom zoeken we mensen die zich prettig voelen in een omgeving waar nog niet alles vastligt en die actief willen bijdragen aan de verdere opbouw van de organisatie.

Je neemt verantwoordelijkheid, denkt vooruit en voelt je op je plek in een omgeving die continu in beweging is.

Je herkent jezelf in het volgende:

  • Ervaring en affiniteit met Procestechniek, Chemische Technologie of een vergelijkbare richting

  • Minimaal een afgeronde VAPRO C of AOT niveau 4-opleiding

  • Minimaal 10 jaar ervaring binnen de chemische, petrochemische, raffinage- of vergelijkbare procesindustrie

  • Aantoonbare operationele leidinggevende ervaring en bewezen people development skills

  • Ervaring met procesautomatisering en het werken met DCS- en MES-systemen

  • Kennis van procesveiligheid, werkvergunningensystemen en relevante wet- en regelgeving

  • Ervaring met het nemen van operationele beslissingen in situaties waar veiligheid, kwaliteit en continuïteit samenkomen

Welkome extra kennis en ervaring:

  • Ervaring binnen greenfield-projecten of grootschalige industriële bouw- en opstartprojecten

  • Ervaring met commissioning, startup en operational readiness

  • Kennis van raffinage-, hydroprocessing- of duurzame brandstofprocessen

  • Ervaring met continue verbeterprogramma's en performance management

Over DSL-01

In Delfzijl bouwen wij aan DSL-01, een fabriek van SkyNRG voor hernieuwbare brandstoffen. Hier produceren we Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF) uit reststromen zoals gebruikte vetten en oliën, met HEFA-technologie. Daarnaast maken we bijproducten zoals butaan, propaan en nafta.

DSL-01 wordt de eerste fabriek in Europa die volledig gericht is op SAF en bijbehorende duurzame bijproducten. Als de fabriek in bedrijf is, produceren we jaarlijks 100.000 ton SAF en 35.000 ton bijproducten. Daarmee verminderen we de uitstoot van broeikasgassen met circa 80% ten opzichte van fossiele kerosine, gemeten over de hele keten.

De bouw is gestart in 2026 en de eerste productie staat gepland voor 2028. Het project omvat de fabriek zelf, bijbehorende leidingen en tijdelijke werkterreinen. Je draagt direct bij aan de realisatie van een nieuwe industriële fabriek en de verduurzaming van de luchtvaart.

We werken volgens internationale standaarden en Nederlandse wet- en regelgeving om de impact op mens, natuur en omgeving zorgvuldig te beheersen. Veiligheid, duurzaamheid en samenwerking staan daarbij centraal.

Waarom deze rol?

Deze functie biedt een kans die maar weinig operators en shift supervisors krijgen. Je bent vanaf een vroeg stadium betrokken bij de realisatie van een compleet nieuwe fabriek en kunt jouw operationele expertise inzetten om invloed uit te oefenen op commissioning, procedures, opleidingen en de uiteindelijke manier van werken.

Na de opstart maak je de stap naar een operationele omgeving waarin je leiding geeft aan een moderne productie-installatie en een belangrijke rol speelt in het neerzetten van de standaarden, cultuur en prestaties van de fabriek.

Tegelijkertijd draag je direct bij aan de realisatie van een van Europa's eerste grootschalige SAF-fabrieken. Een unieke kans om mee te bouwen aan een nieuwe productieorganisatie én een tastbare bijdrage te leveren aan de verduurzaming van de luchtvaart.

NB: Voor de opbouw van de operationele organisatie zoeken we uiteindelijk vijf Shift Supervisors. De eerste twee Supervisors starten tijdens de project- en opstartfase van DSL-01. De overige drie posities worden naar verwachting in het voorjaar ingevuld, zodat het volledige team gereed is voor de operationele fase. ‌

 

Solliciteer

Wil jij meewerken aan de succesvolle realisatie van een nieuwe fabriek en het resultaat van je werk terugzien in de praktijk? Dan is dit je kans om bij te dragen aan de ontwikkeling van duurzame luchtvaart.

NB: Een medische keuring maakt vanwege veiligheids- en gezondheidsredenen onderdeel uit van de selectieprocedure voor deze functie. ‌

 

Meer weten over DSL-01 en SkyNRG? Kijk op www.skynrg.com.

📌 Acquisitie naar aanleiding van deze vacature wordt niet op prijs gesteld.

SkyNRG is een werkgever die gelijke kansen biedt. We zetten ons in voor een inclusieve werkomgeving en beoordelen alle sollicitanten op basis van hun kwaliteiten, ongeacht afkomst, huidskleur, religie, nationaliteit, geslacht, seksuele oriëntatie, genderidentiteit of -expressie, leeftijd, beperking of andere wettelijk beschermde kenmerken.

Compensation: €4,583 – €6,000 per month

Camunda is the enterprise platform for agentic orchestration, enabling organizations to coordinate AI agents, people, and systems across complex, end-to-end business processes. You will translate government priorities into a compelling value case for process orchestration, automation, and agentic workflows, while navigating formal procurement processes and the governance expectations of public-sector customers.

What you will own

What success looks like

First 30 days

  • Produce an initial account segmentation and stakeholder-mapping plan for the Dutch Government territory.

  • Establish a repeatable operating cadence for pipeline creation, deal inspection, forecasting, and cross-functional account-team collaboration.

First 90 days

  • Complete strategic account plans for the highest-priority government accounts, including business priorities, buying groups, whitespace, partners, competition, and next actions.

  • Create qualified pipeline through a balanced mix of net-new opportunities, partner-sourced activity, executive introductions, and expansion plays.

  • Develop a strong network of relevant government and ecosystem stakeholders, with clear relationship and meeting objectives.

  • Demonstrate consistent MEDDICC qualification and accurate Salesforce hygiene across active opportunities.

  • Identify the most relevant public-sector use cases and value narratives for Camunda’s Dutch market development.

First 180 days and beyond

  • Establish a credible, repeatable pipeline engine for the Dutch Government market.

  • Progress strategic opportunities through well-defined qualification, value validation, technical evaluation, procurement, and commercial stages.

  • Win new government logos and create expansion paths into additional departments, agencies, or processes.

  • Build trusted relationships with executive sponsors and public-sector ecosystem partners.

  • Contribute actionable market insight that improves Camunda’s positioning, messaging, partner strategy, and investment decisions in the Netherlands.

  • Deliver against quota while protecting long-term customer value, adoption, and expansion potential.

What you will bring

Must-haves

  • 5+ years of success in a quota-carrying enterprise software or SaaS Account Executive role, owning complex deals end to end.

  • Demonstrated experience selling into the Dutch Government or another highly regulated public-sector environment, with a clear understanding of formal procurement, security, legal, and governance requirements.

  • A track record of creating pipeline through proactive outbound activity and converting multi-stakeholder opportunities into material, preferably multi-year, contracts.

  • Strong command of MEDDICC or a comparable enterprise sales methodology, with the discipline to qualify rigorously, manage mutual action plans, and forecast accurately.

  • Executive presence and communication skills in Dutch and English, with the ability to connect operational problems to strategic, financial, and citizen-impact outcomes.

  • A collaborative, customer-focused, and resilient approach aligned with Camunda’s FAITH values and global-first way of working.

Nice-to-haves

  • Experience selling process automation, workflow, orchestration, integration, business transformation, or adjacent enterprise technology.

  • Existing relationships across Dutch ministries, executive agencies, municipalities, provinces, public-service organizations, or government-focused partners.

  • Experience working with global system integrators, regional implementation partners, or public-sector framework agreements.

  • Familiarity with Camunda, BPMN, DMN, process orchestration, cloud platforms, or agentic automation.

  • Experience creating quantified value cases for service modernization, compliance, operational resilience, or cost reduction.

Why this role matters now

Dutch public-sector organizations are under pressure to modernize services, improve efficiency, operate securely, and coordinate increasingly complex technology and regulatory environments. Process orchestration gives them a way to make that complexity visible and manageable while connecting people, systems, and automation.

This role is an opportunity to shape a market rather than inherit a mature patch. You will have the ownership and visibility to define where Camunda can create the greatest public value, build the ecosystem around those opportunities, and establish a durable foundation for growth in the Netherlands.

You will join a global, distributed team that values initiative, transparency, customer impact, and practical collaboration. jobs.title: Mobile Service Engineer – South England
jobs.description:
Hozah is a tech-led, award-winning company driving change in the parking industry and reimagining urban mobility. Our mission is simple but powerful: to transform parking into a seamless, automated experience, paving the way for smarter, more sustainable cities. With recognition as PayTech Company of the Year, a place among Deloitte's Top 50 Fastest Growing Tech Companies in the UK, and significant VC/PE investment, we're scaling rapidly and need a skilled Mobile Service Engineer to look after our growing estate from Manchester southwards.

Role Overview

We are seeking a hands-on and proactive Mobile Service Engineer to manage the maintenance and overall health of our car park infrastructure from Manchester southwards, ensuring that downtime on sites due to equipment failure is kept to a minimum. You'll be responsible for the ongoing maintenance of existing sites and the coordination of subcontractors to keep operations running seamlessly. The role calls for a mix of technical expertise, knowledge of CCTV/ANPR cameras and a problem-solving mindset, with regular site visits to either oversee or carry out maintenance work.

Location & Travel

This is a field-based role covering our southern estate, from Manchester southwards and down to the South West, including St Austell in Cornwall. The ideal candidate will be based within this area and must be able to travel regularly to sites across all of our southern locations. We also have a North equivalent of this role, so there may be the odd occasion where you're asked to cover sites further north. We're flexible on working hours where long journeys are involved, and travel time will be factored in where necessary.

Key Responsibilities

  • Equipment maintenance: Maintain ANPR cameras, Pay & Display machines, tablets, signage and other related equipment.

  • RAMS: Ensure Risk Assessments and Method Statements (RAMS) are prepared and followed when on site.

  • Signage & frontline maintenance: Install and replace signage and kiosk consumables as required, ensuring compliance with safety and operational standards.

  • Issue resolution: Diagnose and resolve technical issues on site, ensuring all equipment functions optimally.

  • Compliance & safety: Adhere to all safe working procedures and compliance guidelines, ensuring a safe and effective work environment.

  • Site visits: Visit sites from Manchester southwards on a scheduled basis to carry out general site health checks.

  • Proactive monitoring: Plan and execute regular site visits and maintenance schedules across the southern estate to maintain a high-quality estate.

  • Subcontractor coordination: Coordinate subcontractors on site to ensure maintenance and project work is delivered on time.

Skills & Qualifications

  • Background in hands-on installation, ideally from companies or industries such as Sky, CCTV, BT, Field IT or IoT-related roles. (ANPR experience is beneficial but not required.)

  • Experience working with subcontractors to ensure projects meet deadlines.

  • Ability to work independently, making on-the-spot decisions to meet project objectives.

  • Experience producing site documentation, such as site maps and install plans.

  • Comfortable working alone, following installation plans and survey documents.

  • Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to multitask and adapt to dynamic site conditions.

  • Based within our southern area (Manchester southwards), and able to travel regularly across all of our sites, as far as St Austell in Cornwall.

  • Full, clean UK driving licence (essential).

  • Basic knowledge of Risk Assessments and RAMS documentation.

Desirable Qualifications / Certificates

  • Asbestos Awareness

  • Abrasive Wheels Certification

  • Working at Height Certification

  • Ladder Safety Training

  • Health & Safety Awareness

  • C&G 2365 (Electrical Installation)

  • CAT & Genny Training

  • IPAF (Powered Access Equipment)

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary & benefits: Reflective of your experience and designed to support your professional growth and well-being.

  • Company van for site travel.

  • Company pension, sick pay and on-site parking.

  • Flexible, home-based working: Split your time between home, our sites and our Croydon office.

Why Hozah?

At Hozah, you'll play a pivotal role in a purpose-driven company at the forefront of urban mobility innovation. We foster a culture of collaboration, creativity and positive impact, where your contributions help shape the future of smarter cities. If you're looking to make a real difference in transforming the future of mobility, we'd love to hear from you. Join us and be part of this exciting journey!

Job Details

  • Job type: Full-time

  • Schedule: Monday to Friday

  • Location: Field-based, Manchester southwards, including the South West as far as St Austell (ideally based within this area)

Hozah does not offer visa sponsorship for this role; applicants must have the right to work in the UK.

jobs.title: Superviseur support client international (Support technique opération de tracking sportif) - Télétravail horaires décalées (H/F)
jobs.description:
McLloyd est une PME technologique française spécialisée dans les solutions de tracking appliquées aux courses. Nos technologies sont notamment utilisées dans plus de 13000 courses hippiques annuelles organisées en France et à l’international.

Dans le cadre du développement de nos activités, notamment en Australie puis aux États-Unis, nous créons un nouveau pôle de supervision chargé d’accompagner nos clients pendant leurs opérations. Ce service a vocation à évoluer progressivement vers une couverture internationale 24 heures sur 24 et 7 jours sur 7. L’équipe, constituée dans un premier temps de deux superviseurs, sera amenée à s’étoffer pour atteindre probablement quatre personnes.

Nous recherchons aujourd’hui notre nouveau superviseur pour participer au lancement et à la construction de ce pôle.

Vos missions

Votre mission

Pendant les opérations de tracking, vous serez le premier point de contact du client. Vous prendrez en charge ses demandes, réaliserez les premières vérifications, résoudrez les incidents simples en direct et transmettrez les situations nécessitant une expertise complémentaire à notre équipe d’ingénieurs (ticketing)

Il s’agit d’un poste opérationnel et technique, sans responsabilité managériale.

Vos principales responsabilités

  • Superviser à distance le bon déroulement des opérations de tracking ;
  • Répondre aux sollicitations des clients pendant les plages de couverture ;
  • Recueillir et qualifier les informations nécessaires à la compréhension d’un incident ;
  • Effectuer les premières vérifications et appliquer les procédures de dépannage ;
  • Résoudre les incidents de premier niveau ;
  • Créer, documenter et suivre les tickets dans notre outil interne ;
  • Transmettre aux ingénieurs les incidents nécessitant une expertise technique approfondie ;
  • Informer le client de l’avancement de sa demande et suivre l’incident jusqu’à sa résolution ou sa transmission complète ;
  • Tenir à jour la documentation interne ;
  • Rédiger les comptes rendus d’opération (% de réussite, interventions et résolutions) quotidiens et mensuels
  • Préparer les opérations à venir et participer à l’amélioration continue du pôle de supervision.L’activité alterne des périodes de supervision en temps réel et des périodes consacrées à la préparation des opérations, au suivi des tickets, à la documentation et à l’amélioration des procédures.

Organisation du travail et horaires

Le poste est organisé en temps plein annualisé. Le planning est établi à l’avance selon le calendrier international des courses et fonctionne par rotation entre les membres de l’équipe.

  • Horaires de journée, prises de poste tôt le matin et horaires de soirée ;
  • À terme, horaires de nuit dans le cadre du développement aux États-Unis ;
  • Travail régulier le week-end et certains jours fériés ;
  • Répartition des plages de couverture entre les superviseurs selon un système de rotation.

Actuellement, certaines opérations peuvent commencer dès 5 heures et se terminer jusqu’à 22 heures. Avec le développement de nos activités aux États-Unis, certaines plages de supervision pourront être réalisées pendant la nuit.

L’organisation des rotations sera réalisée dans le respect du temps de travail annualisé, des temps de repos et des dispositions légales et conventionnelles applicables. Les heures de nuit, du dimanche et des jours fériés donneront lieu aux majorations ou compensations prévues au sein de l’entreprise. Cette organisation implique une réelle disponibilité et l’acceptation d’horaires variables. Elle ne signifie toutefois pas que chaque superviseur travaillera systématiquement la nuit ou tous les week-ends.

Vos compétences

Profil recherché

  • Personne sérieuse, ponctuelle, fiable, calme et méthodique face à un incident ;
  • Autonomie et capacité à travailler efficacement à distance ;
  • Aisance dans la relation client, par téléphone comme par écrit ;
  • Capacité à recueillir des informations précises et à les transmettre clairement ;
  • Aisance avec les outils informatiques et les environnements techniques ;
  • Respect des procédures et attention portée à la qualité de la documentation ;
  • Disponibilité pour travailler selon un planning tournant comprenant des horaires de jour, de nuit, de week-end et certains jours fériés ;
  • Connexion internet stable et environnement adapté au télétravail.

Anglais courant obligatoire, à l’oral comme à l’écrit.

Une expérience professionnelle d’au moins deux ans en support client, assistance technique, supervision d’opérations, exploitation informatique, maintenance à distance ou gestion d’incidents est requise.

La connaissance du secteur hippique constitue un plus, mais elle n’est pas indispensable. Une formation aux solutions et aux procédures Mclloyd sera assurée en interne.

Avantages

Conditions proposées

  • CDI à temps plein annualisé ;
  • Majorations ou compensations applicables aux horaires concernés ;
  • Poste exercé en 100 % télétravail ;
  • Planning organisé par rotation et communiqué à l’avance ;
  • Déplacements ponctuels possibles au siège ou sur certaines opérations, notamment pendant la période de formation ;
  • Formation technique assurée en interne ;
  • Participation à la création d’un nouveau pôle stratégique pour le développement international de Mac-Lloyd.

Pourquoi rejoindre McLloyd

Vous intégrerez une PME technologique en pleine évolution et participerez directement à la création d’un nouveau service international. Vous occuperez un poste concret, autonome et utile aux clients, au contact d’opérations sportives organisées en France et à l’étranger. Vous contribuerez également à la définition des procédures et à l’organisation d’une équipe amenée à se développer progressivement

Visionary in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies, We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading.

About the Role:

Hi there! We're hiring an ADR I to join our Account Development team at Camunda.

We're a tight-knit, energetic team that takes outbound seriously without taking ourselves too seriously. We run structured prospecting motions, share what's working in real time, celebrate the wins together, and still allow for flexibility in the way we operate because booking a good meeting takes real work and progressing an opportunity puts ADRs at the forefront of a great GTM motion.

This is a strong entry point into tech sales for someone who wants to learn and refine the fundamentals of prospecting, discovery, and pipeline generation inside an enterprise software motion. You'll work directly with Account Executives but will also be responsible for prospecting into your own patch. We ask that all of our ADRs have a remote environment that is conducive to consistent weekly motions and to be able to travel 4-6 times per year, usually a week or less at a time.

As an ADR I, you'll run long-term outbound and timely inbound prospecting motions to generate qualified pipeline for our sales team. Working emails, sales cadences, social outreach and most importantly calls to get in front of the right people at the right accounts at the right time. This role exists because a sustainable pipeline is built through persistence, consistency, a growth mindset and an ability to diagnose challenges and bring solutions within your own prospecting motion.

What you'll be doing:

  • Generate qualified pipeline by running outbound prospecting across email, phone, event outreach and attendance and LinkedIn into target accounts.

  • Qualify inbound interest through ADR-led scheduled calls and convert into booked meetings for Account Executives.

  • Research accounts, personas and signals to tailor and leverage AI for high touch low impact motions.

  • Partner with Account Executives to understand what constitutes a quality meeting, contact and account, and adjust your approach based on feedback.

  • Exhibit excellent operational hygiene by tracking activity and pipeline health in Salesforce and other sales tools to monitor your own inputs and performance.

  • Learn Camunda's product and value propositions and the process orchestration space well enough to have credible, useful conversations with prospects in specific verticals.

What you bring:

  • Some experience with outbound prospecting or customer-facing communication is preferred. This doesn't have to be in sales. Internships, retail, hospitality, or customer support all count if you know how to build rapport with people, manage expectations and handle rejection.

  • Comfort with strict time management and prioritization of requests. You'll be conducting a lot of calls and emails, and you're motivated by the math of it. You will also be given regular enablement and will be responsible for monitoring multiple sources of leads.

  • Curiosity about technology and a willingness to learn a technical product. You don't need an engineering background, but you need to be genuinely interested in understanding what Camunda does and why it matters to the people you're calling. You share successes.

  • Resilience and self-awareness. You know how to keep going without getting discouraged, and you can tell the difference between a bad day and a bad approach.

  • Coachability. You take feedback from your manager and AEs seriously and change your approach in a timely and meaningful way based on it.

  • Cross-functional relationships. You have a curiosity as to how things work and which individuals you can support and thus that can support you. You ask questions and challenge the status quo if you’ve experienced a better solution.

Nice-to-haves:

  • Ability and/or willingness to use our product.

jobs.title: Closer
jobs.description:
Chez nous, vendre, c'est coacher à la décision. 🎯

Nous sommes convaincus de trois choses :

  • Vous êtes là pour sincèrement aider la personne en face de vous.

  • Sa réussite se trouve souvent en dehors de sa zone de confort.

  • Pour obtenir des résultats différents, il faut oser faire les choses différemment.

Cela implique parfois de confronter les prospects à leurs peurs, leurs contradictions ou leurs croyances limitantes.

Même si c'est inconfortable. 💡

Parfois, votre rôle sera simplement de provoquer une prise de conscience et de les laisser partir. D'autres fois, il faudra aller plus loin pour les aider à regarder la réalité en face.

Toujours avec la même intention : faire ce qui est le mieux pour eux.

Si cette façon de voir la vente vous parle, lisez la suite. 👇

À propos de NextGenLearning 🚀

Chez NextGenLearning, nous accompagnons des personnes qui partent de zéro pour se reconvertir en Data Analyst et décrocher un emploi.

Notre objectif n’est pas de faire une formation de plus, mais de développer un nouveau standard dans notre domaine.

Nous avons construit un produit exceptionnel, qui permet à nos élèves d'obtenir des transformations que beaucoup pensent impossibles.

Et plutôt que de vous demander de nous croire sur parole, voici quelques témoignages de nos élèves : 🎥

  • Barman → Data Analyst : https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yTFLTspkOGc

  • BAC+2 → Data Analyst : https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jkiycuwroAo

  • Fonctionnaire → Data Analyst (en 8 mois avec famille et boulot en // ) : https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=oTGsn3x391Y

  • Marketing → Data Project Manager : https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lQG_-yspImU

  • Jonathan - Retour après avoir fait des bootcamps pendant 4 ans : https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qZqLoWP1RwA

Nous sommes une petite équipe de passionnés, curieux, exigeants avec nous-mêmes, qui aiment le travail bien fait et cherchent constamment à s'améliorer.

Nous grandissons et aujourd’hui, nous recherchons un Closer qui souhaite construire avec nous sur le long terme.

Votre mission 🤝

Nos prospects prennent une décision importante : changer de métier.

Votre rôle est de comprendre leur situation, de leur apporter les connaissances et les perspectives nécessaires, et de les aider à prendre une décision éclairée.

Cela demande de savoir écouter, expliquer, rassurer et parfois confronter leurs idées.

Concrètement :

  • Mener des entretiens de vente avec des prospects qualifiés.

  • Comprendre leurs motivations, leurs freins et leurs objectifs.

  • Présenter notre accompagnement avec pédagogie.

  • Assurer le suivi commercial et le reporting quotidien.

  • Respect de nos process : les leads qualifiés le sont.

  • Participer aux trainings d’équipe pour progresser continuellement.

Conditions 📋

  • Statut : Freelance / Indépendant

  • Lieu : 100% télétravail, d'où vous voulez 🌎

  • Disponibilité : minimum 15h par semaine, dont 10h de calls commerciaux

  • Rémunération : discutée après qualification de votre candidature.


Ce qui compte pour nous, ce sont les résultats, pas les heures travaillées.

Vous êtes libre de vous organiser comme vous le souhaitez. En contrepartie, nous attendons de la fiabilité : tenir vos engagements et être présent dans les moments importants.

Nous voulons être les meilleurs et gagner, mais jamais au détriment de notre santé, de notre famille ou de notre vie personnelle.

Le profil recherché 🌟

  • Amoureux de la psychologie humaine : vous aimez comprendre les gens, leurs motivations, leurs peurs et leurs comportements.

  • Intelligence émotionnelle : vous savez écouter, faire preuve d'empathie et confronter avec bienveillance.

  • Communication : vous vous exprimez avec clarté, précision et impact.

  • Ouvert au feedback (essentiel) : vous aimez apprendre, remettre en question vos méthodes et progresser.

  • Autonome et fiable : vous savez vous organiser et prendre vos responsabilités.

  • Orienté résultats

Une expérience en vente, accompagnement client ou marketing est un plus.

Mais ce sont avant tout vos compétences démontrées qui nous intéressent, pas vos diplômes ou certifications.

🚀 Pourquoi rejoindre l’équipe

  • La meilleure raison de travailler avec nous, c’est que vous aimez ce que nous faisons et vous avez envie d’en faire partie, surtout si notre mission vous inspire.

  • Vous travaillez d’où bon vous semble.

  • Si vous êtes performant, vous prendrez rapidement en responsabilité au sein de l’entreprise. Nous verrons ensemble comment vous propulser vers vos objectifs et aller bien plus loin que ça (du moment que vous avez l'ambition et la détermination d'avancer avec nous sur ce chemin) !

Pour postuler ✉️

Envoyez-nous votre candidature accompagnée d'une courte vidéo (2-5 minutes) dans laquelle vous présentez :

  • Votre parcours et vos expériences commerciales.

  • Vos résultats et vos principales forces.

  • Pourquoi vous souhaitez rejoindre NextGenLearning.

Si votre profil retient notre attention, nous vous recontacterons pour un premier échange.

jobs.title: (Senior) Full Stack Engineer (m/f/x) - Based in Germany
jobs.description:
Cara Care, a digital health company backed by Bayer AG, is on a mission to improve people’s digestive health through technology. As we expand our product portfolio and modernize our platform, we’re looking for a versatile, pragmatic, and forward-thinking (Senior) Full-Stack Engineer (m/f/x) to help shape the future of digital therapeutics.

Your Role

You’ll join a cross-functional product team with high ownership, lean processes, and a clear focus: deliver real impact to patients. We’re looking for someone who thrives on solving real-world problems with code, is technology-open, and knows when to build fast and when to build right. Your main focus will be building and improving our backend services, while also contributing to our React Native apps.  You’ll also help us use AI tools and coding agents thoughtfully in day-to-day engineering, turning emerging capabilities into reliable workflows that improve how we design, build, test, and operate patient-facing products.

Your Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and operate reliable backend services and APIs, primarily using Python, Django, and PostgreSQL, and contribute targeted changes to our React Native applications with TypeScript.
  • Use AI coding agents to implement features, refactor code, and generate tests. Define clear tasks and constraints, provide relevant context, Provide clear context and constraints, and validate changes through code review, automated tests, and application-level checks.
  • Take an end-to-end view of features: understand how mobile clients, APIs, data models, and infrastructure interact, and make pragmatic technical decisions across these boundaries.
  • Own backend delivery from architecture and implementation to automated testing, deployment, monitoring, and iteration, and continuously improve our CI/CD pipelines.
  • Improve the performance and reliability of our backend services, APIs, and databases.
  • Connect AI-assisted development to engineering and design tools via MCP, for example to automate repetitive coding tasks or check frontend changes against Figma designs. Keep patient data, credentials, and other sensitive information out of unapproved tools and workflows.
  • Collaborate closely with Product, Design, and Medical to explore, define, and deliver patient-centric features across our platform, supporting regulated digital health products for IBS, GERD, and upcoming indications.
  • Uphold technical excellence in architecture, code quality, and security, including applicable requirements under IEC 62304, BSI TR-03161, and the MDR. 
  • Mentor other developers and help raise the technical bar across the team.

Requirements

Your Profile

Must haves

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a strong backend focus and an understanding of how complete applications work from user interface to infrastructure.
  • Strong backend development skills in an established language such as Python, TypeScript, Java, or PHP. Our current stack includes Python, Django, and PostgreSQL.
  • Working knowledge of React Native and TypeScript, with the ability to implement and test changes in an existing mobile application.
  • Solid understanding of relational databases, API design, distributed systems and services.
  • Experience writing and maintaining automated tests for backend services and APIs, including unit and integration tests.
  • Solid understanding of backend security and privacy, including authentication, authorization, secrets management, and secure handling of personal and patient data.
  • Strong practical knowledge of containers, Kubernetes, and cloud-native architecture, with experience using GCP or another major cloud provider such as AWS or Azure.
  • Hands-on experience using AI coding agents to implement features, refactor code, and write automated tests, including connecting agents to engineering tools via MCP. You can explain how you scoped the work, verified the results, and handled tool permissions and sensitive data.
  • A pragmatic product mindset: you collaborate effectively with non-technical stakeholders, understand the impact of technical decisions on patients and UX, and continuously improve both product and platform.

Nice-to-have

  • Strong Linux administration skills, including setting up, operating, and securing self-managed cloud instances; familiarity with monitoring and observability concepts.
  • Experience with Prometheus, Loki, and Grafana; GitOps using ArgoCD or FluxCD; or configuration management using Ansible or similar tools.
  • Networking knowledge and experience with mobile CI/CD, release automation, or application monitoring tools such as Sentry.
  • Experience in regulated industries, healthcare, or other security-conscious environments.


💡Please note: Cara Care is a remote-first company with a fully distributed team. All team members are based in Germany so candidates must reside in Germany to join us.

Benefits

💸 Fair compensation: We offer fair pay, regular salary reviews, and the equipment you need to do your best work.

🫶 Great team spirit: Join a vibrant, interdisciplinary team and enjoy a friendly, supportive working atmosphere, with regular in-person team events.

👨‍💻 Remote-first working: Prefer working from home? No problem. Want to join us at our Berlin office? That works too. Our remote-first approach gives you the flexibility to work where it suits you best.

🏝️ 30 days off per year: Rest matters. You’ll get 26 vacation days plus 4 additional company-wide mental health days each year to take a breather and recharge.

🦉 Flexible working hours: Whether you’re an early bird or prefer a later start, you can shape your working day around what works for you.

🏋️ Urban Sports Club (USC): Enjoy access to a wide range of sports, fitness, and wellness activities at discounted rates.

🧠 OpenUp: Access a variety of resources and services to support your mental health and personal wellbeing.

🛍️ Corporate Benefits: Get attractive discounts and exclusive offers from a wide range of well-known brands and providers.

🚀 Make a real impact: Be involved, contribute your ideas, and help shape what comes next. Your voice matters, and you can make a real difference.

About Cara Care

Cara Care is a digital health company on a mission to improve the lives of people with digestive health conditions through holistic, science-based digital therapies.

Our established IBS therapy, Cara Care für Reizdarm, provides personalised content, practical exercises, and symptom tracking to help people better understand and manage their condition. It is listed in the German Federal Institute for Drugs and Medical Devices’ (BfArM) directory of digital health applications (DiGA) and is covered by statutory health insurance in Germany.

We are expanding our product portfolio and evolving our technology platform to bring digital therapies to more people across a broader range of conditions.

Backed by Bayer

We’re proud to share that Cara Care has recently joined the Bayer Group, a move that strengthens our mission and enables us to scale our impact even further. With Bayer’s global healthcare expertise and our innovative digital approach, we’re poised to redefine care for digestive health.

What It’s Like to Work With Us

At Cara Care, you’ll be part of an interdisciplinary team of doctors, designers, engineers, and creatives who are deeply passionate about improving lives. We’re inspired by our patients and driven by real-world impact. We move fast, collaborate closely, and never lose sight of the importance of well-being—both for our users and ourselves.

Diversity Matters to Us

We believe that diverse teams build better products. That’s why we’re committed to creating an inclusive environment for everyone—regardless of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, or disability.

We know that applying for a new job is a big step, and we genuinely appreciate your time and effort. We’re excited to get to know you!

jobs.title: Office Manager (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Deine Rolle

Als Office Manager (w/m/d) bist du das Herzstück unseres Berliner Offices. Du sorgst dafür, dass im Hintergrund alles funktioniert und sich Kolleg*innen, Kund*innen und Gäste rundum wohlfühlen.

Du denkst voraus, behältst den Überblick und packst selbst mit an – vom täglichen Office-Betrieb über Events bis hin zu größeren Projekten wie Umzügen oder Umbauten.

Was machst du dabei konkret?

Du hältst unser Office am Laufen. Du koordinierst Hausverwaltung, Handwerker und Dienstleister und kümmerst dich um alles, was einen reibungslosen Office-Alltag ausmacht – von Meetingräumen, Bestellungen und Post bis zu Dokumentationen, Reisebuchungen, Rechnungen und Belegen. Auch ausgewählte Themen für unser Münchener Office liegen bei dir.

Du bist Gastgeber*in und bringst Menschen zusammen. Du empfängst Kund*innen und Gäste, bereitest Meetings und Catering vor und sorgst dafür, dass unser Office ein Ort ist, an dem man gerne zusammenkommt. Dazu gehören auch unsere internen Events, All Hands sowie die kleinen Dinge, die unsere Office Culture ausmachen – von Geburtstagen bis Merchandise.

Du sorgst für einen großartigen Employee Lifecycle. Gemeinsam mit IT und den relevanten Teams organisierst du ein reibungsloses On- und Offboarding und kümmerst dich um organisatorische Themen rund um Wellbeing und Arbeitssicherheit.

Du übernimmst Projekte und packst an. Ob Event, Umbau oder Umzug: Du koordinierst Timelines, Budgets und Beteiligte und sorgst dafür, dass es läuft. Und wenn eine Glühbirne gewechselt oder ein Griff festgeschraubt werden muss, machst du das auch einfach selbst.

Das bringst du mit

Background
Du hast eine abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung, eine Ausbildung in Hotellerie, Gastronomie oder Eventmanagement oder einen vergleichbaren Hintergrund. Entscheidend ist für uns aber nicht dein konkreter Abschluss, sondern dass du bereits relevante praktische Erfahrung mitbringst.

Skills und Qualifikationen:

  • Du hast Erfahrung im Office Management, Workplace Management, Hospitality, Eventmanagement oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle.

  • Du kommunizierst fließend auf Deutsch und Englisch und fühlst dich mit digitalen Tools wohl.

  • Du bist stark in Organisation und Koordination und kannst mehrere Themen gleichzeitig souverän steuern.

  • Erfahrung aus Hotellerie, Gastronomie oder Projektmanagement ist ein Plus.

Mindset

Hospitality & Service: Du hast Freude daran, dass sich andere willkommen und gut aufgehoben fühlen, und hast ein Auge für die Details, die den Unterschied machen.

Ownership & Hands-on: Du siehst, was zu tun ist, übernimmst Verantwortung und findest pragmatische Lösungen – selbst oder mit den richtigen Leuten.

jobs.title: Tools Developer (Rust / Linux)
jobs.description:
About Fractile

Fractile was founded in 2022 on the bet that, eventually, the world’s most capable AI systems would be limited in their impact by the time taken to produce useful outputs. We bet everything on the logical conclusion: that the only way to truly unlock this latent value, to make speed viable at scale, was to radically re-invent the hardware that we run our frontier AI models on. Ever since, we have been building chips and systems that tackle this problem: how to efficiently generate output at thousands of tokens per second, while handling the complexity and capacity challenges of operating large models at very long contexts.

 

The workloads that push to the limits of the current frontier are already transformational; it is the technical and economic limits on inference speed that are constraining progress. The defining work of the 21st century will be marked by the engine of inference delivering immense and diffuse chains of intellectual inquiry, in drug discovery, in software engineering, in materials discovery, in any field where progress is driven by deep reasoning and intelligence to resolve complex problems.

About the Software organisation at Fractile

Developer Experience sits within the Software organisation at Fractile, which is responsible for developing a full software stack for our groundbreaking AI inference systems. That's everything from ML compilers, device drivers and systems firmware, application level runtime and ecosystem integrations, ML and compute libraries, great developer tooling and a full portfolio of simulators, through to datacenter scale workload deployment solutions. At Fractile, we know that a fantastic software stack is a critical and central part of any AI inference solution and it sits at the heart of everything we're doing.


About the team and role

The tools built by the Developer Experience team are how engineers — both inside Fractile and at our customers — see, control and understand the Fractile inference accelerator. That means the command-line utilities used to discover, configure and health-check devices; the diagnostics used during hardware bring-up and in the datacentre; and the profiling, tracing and debugging tools that show where the time goes across the host, the driver and the silicon.

As a Tools Developer you will design and build these tools in Rust, running on Linux hosts from a single developer workstation against large datacentre deployments. You will work closely with the hardware, firmware, kernel driver, runtime and Developer Experience teams to understand what they need, and turn that into fast, reliable and well-designed tools that fit naturally into existing Linux workflows. This is largely greenfield work, with real scope to shape how our tooling is architected and how it is used.


About you

You enjoy building tools that other engineers rely on every day, and you care about getting the details right: clear output, sensible defaults, good error messages and behaviour you can script against. You are at home on Linux, comfortable working anywhere from the shell down to sysfs, ioctls and the kernel/userspace boundary, and you know how to find out what a system is actually doing when it misbehaves. You are self-driven, able to identify tooling opportunities for yourself, and happy to work autonomously in areas of ambiguity.


Key Requirements

  • Strong Rust skills, with experience shipping production-quality tools or libraries

  • Knowledge of Linux from a developer's perspective: processes, memory, filesystems, sysfs/procfs, device files and ioctls, systemd and the kernel/userspace interface

  • Experience designing command-line tools and APIs that are easy to learn, script and automate

  • Experience working with stakeholders across multiple teams

Nice to Have

  • Experience writing tools for PCIe-attached devices, GPUs or other ML accelerators

  • Experience using CUDA, ROCm, Vulkan Compute, or similar

  • Familiarity with tracing and telemetry formats or systems such as Perfetto, Chrome trace format, OpenTelemetry or Prometheus

  • Experience exposing Rust libraries to Python (e.g. PyO3) or C

  • Experience with Bazel, CI/CD or packaging software for Linux distributions

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary: A competitive salary reflective of your experience and the specialist nature of the role.

  • Equity & Ownership: meaningful equity so everyone shares in the value creation

  • Benefits: Private Medical, Dental and Vision, Contributory Pension, 25 Days holiday plus bank holidays and Life/Critical Illness Insurance.

  • Diverse & fun office: we believe the hardest problems get solved by the broadest range of minds. We are committed to Equal Employment Opportunity through attracting and retaining a diverse team and building an inclusive environment.

Fractile is seeking to increase the clock speed of global progress, one chip at a time. We’ve recently raised $220M from investors including Founders Fund and Accel and our most important work lies ahead. Join us!

jobs.description:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The team

Mistral Cloud builds and operates the infrastructure that powers Mistral's AI. The Data Centers team signs long-term leases for data center capacity developed by third-party operators, sources the GPUs that fill those halls, and runs the workloads that train and serve Mistral's models. Today the team is around 40 people, mainly based in Paris with some remote members, and operates roughly 200 MW of existing capacity across France. Key partners include Éclairion in France and EcoDC in Sweden, which is currently delivering Mistral's first Swedish data center.

The team sits at the center of an ambitious roadmap: Mistral has publicly committed to securing one gigawatt of data center capacity globally by 2030. With 200 MW already online, roughly 800 MW remain to be secured over the next five years. Every megawatt needs power, and power is this role's domain.

The Role

Mistral's data centers will consume hundreds of megawatts of electricity. This hire makes sure that power is reliable and affordable. You will define and execute Mistral's energy procurement strategy: structuring agreements with utilities, hedging against volatile spot prices, and tracking the regulatory changes that affect where and how data centers can be powered. The role also touches energy policy and community relations in the regions where Mistral operates.

This is a hybrid seat. Roughly half of the work is commercial: procurement contracts, hedging instruments, and price risk management. The other half is policy and positioning: monitoring regulation, engaging with grid operators and local authorities, and helping Mistral build the social license to operate large data centers across Europe.

What You Will Do

  • Define and execute Mistral's energy procurement strategy across European data center sites

  • Negotiate power purchase agreements and procurement contracts with utilities

  • Structure hedging agreements to limit exposure to volatile spot power prices

  • Monitor energy regulation and policy developments that affect data center siting, grid connection, and power pricing

  • Engage with grid operators, regulators, and local communities in regions where Mistral builds and operates data centers

What We're Looking For

  • You have procured energy at scale. You have structured power purchase agreements, utility contracts, or hedging instruments for industrial or infrastructure-scale consumers.

  • You understand European energy markets. You know how power pricing, grid connection, and regulation work across the markets where Mistral operates.

  • You can read a regulatory brief. You have tracked and interpreted energy or infrastructure policy and translated it into commercial implications.

  • You communicate across disciplines. You work effectively with engineers, finance, legal, and external stakeholders, and can explain complex energy concepts to non-specialists.

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

jobs.title: Staff or Senior Machine Learning Engineer - Identity & Audience
jobs.description:
Streaming TV is no longer just a brand awareness channel. It’s becoming a core part of the performance marketing mix, alongside search and social. Vibe.co is building the platform that makes TV work like the rest of the acquisition stack: targeted, measurable, and optimized for results.

Vibe.co is an Audience First Streaming TV Advertising platform that gives marketers the tools to reach the right audiences, optimize campaigns in real time, and understand what’s actually driving business outcomes. With hyper-targeted segmentation, AI-powered recommendations, real-time optimization, and incrementality measurement, Vibe brings the precision and accountability of digital advertising to the biggest screen in the house.

Today, more than 12,000 brands use Vibe.co to reach 120 million+ households. And in August 2026, Vibe.co became a Walmart company, opening up a new chapter for the business and the industry. With Walmart’s first-party data and purchase signals now part of the Vibe platform, advertisers can connect TV advertising to real-world transactions and measure the impact of CTV with a level of precision previously associated with platforms like Google and Meta.

This is a unique moment to join Vibe. With Walmart’s scale, data, and reach behind us, we’re building the next generation of TV advertising and creating a more measurable, performance-driven future for the channel.

About the Role

Data isn't a support function at Vibe, it's the fuel. Every decision about which ad reaches which household, and when, runs on it. You'll join the Data Platform team and specialize in identity, turning billions of raw events into coherent, usable entities that power targeting, measurement, and the training sets Vibe's models learn from. You'll report to the Head of Data Platform. This role exists because identity resolution at Vibe's scale is a hard, unsolved problem, and the team needs someone who can build models that catch the right signal across petabytes of events. You'll get direct, measurable impact: your work decides which ad reaches whom and whether it worked, not a metric buried in a research paper. You'll shape the roadmap for a system every team at Vibe depends on, and work on a problem that only gets more interesting as CTV scales.

What You'll Do

Identity Stack Ownership

  • Research and build algorithms that resolve coherent entities, like users and households, from billions of events

  • Turn machine learning, clustering, and statistical approaches into scalable, production-ready systems

  • Lead projects end-to-end, from stakeholder requirements through research, implementation, and post-launch iteration

  • Build platform-level identity-resolution tooling so every team can resolve identity behind their own events

  • Design for scale from the start; treat unscalable local tests as unfinished work

Cross-Team Partnership

  • Help shape and execute the roadmap for Vibe's identity stack

  • Surface tradeoffs, risks, and decisions to stakeholders without burying them in implementation detail

  • Translate ambiguous requests from Product, Sales, ML, and Finance into concrete deliverables

  • Collaborate with other ML engineers on MLOps problems

What You Need

  • 5+ years of experience as an ML engineer or data scientist building and operating production services

  • Experience operating at data scale, using tools like Dagster, Spark, or Iceberg

  • Familiarity with MLOps tooling and practices

  • A track record of leading technical projects end-to-end, from ambiguous requirements to shipped systems

  • Strong cross-functional communication skills, including adjusting detail level for your audience and pushing back constructively

  • Judgment about when to invest in abstraction and when to keep things simple

Nice to Haves

  • Experience in streaming TV advertising or programmatic advertising

Our Values

At Vibe, we run on three values: Impact, Ambition, and Urgency. We tie every goal to a real business outcome, think 10x rather than settling for good enough, and move daily rather than waiting for perfect conditions.

You'll thrive here if you own outcomes without needing direction, default to action, and hold yourself to results, not effort.

This is a high-performance environment with high-performance rewards: you'll work alongside people who push you, with real ownership over hard problems in a market that's moving fast.

If that sounds like the best version of your career, we want to meet you.

What We Offer

The pay range for this role is €99,000 - €171,000. We will support relocation to Paris for great candidates.

At Vibe, we want you to build something, own something, and grow fast. Here's how we back that up:

  • Equity — Employee Stock Ownership Plan. You're building this; you should own part of it.

  • Variable pay — Based on real Vibe business goals.

  • Hybrid flexibility — We're in the Heart of Paris and our team is in 3x a week!

  • Health insurance — Full coverage via Alan.

  • Meal vouchers — Via Swile.

  • Annual offsite — The whole team, once a year, somewhere worth the trip.

  • Tech Syncs — Engineering and Product meet in person at least quarterly, worldwide.

Our Interview Process

We respect your time. Here's exactly what to expect — no surprises, no ghosting.

  1. Recruiter screen — 30 min. We'll share context; you'll share yours.

  2. Manager interview — Meet the person you'd work with directly.

  3. Technical Interview — A real problem, not a trick. We'll work through it together.

  4. Calibration interview — A senior leader joins to ensure we're holding a consistent, high bar.

  5. Offer — Fast. We don't let good decisions sit.

  6. Reference checks — Two calls, handled with discretion.

Equal Opportunity

Vibe is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

We believe the best ideas come from teams with different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please let us know.

Referral Instructions

Being referred? Ask your contact to submit your application directly on your behalf.

jobs.description:
About myTomorrows 

myTomorrows is a global health tech company dedicated to breaking down barriers for patients seeking treatment options.   

We strive to enable earlier and better treatment access by bridging the gap between those searching for possible options, and the companies who develop them. We work closely with patients, healthcare professionals, trial sites, patient advocacy groups, and BioPharma – connecting key stakeholders in the drug development ecosystem.   

We’ve developed a cutting-edge AI-powered technology platform that simplifies and streamlines access to drugs in development. To support our users and clients, we have a range of industry-expert specialized teams ready to help. Our services include clinical trial patient recruitment, Expanded Access Program management and Real-World Data collection.   

With a global footprint spanning 134 countries, to date we’ve supported over 17,000 patients, 3,000 physicians and 350 sites, earning the trust of 60+ BioPharma companies. In October 2025, we closed a €25M investment with Avego Healthcare Capital to fuel our global ambitions and scale the business.  

Join us in shaping the future of treatment access - making tomorrow’s therapies accessible for people who need them today. 

The opportunity: People Business Partner

As a People Business Partner at myTomorrows, you are a trusted advisor to senior leaders and the Leadership Team. In this Individual contributor People Business Partner role, you will translate business priorities into practical people solutions that enable high performing teams and organizational growth.

You will partner closely with leaders across the organization to strengthen leadership effectiveness, organizational design, performance, engagement, and talent development. You enjoy balancing strategic thinking with hands on execution and are comfortable navigating the pace, ambiguity, and opportunities of a fast growing international scale up.

Given that most of our team is located in the Netherlands, we only consider candidates who live within commuting distance of our Amsterdam office.

What you'll do in this role:

  • Coach leaders on performance management, leadership effectiveness, feedback, development, and difficult people conversations.

  • Lead complex employee relations cases, including performance improvement, conflict resolution, absence management, and sensitive exits.

  • Drive and continuously improve key People programs, including performance management, engagement, talent reviews, succession planning, and career development.

  • Translate business strategy into practical People initiatives that support organizational growth and scalability.

  • Use people data and insights to identify trends, challenge assumptions, and recommend actions that improve engagement, retention, and organizational performance.

  • Partner closely with Talent Acquisition and People Operations to deliver an outstanding employee experience across the entire employee lifecycle.

  • Ensure consistent application of People policies, employment legislation, and People practices across your business areas.

  • Lead cross functional People projects that improve organizational effectiveness, manager capability, and operational excellence.

  • Act as a trusted sparring partner who balances strategic thinking with hands on execution.

What you bring to the table:

  • Demonstrated experience partnering with senior leaders on organizational and people topics.

  • Extensive experience managing complex employee relations, performance management, and organizational change.

  • Strong coaching, influencing, and stakeholder management skills.

  • Solid knowledge of Dutch employment law and HR best practices.

  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate people data into actionable business insights.

  • Comfortable operating independently, making sound judgments, and managing competing priorities.

  • Experience working in a technology, SaaS, HealthTech, or scale up environment is highly preferred.

  • Experience with modern HR systems such as Personio is a plus.

  • Experience supporting international teams is a plus.

  • International work environment with scale up energy and a flat organization.

  • Competitive salary, annual performance bonus, and equity.

myTomorrows is an Equal Opportunity Employer and, beyond upholding discrimination-free practices, we are committed to cultivating a workplace where difference and diversity are protected and celebrated. The best work comes from our best selves, and we go to great lengths in supporting our team members to be just that.

jobs.title: Data & AI Governance Consultant
jobs.description:
Help organisaties om data en AI verantwoord, betrouwbaar en effectief in te zetten.

Data- en AI-governance is meer dan beleid en procedures. Het zorgt ervoor dat organisaties grip krijgen op hun data, betere beslissingen nemen en AI op een verantwoorde manier kunnen inzetten.

Bij adesso helpen we organisaties om datagedreven en AI-gedreven werken duurzaam te organiseren. Niet door alleen modellen en policies te introduceren, maar door governance te verbinden aan businesswaarde, adoptie en de dagelijkse praktijk.

Als Data & AI Governance Consultant help jij klanten om structuur aan te brengen, eigenaarschap te organiseren en hun datamanagement en AI-governance verder te professionaliseren. Je vertaalt complexe vraagstukken naar praktische oplossingen die daadwerkelijk werken.

Jouw rol

Jij brengt structuur in complexe data- en AI-vraagstukken. Je helpt organisaties om hun governanceprocessen te verbeteren, verantwoordelijkheden helder te maken en data beter te benutten.

Je werkt zelfstandig aan analyses, workshops en verbeterinitiatieven en schakelt daarbij met stakeholders uit business en IT. Samen met collega's en klanten vertaal je strategische doelstellingen naar concrete acties.

Je krijgt de ruimte om verantwoordelijkheid te nemen, je expertise te verdiepen en steeds meer zelfstandig klanten te adviseren.


Wat je doet

Data- en AI-governance

  • Je adviseert klanten over data governance, datamanagement en verantwoord gebruik van AI.

  • Je helpt bij het ontwerpen en implementeren van governance operating models, inclusief rollen, verantwoordelijkheden en besluitvorming.

  • Je voert zelfstandig maturity assessments uit en vertaalt de resultaten naar concrete verbeteradviezen.

  • Je ondersteunt bij het ontwikkelen van datastrategieën, governanceprincipes, policies en praktische roadmaps.

  • Je helpt organisaties om data ownership en data stewardship goed in te richten.

Data quality, metadata & AI

  • Je analyseert en verbetert processen rondom datakwaliteit, metadata en data lineage.

  • Je helpt bij het definiëren van kwaliteitsafspraken, KPI's en verantwoordelijkheden.

  • Je werkt samen met data engineers, architecten en andere specialisten om governancevraagstukken te vertalen naar werkbare oplossingen.

  • Je onderzoekt hoe AI en automatisering datamanagementprocessen kunnen verbeteren.

  • Je houdt rekening met privacy, security, Responsible AI en relevante wet- en regelgeving, zoals de EU AI Act.

Consultancy & stakeholdermanagement

  • Je faciliteert workshops met business- en IT-stakeholders om behoeften, knelpunten en verbeterkansen in kaart te brengen.

  • Je vertaalt zakelijke doelstellingen naar concrete governance-initiatieven en meetbare resultaten.

  • Je presenteert analyses, bevindingen en aanbevelingen op een duidelijke en overtuigende manier.

  • Je ondersteunt klanten bij het invoeren van nieuwe processen en werkwijzen en helpt draagvlak te creëren.

  • Je signaleert kansen voor aanvullende dienstverlening en bespreekt deze met je team.

Samenwerking & ontwikkeling

  • Je neemt zelfstandig verantwoordelijkheid voor onderdelen van klantprojecten en bewaakt de voortgang en kwaliteit van je werkzaamheden.

  • Je werkt nauw samen met collega's uit verschillende disciplines en schakelt tijdig wanneer ondersteuning nodig is.

  • Je gebruikt AI-tools waar ze waarde toevoegen en beoordeelt de uitkomsten kritisch, met aandacht voor vertrouwelijkheid en dataveiligheid.

  • Je deelt kennis, begeleidt waar mogelijk minder ervaren collega's en draagt bij aan de ontwikkeling van onze dienstverlening.


Wat jij meebrengt
Je bent analytisch sterk, nieuwsgierig en weet complexe onderwerpen begrijpelijk te maken. Je vindt het leuk om met klanten samen te werken en krijgt energie van het verbeteren van processen en organisaties.

  • Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding, bijvoorbeeld in Bedrijfskunde, Informatiekunde, Informatica of een vergelijkbare richting.

  • Minimaal 3 jaar relevante ervaring binnen data governance, datamanagement of dataconsultancy.

  • Kennis van data governance, data quality, data stewardship en governanceprocessen.

  • Ervaring met het uitvoeren van analyses, begeleiden van workshops of adviseren van stakeholders.

  • Begrip van data-architectuur, datamodellering en de samenwerking tussen business en IT.

  • Interesse in AI-governance en het verantwoord toepassen van AI binnen organisaties.

  • Je gebruikt AI zelf in je werk en onderzoekt graag hoe het slimmer kan.

  • Je werkt zelfstandig, neemt initiatief en weet wanneer je collega's moet betrekken.

  • Goede communicatieve vaardigheden en het vermogen om verschillende belangen samen te brengen.

  • Een uitstekende beheersing van het Nederlands en Engels.

Mooi meegenomen

  • Ervaring met maturity assessments, governance operating models of het opstellen van RACI's.

  • Kennis van DAMA-DMBOK of een CDMP-certificering, of de ambitie om deze te behalen.

  • Ervaring met datacatalogustools zoals Microsoft Purview, Collibra of Alation.

  • Kennis van metadata, data lineage en data quality frameworks.

  • Kennis van Responsible AI, de EU AI Act of data-readiness voor AI.

Over ons team

Je komt terecht in een klein, enthousiast en leergierig team van drie collega's. De lijnen zijn kort, iedereen heeft invloed en ideeën worden niet alleen gehoord, maar ook uitgeprobeerd. Onze focus ligt op de consultancykant van data en AI. We begeleiden organisaties bij AI-transformaties en beginnen altijd bij het echte probleem van de klant. Van daaruit ontwikkelen we roadmaps en helpen we bij de implementatie.

We werken aan data- en AI-governance, datastrategie, change management en datakwaliteit. Daarbij onderzoeken we continu hoe AI ons werk en dat van onze klanten slimmer kan maken.

Ontwikkeling staat voorop. We delen kennis, proberen nieuwe werkwijzen uit en leren van elkaar. Heb je een andere achtergrond binnen datamanagement? Ook dan maken we graag kennis met je.

Waarom adesso? Omdat je bij ons écht kunt meebouwen.

Bij adesso Nederland draait het om meer dan alleen technologie. We bouwen slimme oplossingen die daadwerkelijk waarde toevoegen voor onze klanten. Geen eindeloze experimenten of AI omdat het hip is, maar technologie die werkt en impact maakt.

We zijn onderdeel van de internationale adesso Group, met ruim 11.500 collega's op meer dan 60 locaties. Tegelijkertijd zijn we in Nederland een relatief klein en persoonlijk team, met korte lijnen, veel vrijheid en ruimte voor eigen initiatief.

Groot genoeg om impact te maken, klein genoeg om het verschil te voelen.

AI First: samen bouwen aan de toekomst

Bij adesso Nederland ontwikkelen we ons tot een AI First-organisatie. We geloven dat AI de manier waarop we software ontwikkelen, met data werken en klanten helpen fundamenteel verandert.

Daarom kijken we verder dan losse AI-experimenten. We bouwen aan slimme dataplatformen, AI-first applicaties en agentic oplossingen die écht onderdeel worden van bedrijfsprocessen.

Dat betekent ook dat we onze eigen manier van werken blijven vernieuwen. We omarmen nieuwe technologie, maar blijven kritisch: niet alles hoeft met AI. De beste oplossing staat altijd voorop.


En misschien wel het belangrijkste: de mensen

We houden van collega's die nieuwsgierig zijn, kennis delen en elkaar verder helpen. Mensen die goed zijn in hun vak, maar ook plezier hebben in samenwerken. Je krijgt bij ons vertrouwen, verantwoordelijkheid en de vrijheid om ideeën daadwerkelijk uit te voeren.

Wat krijg je van ons?

  • Een salaris van €5.400,- tot €6.600,- afhankelijk van jouw kennis en ervaring;

  • 8% vakantiegeld;

  • Contract voor 32 tot 40 uur per week;

  • Een leaseauto of mobiliteitsvergoeding boven op je salaris;

  • 27 vakantiedagen en 4 studiedagen;

  • €3.600 persoonlijk ontwikkelbudget per jaar en ruimte voor certificeringen;

  • Hybride werken met flexibele werktijden;

  • Goede pensioenregeling;

  • Doorgroeimogelijkheden;

  • Internationale kennis en ontwikkelmogelijkheden, gecombineerd met een hecht Nederlands team.

Zullen we kennismaken?
Je hoeft niet aan ieder technisch punt te voldoen. We zijn vooral benieuwd naar wat je hebt gebouwd, welke keuzes je hebt gemaakt en waar je naartoe wilt groeien.

Een cv of LinkedIn-profiel is genoeg om het gesprek te starten. Daarna volgen een kennismaking, een technisch gesprek en een praktijkcase.

Bij adesso werk je niet alleen aan de technologie van morgen. Je krijgt ook de ruimte om mee te bepalen hoe we die bouwen.
