Securance helps organizations build resilience and security, enabling them to provide assurance to stakeholders on IT risk management and cybersecurity. Based in Utrecht, the team works to structurally improve security for clients operating in the DACH market.

Your responsibilitiesJunior International Sales & Partnership Representative – DACH Market

Full-time Graduate Position / Part-time Working Student

📍 Utrecht, The Netherlands
🌍 International Sales & Marketing Team
🇩🇪 DACH Market – Germany, Austria & Switzerland

Your market is DACH. Your team is international. Your career starts in Utrecht.

Are you a German-speaking student or recent graduate looking for an exciting start to your international career?

Would you like to work with colleagues from different countries, build business relationships, visit industry events and learn what professional B2B sales and partnership management are really about?

Welcome to Securance!

We are looking for an enthusiastic Junior International Sales & Partnership Representative to join our international Sales & Marketing team in Utrecht, the Netherlands.

Whether you're finishing your studies or have recently graduated, we offer you the opportunity to develop your commercial skills, build an international network and gain hands-on experience in business development.

One team. Many nationalities. Different markets.

At Securance, international collaboration isn't just something we talk about. It's how we work every day.

Our sales team brings together colleagues from different countries and cultural backgrounds. Each team member focuses on developing business in their own home market, combining local knowledge and language skills with the strength of an international organization.

We work side by side in Utrecht, sharing experiences, exchanging ideas and supporting each other.

As our German-speaking representative, you'll focus on developing our business and partnerships across the DACH region.

You'll also work closely with our colleagues in Germany, travelling there regularly when needed to collaborate with the local team, meet partners, attend events and support commercial opportunities.

Your home base is Utrecht, but your professional network will extend across borders.

Learn Consultative Sales and Partnership Management from experienced professionals

At Securance, we believe successful business development starts with understanding people, their organizations and their challenges.

We don't focus on simply pushing products or closing quick deals. Instead, we practice Consultative Sales: asking the right questions, understanding customer needs, identifying opportunities and developing solutions that create long-term value.

You'll also learn how to build and manage strategic business partnerships, develop professional networks and turn relationships into meaningful commercial opportunities.

Our experienced and innovative team will coach you, involve you in real business activities and help you develop your own professional approach.

We don't expect you to know everything when you join. We expect you to be curious, motivated and eager to learn.

Our ambition is to help you become genuinely good at professional B2B sales, business development and partnership management.

What will you be doing?

As part of our international team, you will:

  • Business Development: Identify potential customers, new business opportunities and commercial prospects in the DACH region.

  • Consultative Sales: Connect with decision-makers, understand their challenges and learn how to develop valuable business solutions.

  • Partnership Management: Help build, develop and maintain relationships with business partners, referral partners and other relevant organizations.

  • Events & Networking: Attend industry conferences, networking events, trade fairs and business meetings to represent Securance and expand our professional network.

  • International Collaboration: Work closely with your international colleagues in Utrecht and regularly visit Germany to collaborate with the German team when needed.

  • Relationship Management: Support the development of long-term relationships with customers and partners.

  • Sales & Marketing: Contribute to commercial campaigns, market research, lead generation and international business development initiatives.

  • Market Development: Gradually take greater ownership of commercial activities and partnership opportunities in your market.

From day one, you'll be involved in real business activities, supported by experienced colleagues.

Who are we looking for?

We're looking for someone with potential, personality and a strong willingness to learn.

You:

  • Are in the final year of your studies or have recently graduated.

  • Speak German at native or near-native level and understand the German-speaking business environment.

  • Have good English communication skills, as English is our international working language.

  • Live in the Netherlands or are willing to relocate to the Utrecht area.

  • Enjoy meeting people, networking and building professional relationships.

  • Are curious, proactive, enthusiastic and commercially minded.

  • Enjoy working with colleagues from different nationalities and cultures.

  • Are interested in B2B sales, business development and partnership management.

  • Are comfortable attending business events and travelling to Germany regularly when required.

Previous sales experience is not required. Your attitude, motivation and willingness to learn matter much more.

What can you expect from Securance?

A genuinely international workplace

Work alongside colleagues from different countries, each bringing their own perspectives, experience and market knowledge.

Excellent professional development

Receive practical training, personal coaching and guidance from experienced sales and business development professionals.

International exposure and travel

Visit Germany to collaborate with local colleagues, meet partners and customers, and attend relevant industry events.

Build your professional network

Develop relationships with companies, industry professionals and business partners across the DACH region.

Real responsibility

Contribute to developing your own market, commercial relationships and partnership opportunities.

An innovative professional environment

Learn about cybersecurity, risk management, IT assurance and related professional services.

Opportunities for students and graduates

We welcome recent graduates interested in a full-time position and final-year students looking to combine their studies with meaningful part-time work.

A collaborative team culture

Become part of a team that shares knowledge, celebrates success and helps each other grow.

About Securance

Securance is an international professional services organization specializing in cybersecurity, risk management, IT assurance and related advisory services.

We help organizations understand risks, strengthen controls and build confidence in their business and technology environments.

Our international approach combines professional expertise with local market understanding, strategic partnerships and long-term customer relationships.

As part of our commercial team, you'll learn how to translate complex business challenges into valuable conversations, business opportunities and sustainable partnerships.

Ready to start your international career?

If you're German-speaking, internationally minded and excited to develop your skills in sales, business development and partnership management, we'd love to meet you.

Join our international team in Utrecht. Build relationships across borders. Start your career with Securance.

Apply now!

Location: Utrecht, The Netherlands. This is an office-based international team position, involving regular business travel to Germany when required. It is not a remote position based in Germany.

Engineering Manager - Compute and Data Platform (AI Platform)
jobs.description:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

🛠️ About our Engineering Teams

Behind Wayve’s embodied AI is the compute and data infrastructure that enables our ML engineers and researchers to train and run increasingly capable models. Our Compute Foundations team builds and operates the large-scale cloud infrastructure that makes this possible, spanning GPU compute, storage, workload scheduling and the platforms that support training and inference.

You’ll lead this London-based team through its next phase of growth, helping build and maintain a reliable, high-performance, multi-cloud and multi-region platform. The challenges go beyond provisioning resources: they include scheduling workloads across different GPU architectures, keeping valuable compute available, and moving data efficiently while managing costs.

You’ll lead a team working with state-of-the-art tooling to tackle infrastructure challenges found only at the world’s leading AI companies, building the platform that enables Wayve to develop its AI Driver.

 

🧠 Your day-to-day

People leadership will be your first priority. You’ll coach and develop engineers, set clear expectations, manage performance. You’ll build technical leadership within the team, giving engineers the support and ownership they need to grow. You will guide the growth of the team through hiring and onboarding.

Alongside this, you will own project prioritisation and roadmap planning, aligning priorities and delivery plans with stakeholders across Wayve. Your goal is to maximise the impact of the team in alignment with the department and company objectives. You will provide visibility into the state of systems you own through clear KPIs and dashboards.

Leading a highly technical team, you’ll bring the technical judgement to guide complex infrastructure decisions and turn competing needs into a clear roadmap. Working with technical leads, partner teams and cloud providers, you’ll balance reliability, performance, capacity and cost, and help the team deliver sustainably.

 

🧩 What you’ll be working on

  • Leading and developing the team: Coach engineers through regular feedback and one-to-ones, manage performance, support career development and build a healthy, performant and accountable team.

  • Hiring and building technical leadership: Lead hiring and onboarding as the team expands, and develop technical leads who can take ownership of key areas of the platform.

  • Driving the roadmap and delivery: Translate training and inference needs into priorities, align commitments with available resources, and surface risks and dependencies early.

  • Scaling cloud compute: Guide the evolution and operation of a multi-cloud, multi-region training and inference platform, including the adoption of new compute architectures (Nvidia Hopper, Blackwell; Qualcomm).

  • Improving scheduling and availability: Oversee Kubernetes-based infrastructure and queuing and scheduling systems, enabling workloads to use the right resources across heterogeneous GPU environments.

  • Planning capacity and cost: Partner with stakeholders and cloud providers on compute and storage forecasts, accounting for resource lead times, performance requirements and cost trade-offs.

  • Ensuring efficient storage across clouds: Guide distributed storage and caching approaches that improve data access and reduce unnecessary duplication and cross-cloud transfer costs.

 

🙌 You should apply if

  • You have a strong track record of managing and developing an infrastructure, platform or distributed systems engineering team, including hiring, coaching, performance management and career development.

  • You have delivered through others, owning team priorities and balancing delivery with operational reliability and longer-term platform improvements.

  • You have substantial experience in Kubernetes and workload queuing and scheduling systems, such as Kueue or equivalent technologies.

  • You can reason about availability, capacity, performance and cost across complex cloud infrastructure, including the interaction between compute, storage and data movement.

  • You understand large-scale GPU compute infrastructure for machine learning training or inference and the operational challenges of scaling beyond small GPU deployments.

Master Data Management Supplier Engagement Lead, Global Business Services

 

At IVC Evidensia, we are a leading veterinary services provider in Europe and North America with more than 2,500 clinics and hospitals across 19 countries and around 42,000 employees. We aim to have an extraordinary impact on animal lives, supporting in the region of 25,000 animals every single day across our international network. IVC Evidensia exists to champion the long-term health and welfare of animals and deliver our purpose of Healthy Animals, Happy Owners.

 

The GBS Master Data Management Supplier Engagement Lead is a new role and is responsible for establishing and leading a proactive, business-facing supplier engagement and governance function within Global Business Solutions (GBS).

 

The role will act as the primary point of coordination between suppliers, clinics, Country Finance, Procurement and GBS, ensuring that new suppliers are onboarded efficiently, accurately and in accordance with established master data governance standards, financial controls and procurement policies.

 

Leading a team of GBS Regional Supplier Engagement SMEs, the role will drive a consistent, standardised approach to supplier onboarding, validation, engagement and ongoing supplier data quality across all operating countries.

 

A key focus will be to embed preventative controls at the point of supplier creation, ensuring supplier records, payment methods, payment terms, banking information and supporting documentation are accurate, complete and appropriately authorised before being established in Oracle.

 

The role will also support and be consulted on the targeted supplier data improvement and remediation initiatives, including Direct Debit and Payment Terms Rationalisation, working collaboratively with Procurement, PTP and Country Finance to reduce payment exceptions, strengthen compliance and improve end-to-end Procure-to-Pay performance.

 
 

Key Accountabilities/Responsibilities:

 

Supplier Onboarding & Front-Line Governance

 
* Own and standardise the end-to-end supplier onboarding process across GBS-supported countries
* Establish minimum mandatory supplier information, documentation and validation requirements before supplier creation
* Ensure appropriate validation of supplier legal identity, tax information, banking details, payment methods and payment terms
* Implement preventative controls to minimise duplicate suppliers, incomplete records, incorrect payment arrangements and unauthorised supplier creation
* Ensure exceptions to supplier onboarding standards are documented, approved and escalated in line with established governance

jobs.title: Telecom security trainer
jobs.description:
About P1 Security

Founded in 2011, P1 Security is on a mission to secure critical and sovereign mobile networks by providing services and technologies to identify, detect, and recover from critical threats and vulnerabilities.

We address telecom security challenges across 5G, cloud-based infrastructure, OpenRAN, network slicing, edge computing (MEC), and legacy telecom systems (2/3/4G), including Diameter, SS7, SIGTRAN, GTP, and related attack surfaces.

Our team includes telecom operators, security professionals, and researchers who regularly share cutting-edge work at international security conferences and GSMA working groups. P1 Labs, our R&D branch, also shares open-source initiatives with the telecom security community (GitHub).

Job Description

Freelance Telecom Security Trainer — Worldwide Onsite Missions

We are seeking an experienced Freelance Telecom Security Trainer to deliver high-impact, onsite technical training for mobile network operators (MNOs), regulators, and enterprise clients worldwide.

Working on a per-mission basis, you will adapt and present established course content and practical lab materials from P1 Security’s training platform. You will help engineering and security operations center (SOC) teams understand telecom protocol vulnerabilities, assess their impact, and apply effective detection and defense strategies.

This role combines deep telecom security expertise with strong classroom facilitation skills and a practical, hands-on approach to learning.

Responsibilities

  • Deliver multi-day onsite technical workshops worldwide, adapting your approach to participants’ technical backgrounds and learning objectives.

  • Prepare for each mission by reviewing the course scope, audience prerequisites, learning objectives, and practical lab requirements with the P1 Security team.

  • Adapt existing online curriculum, presentations, exercises, and lab materials for engaging live classroom delivery.

  • Explain signaling flows, trust boundaries, protocol vulnerabilities, attack scenarios, and defensive controls clearly and accurately.

  • Facilitate hands-on exercises in authorized, controlled lab environments and help participants troubleshoot technical issues.

  • Answer participant questions on telecom security, including detection, mitigation, and operational defense strategies.

  • Check participants’ understanding through practical exercises, discussion, and knowledge checks.

  • Coordinate classroom and lab readiness with P1 Security and the client before delivery.

  • Gather participant feedback and share recommendations to improve course content and delivery.

  • Respect client confidentiality, intellectual property, and agreed rules of engagement throughout each mission.

Required qualifications

  • Deep telecom security expertise in one or more of the following domains:

  • SS7 / SIGTRAN: MAP/CAP signaling, common abuse scenarios, and signaling security controls. Related course: TS-201 — 2G, 3G and SS7 Mobile Network Security.

  • LTE / Diameter: S6a, Gx, and Gy interfaces, protocol vulnerabilities, and defensive measures. Related course: TS-401 — LTE Security and Insecurity.

  • GTP-C: Versions 1 and 2, control-plane procedures, security risks, and mitigation strategies. Related training tracks: TS-201 — 2G/3G and TS-401 — LTE / EPC, depending on the mission scope.

  • IMS / SIP: Signaling fundamentals, protocol weaknesses, and protection mechanisms. Related course: TS-250 — IMS Security.

  • 5G: Service-based architecture (SBA), HTTP/2 and JSON-based APIs, and interconnect security involving N32 and the Security Edge Protection Proxy (SEPP). Related course: TS-501 — 5G Telecom Security hands-on course.

  • You do not need to cover every domain to apply. Specialists in one or several domains are welcome. Missions will be matched to your demonstrated expertise; please indicate the courses and topics you are confident teaching independently.

  • Proven experience delivering technical training, workshops, or hands-on instruction to engineering or SOC teams.

  • Ability to explain complex technical concepts, manage classroom discussion, and adapt to mixed levels of experience.

jobs.description:
Description

We are looking for a creative owner, because how the world sees us decides which doors open. Join the CEO Office at QuantumDiamonds (QD) and take ownership of everything marketing and branding. You will shape how semiconductor manufacturers, failure analysis labs, partners and future colleagues experience QD, at trade shows, at events, online and in every piece of material we hand out. As an Intern in Marketing & Branding, you will drive our branding, prepare our trade show appearances and events from start to finish, and create the materials and merchandise that represent us. At the same time, you will set up the processes that make our marketing repeatable as we scale toward industrial production.

Who we are

Founded in 2022 as a spin-off of TU Munich, QD leverages quantum sensors to rapidly capture three-dimensional current maps within multi-layer chips. Our strong, international team of over 70, including physicists, engineers, data scientists, and other experts, works side by side with major semiconductor manufacturers, supporting chip debugging and accelerating yield analysis. Backed by top-tier deep tech investors, semiconductor experts, and strategic public programs, we have ensured long-term stability, shifting from breakthrough to scale - and shaping the next chapter in chip testing.

Why join QuantumDiamonds?

Picture this:

  • Quantum sensors that see inside the most advanced chips on Earth, right where two frontier fields collide.

  • Nobel-Prize physics aimed at real customers with real problems, in production now, not someday.

  • Physicists, data scientists, and engineers building side by side, turning deep science into tools the industry actually runs on.

  • An international team that runs at hard problems for fun, where knowledge moves fast and so do you.

Still unsure about why joining us?

  • You'll get to build a company together with a brilliant and welcoming team on a product that has never been done before.

  • From Day 1, you'll own your own topics end to end and see the direct impact of your work on how the world sees QuantumDiamonds.

  • Our technology is the cutting edge of tomorrow, starting today and not in 10 years.

  • You’ll be part of a high-growth company backed by top-tier investors.

Let’s make the invisible visible!

 
 

What will you do

  • Own our brand day to day and drive our ongoing branding, from rollout across all touchpoints to keeping our look consistent

  • Plan and prepare our trade show appearances end to end: booth concept, materials, logistics, shipping, and coordination with organizers and vendors

  • Plan and organize our own events and customer visits, from invitation to follow-up

  • Design decks, flyers, brochures, posters and booth materials for trade shows and customer meetings

  • Develop new merchandise and manage the process with suppliers, from idea to delivery

  • Turn trade shows, customer installations and milestones into content for LinkedIn and our website

  • Gather input from the people who build and sell our technology and work directly with management

  • Set up templates, checklists and processes for trade shows, events and marketing materials so they can be repeated and scaled

 

What is expected of you

  • You are enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master's program in Marketing, Communication, Design, Business Administration, or a related field

  • You have first experience in marketing, branding, event management, or content creation, ideally in a B2B tech environment

  • You have a strong eye for design and are confident with tools such as Canva or Figma

  • You write clearly and can make complex technical topics understandable without oversimplifying them

  • You are well organized and keep many moving parts on track, especially under deadline pressure before trade shows and events

  • Experience with LinkedIn company pages, Webflow or another CMS, or AI tools in content production is a plus

  • You have a strong technical understanding and quickly get to grips with complex topics, so you can explain our technology and its value

  • A background in physics, engineering, or another technical field is a plus

  • You take ownership: you drive topics yourself and follow them through to completion

  • You are available for a full-time internship of 4 to 6 months, can work from our Munich office

  • Fluent English is required, German is a plus

Our benefits

  • Mission: At QD, we’re driven by more than just building great products - we aim to make a lasting difference. Joining us means contributing to meaningful work that goes beyond business as usual.

  • Impact & growth: This is an exciting stage of our journey, and your voice matters. You’ll have the chance to shape our culture, influence key decisions, and grow alongside a company that’s scaling fast.

  • Health & fitness: With a company-sponsored Wellpass membership, you’ll have access to countless gyms, classes, and wellness offers across Germany to stay healthy and active.

  • Team & culture: We believe the best ideas come when we connect outside the office. From regular off-sites to team events, you’ll be part of a collaborative and supportive environment.

  • Well-being & balance: We value rest and recovery. That’s why you’ll enjoy 24 vacation days plus public holidays to recharge and return inspired.

About us

QuantumDiamonds GmbH, headquartered in Munich, Germany, develops and manufactures semiconductor inspection systems based on quantum sensing. Spun out of the Technical University of Munich in 2022, the company uses nitrogen-vacancy centers in diamond to map electrical current with micrometer precision inside advanced 2.5D and 3D chip architectures. Nine of the world's ten largest semiconductor manufacturers are engaged with QuantumDiamonds, with systems deployed across Europe, the United States, and Asia. The company is investing €152 million to build the world's first production facility for quantum sensing-based semiconductor inspection tools, supported under the European Chips Act.

  • Perform radiographic testing (RT/X-ray) and penetrant testing (PT) on production parts, welds, structures and other hardware in accordance with applicable procedures.

  • Prepare parts, verify inspection conditions, and use the required equipment and consumables.

  • Interpret and evaluate indications within the scope of your qualification and against approved acceptance criteria; seek guidance or escalate complex or ambiguous cases.

  • Produce complete inspection reports and maintain traceability of results, equipment, parameters and applicable documents.

  • Check the condition and validity of inspection equipment, and report any need for maintenance, verification or replacement.

  • Coordinate with Production to schedule inspections at the right stage and help resolve inspection-related production blockers.

  • Raise non-conformities and contribute to root-cause investigations, corrective actions and their follow-up.

  • Contribute to updating work instructions, procedures, inspection plans and report templates, under the coordination of authorized personnel.

  • When needed, coordinate inspections performed by external providers and check that their deliverables and supporting documentation are complete.

  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of NDT practices and the development of internal capabilities, including UT where your experience allows.

  • Follow the site’s safety, quality and document-control requirements.


What you bring

  • Level 2 qualification in radiographic testing (RT/X-ray) and penetrant testing (PT) under EN 4179, NAS 410, ISO 9712; current qualifications are strongly preferred.

  • Professional experience in the space industry is required, ideally involving flight hardware or critical equipment.

  • Practical experience inspecting welds, metallic structures, pressure vessels, propulsion systems, machined parts or composite components.

  • Ability to read drawings, specifications, procedures and acceptance criteria, and produce accurate, clear inspection reports.

  • Good understanding of inspection traceability, equipment control and the handling of non-conforming results.

  • Ability to work within the scope of your qualification and consult the Level 3 or technical focal points whenever a decision falls outside that scope.

  • Professional working proficiency in English, both spoken and written, to operate in an international environment.


Especially valuable

  • UT qualification or practical experience, particularly inspecting critical parts or structures.

  • Experience with digital radiography, phased-array UT, automated inspection or composite inspection.

  • Experience working with a Responsible Level 3, external NDT providers or certification bodies.

  • Experience preparing or reviewing procedures, technical instructions or inspection plans.


How you work

  • Rigorous and detail-oriented, with a consistent focus on conformity and traceability.

  • Sound technical judgment and a pragmatic, production-focused mindset.

  • Autonomous and organized, with clear communication whenever a discrepancy or concern arises.

  • Comfortable collaborating with Production, Quality, Engineering and external providers.

  • Motivated to help build robust NDT capabilities for demanding space hardware.

Why you should join us!

What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is:  

  • We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind 

  • We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them  

  • We have a lot of Fun - we refuel our energy knowing we are democratising space. It’s a wonderful and rare opportunity, are YOU up for the challenge?
